definition_zh: 刺破；扎穿；刺出的小孔；[喻] 戳破（幻想、说法）
definition_en: to make a small hole in something with a sharp point, or the hole so made
core_image: 一枚钉子扎进车胎，气从一个小孔里嘶嘶漏掉
scene: 自行车的后胎被一枚钉子扎穿，气在半分钟里泄光。A nail had punctured the back tyre, and the air was gone in half a minute.
sceneCN: 这里 puncture 指扎破车胎（第 1 个义项：刺破轮胎）；句意为自行车的后胎被一枚钉子扎穿，气在半分钟里泄光。

pos.zh: 刺破；扎穿
小孔；刺痕

senses.title: A punctured tyre
senses.definition: to make a small hole in something with a sharp point
senses.definitionCN: 用尖物在某物上扎出小孔
senses.example: A nail had punctured the back tyre, and the air was gone in half a minute.
senses.exampleCN: 一枚钉子扎穿了后胎，气在半分钟里就漏光了。
senses.why: The verb names one sharp point entering a surface and leaving a narrow opening.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是动词，指一个尖点进入表面、只留下一个窄孔的动作。

senses.title: A puncture in the tyre
senses.definition: the small hole itself, or a tyre made flat by such a hole
senses.definitionCN: 那个小孔本身，或因这种小孔而瘪掉的轮胎
senses.example: The puncture was no wider than a pin, yet the whole tyre failed.
senses.exampleCN: 那个小孔不比针尖宽，整条轮胎却报废了。
senses.why: Here the noun names the result rather than the act, and British use lets it stand for a flat tyre.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是名词，命名的是结果而不是动作；英式用法里它还可以直接指瘪掉的轮胎。

senses.title: A puncture wound
senses.definition: a wound made by a sharp point driving into the body
senses.definitionCN: 尖锐物刺入身体造成的伤口
senses.example: The doctor cleaned the puncture wound before it could infect.
senses.exampleCN: 医生在感染之前清洗了那处刺伤。
senses.why: Medicine keeps the literal picture but narrows it to skin and flesh, where depth matters more than width.
senses.whyCN: 医学沿用这个字面画面，只把它收窄到皮肉上；在那里深度比宽度更要紧。

senses.title: To puncture a myth
senses.definition: to destroy a widespread claim, or to drain someone's confidence
senses.definitionCN: 击破一个广为流传的说法，或泄掉某人的信心
senses.example: One careful study punctured the myth that the market always corrects itself.
senses.exampleCN: 一项严谨的研究戳破了市场总会自我修正的神话。
senses.why: The metaphor borrows a small hole to describe a large claim losing its pressure.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻借一个小孔，来描述一个庞大的说法失去压力。

intro.en: Puncture comes straight from Latin punctura, 'a prick', built on the verb pungere, 'to prick or sting'.
intro.cn: puncture 直接来自拉丁语 punctura（一刺），词根是动词 pungere（刺、螫）。

items.en: Pungere meant to prick, sting or pierce with a point.
items.cn: pungere 意为用尖物刺、螫或穿透。

items.en: Its participle punctus described something pricked or pointed.
items.cn: 它的分词 punctus 描述被刺过或带尖的东西。

items.en: Punctura named the prick itself and the small hole it left.
items.cn: punctura 指刺的动作本身以及留下的小孔。

items.en: English took the word first for wounds and small openings.
items.cn: 英语最初用这个词指伤口和小开口。

items.en: Later it became a verb for deflating claims and confidence.
items.cn: 后来它变成动词，用来给说法和信心放气。

note.en: The look-alike group is the punct- family; the near-meaning group separates pierce, prick, perforate and stab by size and intent.
note.cn: 形近组是 punct 词族；近义组按大小与意图把「穿透」「轻刺」「穿孔」「捅刺」分开。

entries.definition: sharp and stinging to the senses.
to make a tiny hole with a point.
to make a hole or holes through a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 在表面打出一个或多个孔。

entries.definition: to thrust a knife or point into something.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a nail, a small hole and a slow hiss.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一枚钉子、一个小孔、一丝慢漏气声」的画面。

normal.en: Puncture contains punct, the Latin point: a point does the work.
normal.cn: puncture 里有 punct（拉丁语的「点」）：干活的是那个尖点。

normal.en: Picture a nail lying on the road, waiting for one tyre.
normal.cn: 想象一枚钉子躺在路上，等着某条轮胎。

normal.en: The stress is on PUNCT; the second syllable is light.
normal.cn: 重音在 PUNCT，第二个音节很轻。

normal.en: The word ends like capture: something is taken out of the tyre.
normal.cn: 词尾像 capture：有东西从轮胎里被拿走了。

normal.en: A puncture is small, quiet and complete: that is why it works as a metaphor.
normal.cn: puncture 小、静、彻底：所以它能当比喻。

abstract.en: A puncture defeats size: a pin can ruin a tyre it could never move.
abstract.cn: puncture 击败体量：一根针能毁掉它根本推不动的轮胎。

abstract.en: The figurative sense always keeps the hiss: something solid loses pressure.
abstract.cn: 比喻义始终保留那声嘶响：坚固的东西失去了压力。

abstract.en: To puncture a claim is to leave it intact in appearance and empty in fact.
abstract.cn: 戳破一个说法，就是让它外形完好、内容空空。

examples.en: A nail had punctured the back tyre, and the air was gone in half a minute.
examples.cn: 一枚钉子扎穿了后胎，气在半分钟里就漏光了。

examples.en: One careful study punctured the myth that the market always corrects itself.
examples.cn: 一项严谨的研究戳破了市场总会自我修正的神话。

examples.en: The doctor cleaned the puncture wound before it could infect.
examples.cn: 医生在感染之前清洗了那处刺伤。

dict_mnemonic.text: punct（点）+ ure：尖点一扎，留下一个小孔。

root: 拉丁语 pungere（刺）的分词 punctus + 名词后缀 -ura

sensesIntro.en: Four senses keep one small hole: the act of pricking, the hole and the flat tyre it leaves, a wound in the body, and a claim deflated until it no longer holds air.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项围绕同一个小孔：扎孔的动作、孔本身与它造成的瘪胎、身体上的刺伤，以及被放到再也存不住气的说法。

core.en: A NAIL AND A HISSING TYRE
core.cn: 一枚钉子和一条嘶嘶漏气的轮胎

branches.en: The act of pricking and the hole it leaves.
branches.cn: 扎孔的动作与它留下的孔。

branches.en: A tyre that fails because of one narrow opening.
branches.cn: 因一个窄孔而报废的轮胎。

branches.en: Skin and flesh entered by a point.
branches.cn: 被尖点刺入的皮肤与肌肉。

branches.en: The same gesture aimed at a claim or a confidence.
branches.cn: 同一个动作指向说法或信心。

branches.en: The metaphor of a surface losing its air.
branches.cn: 表面失去气的比喻。

intro.en: The punct family is wide: puncture, punctual, punctuation and punctilious all come from the idea of a point that marks or divides.
intro.cn: punct 词族很宽：puncture、punctual、punctuation、punctilious 都来自「一个点用来标记或划分」的意思。

latinIntro.en: Latin pungere gives the verb, punctus the participle and punctura the noun; English kept the point in every member of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pungere 提供动词，punctus 提供分词，punctura 提供名词；英语在这一族的每个成员里都保留了那个「点」。

items.meaning: a prick made by a point
exact to the point of time
sharp and stinging to the senses

definition_zh: 惩罚性的；处罚的；苛刻的
definition_en: intended to punish, often by being deliberately harsh
core_image: 一张罚单金额大到足以压垮一家小厂
scene: 监管机构开出一张惩罚性罚单，金额足以让小厂关门。The regulator imposed a punitive fine that would have closed a smaller plant.
sceneCN: 这里 punitive 指惩罚性的（第 1 个义项：惩罚性罚款）；句意为监管机构开出一张惩罚性罚单，金额足以让小厂关门。

pos.zh: 惩罚性的；处罚的；苛刻的

senses.title: A punitive fine
senses.definition: a penalty set high in order to hurt rather than merely to compensate
senses.definitionCN: 定得很高、目的在造成痛感而不只是补偿的罚款
senses.example: The regulator imposed a punitive fine that would have closed a smaller plant.
senses.exampleCN: 监管机构开出一张惩罚性罚单，金额足以让小厂关门。
senses.why: The adjective states the purpose of the money: it is meant to be felt, not merely repaid.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词说的是这笔钱的目的：它要被感受到，而不只是被偿还。

senses.title: Punitive damages
senses.definition: extra money awarded by a court to punish conduct worse than mere negligence
senses.definitionCN: 法院为惩罚比单纯过失更恶劣的行为而额外判给的钱
senses.example: The jury added punitive damages because the company had known the risk.
senses.exampleCN: 陪审团加判惩罚性赔偿，因为公司早就知道风险。
senses.why: This is the legal sense, where a court separates punishment from compensation and names the extra sum.
senses.whyCN: 这是法律义项：法院在这里把惩罚与补偿分开，并为多出的那笔钱命名。

senses.title: Punitive tariffs
senses.definition: duties raised to penalise another country's exports
senses.definitionCN: 为惩罚他国出口而提高的关税
senses.example: The punitive tariffs raised the price of imported steel overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 惩罚性关税一夜之间抬高了进口钢材的价格。
senses.why: Trade policy borrows the adjective when a duty aims at a foreign government rather than at revenue.
senses.whyCN: 当一项关税针对外国政府而不是针对财政收入时，贸易政策就借用了这个形容词。

senses.title: A punitive expedition
senses.definition: a military campaign sent to punish a population or group
senses.definitionCN: 为惩罚某个群体而派出的军事行动
senses.example: History books still argue about that punitive expedition.
senses.exampleCN: 历史书至今仍在争论那次惩罚性远征。
senses.why: The oldest use sends armed force where a fine cannot reach, and the word keeps that severity.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的用法派出军队，去罚单够不到的地方，这个词也一直保留着那份严厉。

intro.en: Punitive descends from Latin poena, 'penalty', through the verb punire, 'to punish'.
intro.cn: punitive 源自拉丁语 poena（惩罚），经动词 punire（处罚）而来。

items.en: Poena first meant compensation paid for a wrong.
items.cn: poena 最初指为过错支付的补偿。

items.en: The verb punire meant to punish or to exact a penalty.
items.cn: 动词 punire 意为处罚或索取惩罚。

items.en: Late Latin punitivus described what serves to punish.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 punitivus 描述用来惩罚的东西。

items.en: French carried the legal adjective into wider use.
items.cn: 法语把这个法律形容词带进了更广的用法。

items.en: English law fixed punitive damages as a separate category.
items.cn: 英国法把惩罚性赔偿固定为一个独立类别。

note.en: The look-alike group is the pun- family; the near-meaning group separates penal, retributive, disciplinary and corrective.
note.cn: 形近组是 pun 词族；近义组把「刑罚的」「报复的」「纪律的」「纠正的」分开。

entries.definition: liable to be punished by law.
a penalty imposed for an offence.
serving to punish, a rarer synonym.
entries.definitionCN: 用于惩罚的，较罕见的同义词。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a fine that is meant to hurt.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一张故意让人痛的罚单」的画面。

normal.en: Punitive carries poena, Latin for penalty: the word is penalty-shaped.
normal.cn: punitive 里藏着 poena（拉丁语的惩罚）：这个词就是惩罚的形状。

normal.en: Picture a fine so large that the receipt itself looks like a verdict.
normal.cn: 想象一张罚单大到收据本身就像判决书。

normal.en: Say PYOO-ni-tiv; the first syllable sounds like pew, a hard bench.
normal.cn: 读 PYOO-ni-tiv，第一音节像 pew，一条硬板凳。

normal.en: The word ends like positive, but it points the other way.
normal.cn: 词尾像 positive，方向却完全相反。

normal.en: Ask: is this money meant to repair, or meant to hurt?
normal.cn: 问一句：这笔钱是为了修复，还是为了让人痛？

abstract.en: A punitive measure works by example: the pain is addressed to one and read by many.
abstract.cn: 惩罚性措施靠示范生效：痛落在一个人身上，被许多人读到。

abstract.en: The word describes intent before amount; a small fine can still be punitive.
abstract.cn: 这个词先描述意图，再描述数额；小额罚款也可以是惩罚性的。

abstract.en: Law uses punitive to mark the line where compensation ends and warning begins.
abstract.cn: 法律用 punitive 标出补偿结束、警告开始的那条线。

examples.en: The regulator imposed a punitive fine that would have closed a smaller plant.
examples.cn: 监管机构开出一张惩罚性罚单，金额足以让小厂关门。

examples.en: The jury added punitive damages because the company had known the risk.
examples.cn: 陪审团加判惩罚性赔偿，因为公司早就知道风险。

examples.en: A corrective fee teaches; a punitive fee warns everyone else.
examples.cn: 纠正性收费教导本人，惩罚性收费警告旁人。

dict_mnemonic.text: pun（罚）+ itive（形容词）→ 用来罚的、带惩罚性的。

root: 拉丁语 poena（惩罚）→ punire（处罚）→ punitivus（惩罚性的）

sensesIntro.en: The four senses all ask what the penalty is for: an ordinary fine, a legal award, a duty on foreign trade, and an armed campaign.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项都在问这项处罚是为了什么：一般罚款、法律赔偿、对外关税，以及一次武装行动。

core.en: A FINE MEANT TO HURT
core.cn: 一张意在让人痛的罚单

branches.en: Money used as a blow in ordinary and legal settings.
branches.cn: 日常与法律场合里被当作打击使用的钱。

branches.en: A duty aimed at another country's trade.
branches.cn: 针对他国贸易的关税。

branches.en: A penalty deliberately set beyond compensation.
branches.cn: 刻意超出补偿额度的处罚。

branches.en: Armed force sent where money cannot reach.
branches.cn: 派往金钱够不到之处的武力。

branches.en: Two extreme forms of official punishment.
branches.cn: 官方惩罚的两种极端形式。

intro.en: The pun- family runs from punish and punishment to punitive and impunity, all built on the Latin word for penalty.
intro.cn: pun 词族从 punish、punishment 延伸到 punitive、impunity，全都建立在拉丁语的「惩罚」一词上。

latinIntro.en: Poena gives the noun, punire the verb and punitivus the adjective; impunity adds a negative prefix to the same root.
latinIntro.cn: poena 提供名词，punire 提供动词，punitivus 提供形容词；impunity 则在同一个词根上加否定前缀。

items.exampleCN: 这笔费用高得带有惩罚性。
批评者质疑它的惩罚性。

definition_zh: 纯语主义的；过分讲究语言纯正的；拘守正统的
definition_en: insisting on strict purity, especially in language or style
core_image: 一位编辑把口语逐字改回书面语，不肯让步
scene: 编辑一遍遍把口语改回书面语，这种纯语主义的坚持让稿子失去了活气。The editor kept restoring the formal phrasing, a puristic refusal to accept how people actually spoke.
sceneCN: 这里 puristic 指纯语主义的（第 1 个义项：语言纯化）；句意为编辑一遍遍把口语改回书面语，这种坚持让稿子失去了活气。

pos.zh: 纯语主义的；过分讲究纯正的

senses.title: Puristic language
senses.definition: insisting that a language has one correct form and should be kept free of foreign or colloquial elements
senses.definitionCN: 坚持一种语言只有一种正确形式，并应剔除外来成分与口语成分
senses.example: The editor kept restoring the formal phrasing, a puristic refusal to accept how people actually spoke.
senses.exampleCN: 编辑一遍遍把口语改回书面语，这是纯语主义地拒绝接受人们实际的说法。
senses.why: The target here is usage: the word judges an attitude to how a language is spoken, not just to its grammar.
senses.whyCN: 这里针对的是用法：这个词评判的是对「语言怎么说」的态度，而不只是语法。

senses.title: Puristic style
senses.definition: demanding an art or design stripped of mixed influences and ornament
senses.definitionCN: 要求艺术或设计剔除混合影响与装饰
senses.example: The building's puristic lines allowed no ornament at all.
senses.exampleCN: 这座建筑的纯语主义线条不允许任何装饰。
senses.why: Architecture and music borrow the word when purity becomes a programme rather than a preference.
senses.whyCN: 当纯粹变成一种纲领而不是一种偏好时，建筑与音乐就借用这个词。

senses.title: Puristic as a label
senses.definition: a critical label for someone who values correctness above communication
senses.definitionCN: 用来批评那些把正确性看得比沟通更重的人的标签
senses.example: Calling him puristic was a polite way of saying he was impossible to work with.
senses.exampleCN: 说他纯语主义，是礼貌地说他没法共事。
senses.why: In ordinary speech the adjective is usually a criticism in disguise, aimed at a person rather than a rule.
senses.whyCN: 在日常言语里，这个形容词通常是伪装起来的批评，指向人而不是规则。

intro.en: Puristic joins Latin purus, 'pure', to the English suffix -istic; the word is purity turned into a policy.
intro.cn: puristic 把拉丁语 purus（纯净）与英语后缀 -istic 结合；这个词是被变成政策的「纯粹」。

items.en: Purus meant clean, unmixed, free of foreign matter.
items.cn: purus 意为干净、未混杂、没有杂质。

items.en: Old French and English kept the word for what is unmixed.
items.cn: 古法语和英语保留了这个词，指未混杂之物。

items.en: Purism named the wish to keep a language or art unmixed.
items.cn: purism 指让语言或艺术保持不混杂的愿望。

items.en: Nineteenth-century critics applied it to language reform.
items.cn: 十九世纪的批评者把它用于语言改革。

items.en: Today it often accuses someone of valuing purity over use.
items.cn: 今天它常用来指责某人把纯粹看得比使用更重。

note.en: The look-alike group is the pur- family; the near-meaning group separates prescriptive, doctrinaire, fastidious and orthodox.
note.cn: 形近组是 pur 词族；近义组把「规定性的」「教条式的」「苛求的」「正统的」分开。

entries.definition: the doctrine of keeping a form pure.
laying down rules of correct use.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of an editor restoring every comma of a spoken sentence.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「编辑把一句口语的每个逗号都改回书面语」的画面。

normal.en: Puristic carries pure: the word is purity wearing a rulebook.
normal.cn: puristic 里有 pure：这个词是穿着规则手册的纯粹。

normal.en: Picture a manuscript with every contraction crossed out in red.
normal.cn: 想象一份稿子，每个缩略形式都被红笔划掉。

normal.en: Say pyoo-RIS-tik; the middle sounds like wrist, rigid and locked.
normal.cn: 读 pyoo-RIS-tik，中间像 wrist，僵硬而锁死。

normal.en: The ending -istic turns a belief into a manner of acting.
normal.cn: 词尾 -istic 把一种信念变成一种行事方式。

normal.en: Ask: is the rule protecting meaning, or protecting the rule?
normal.cn: 问一句：这条规则是在保护意义，还是在保护规则本身？

abstract.en: Puristic authority rests on the fear that a language will dissolve if it mixes.
abstract.cn: 纯语主义的权威建立在一种恐惧上：语言一混合就会溶解。

abstract.en: The word describes a border guard, not a grammarian.
abstract.cn: 这个词描述的是边检员，不是语法学家。

abstract.en: Every puristic rule is a claim about who owns a language.
abstract.cn: 每条纯语主义规则都是关于谁拥有这门语言的主张。

examples.en: The editor kept restoring the formal phrasing, a puristic refusal to accept how people actually spoke.
examples.cn: 编辑一遍遍把口语改回书面语，这是纯语主义地拒绝接受人们实际的说法。

examples.en: The committee's puristic rejection of loanwords made the manual hard to read.
examples.cn: 委员会对外来词的纯语主义拒绝让手册变得难读。

examples.en: A prescriptive grammar describes the standard; a puristic one guards its borders.
examples.cn: 规定性语法描述标准，纯语主义语法则守卫标准的边界。

dict_mnemonic.text: pure（纯）+ istic（主义化的）→ 把语言纯正当作信条的。

root: 拉丁语 purus（纯净）+ 英语后缀 -istic

sensesIntro.en: The three senses follow one demand for purity through language, through art and design, and through the label applied to a person.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项追着同一个「纯粹」要求：穿过语言，穿过艺术与设计，最后落在贴到人身上的那个标签。

core.en: AN EDITOR WITH A RED PEN

branches.en: A language kept free of foreign and colloquial forms.
branches.cn: 被排除外来与口语形式的语言。

branches.en: The same demand moved into art and design.
branches.cn: 同一个要求被搬进艺术与设计。

branches.en: Purity turned into a programme rather than a taste.
branches.cn: 变成纲领而不是品味的纯粹。

branches.en: The word used as a reproach against a person.
branches.cn: 被用作对人的责难的这个词。

branches.en: A rule defended for its purity, and the person who defends it.
branches.cn: 被以纯粹之名捍卫的规则，以及捍卫它的人。

intro.en: The pur- family covers purity, purify, pure, purist and purism; puristic is the adjective that makes the demand sound like a method.
intro.cn: pur 词族包括 purity、purify、pure、purist、purism；puristic 是让这项要求听起来像方法的形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin purus gives the root, -itas makes purity and -ificare makes purify; -istic adds the tone of doctrine.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 purus 提供词根，-itas 造出 purity，-ificare 造出 purify；-istic 加上教义的腔调。

items.exampleCN: 一个严格的纯语主义者。

definition_zh: 供应（货物）；提供（信息、观点）；传播
definition_en: to supply goods or, more often figuratively, to spread ideas and information
core_image: 一家小店每天清晨把刚出炉的面包摆上木架
scene: 小镇上只有一家店供应新鲜面包，每天清晨六点开门。Only one shop in town purveyed fresh bread, opening at six each morning.
sceneCN: 这里 purvey 指供应（第 1 个义项：供应货物）；句意为小镇上只有一家店供应新鲜面包，每天清晨六点开门。

pos.zh: 供应；提供；传播

senses.title: To purvey goods
senses.definition: to supply goods, especially food, as a regular business
senses.definitionCN: 尤指食物，作为一项固定生意来供应货物
senses.example: Only one shop in town purveyed fresh bread, opening at six each morning.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上只有一家店供应新鲜面包，每天清晨六点开门。
senses.why: The oldest sense is commercial: a supplier keeps a stock and serves customers from it.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是商业性的：供应者维持一份存货，并从中服务顾客。

senses.title: To purvey information
senses.definition: to supply or circulate ideas, information or rumours to an audience
senses.definitionCN: 向受众提供或传播观点、信息或谣言
senses.example: Anonymous accounts purveyed rumours faster than the paper could deny them.
senses.exampleCN: 匿名账号散布谣言的速度比报纸辟谣还快。
senses.why: The object changes from bread to beliefs, but the direction of flow is the same: out to a public.
senses.whyCN: 对象从面包变成信念，流向却一样：向公众送出。

senses.title: Purveyance for the crown
senses.definition: the historical right to buy provisions for the king at prices fixed by the crown
senses.definitionCN: 历史上按王室定价为国王采购物资的特权
senses.example: The sheriffs purveyed grain for the royal army at prices the crown itself set.
senses.exampleCN: 郡守按王室自己定的价格，为王家军队征购谷物。
senses.why: This legal sense names compulsory supply, and it is the sense that gave purveyance its unpopular name.
senses.whyCN: 这个法律义项指强制性的供应，也正是它让 purveyance 这个名字招人反感。

intro.en: Purvey and provide are doublets: both come from Latin providere, 'to see ahead', by two different routes through French.
intro.cn: purvey 与 provide 是同源双式词：都来自拉丁语 providere（预先看见），只是经法语走了两条不同的路。

items.en: Providere meant to foresee and so to make provision.
items.cn: providere 意为预先看见，因而预先准备。

items.en: Old French porveoir carried the sense of preparing supplies.
items.cn: 古法语 porveoir 带有准备供应的意思。

items.en: English purvey kept the supplying side of the verb.
items.cn: 英语 purvey 保留了动词「供应」的一面。

items.en: The learned form provide kept the foreseeing side.
items.cn: 学者形的 provide 保留了「预见」的一面。

items.en: Today purvey is mostly formal and often figurative.
items.cn: 今天 purvey 多为正式用法，且常用作比喻。

note.en: The look-alike group is the -vey family; the near-meaning group separates supply, provide, furnish and peddle.
note.cn: 形近组是 -vey 词族；近义组把「供应」「提供」「配备」「兜售」分开。

entries.definition: to look over or measure an area.
the range of what is covered.
one who supplies goods or ideas.
to equip or supply with something.
to sell or spread goods door to door.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a small shop setting out bread before dawn.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「天没亮小店就把面包摆上架」的画面。

normal.en: Purvey looks like provide with a different road: same origin, different job.
normal.cn: purvey 像走了另一条路的 provide：同源，分工不同。

normal.en: Picture a wooden shelf of loaves, stocked before the town wakes.
normal.cn: 想象一木架面包，在镇子醒来前就摆好了。

normal.en: Say per-VAY; the stress lands on the end, like a delivery arriving.
normal.cn: 读 per-VAY，重音落在词尾，像货物抵达。

normal.en: The noun purveyor ends like vendor: the person behind the supply.
normal.cn: 名词 purveyor 词尾像 vendor：供应背后的人。

normal.en: Ask: what is being supplied here, bread or beliefs?
normal.cn: 问一句：这里供应的到底是什么，面包还是信念？

abstract.en: Purvey quietly claims that the supply is steady and the channel is real.
abstract.cn: purvey 悄悄主张：供应是稳定的，渠道是真实的。

abstract.en: The word survives because institutions need a formal verb for what flows through them.
abstract.cn: 这个词存活下来，因为机构需要一个正式动词来说流过它们的东西。

abstract.en: A purveyor of ideas is a shop by another name.
abstract.cn: 观点的供应者，不过是换了名字的商店。

examples.en: Only one shop in town purveyed fresh bread, opening at six each morning.
examples.cn: 镇上只有一家店供应新鲜面包，每天清晨六点开门。

examples.en: Anonymous accounts purveyed rumours faster than the paper could deny them.
examples.cn: 匿名账号散布谣言的速度比报纸辟谣还快。

examples.en: A school provides lessons; a shop purveys goods.
examples.cn: 学校提供课程，商店供应货物。

dict_mnemonic.text: pur（向前）+ vey（带）→ 把东西带上前来，就是供应。

root: 拉丁语 providere（预先看见）经古法语 porveoir 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: The three senses follow the supply from bread to beliefs: goods sold over a counter, information and rumours sent to a public, and the old royal right to buy provisions by force.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项跟着供应从面包走到信念：柜台后面卖出的货物、送给公众的信息与谣言，以及旧日王室强制征购物资的特权。

core.en: A SHELF STOCKED BEFORE DAWN

branches.en: Bread and other goods kept in stock.
branches.cn: 备有存货的面包与其他货物。

branches.en: Facts and beliefs moved like stock.
branches.cn: 像存货一样被搬运的事实与信念。

branches.en: One verb for goods and for ideas.
branches.cn: 一个动词兼指货物与观念。

branches.en: Compulsory supply claimed as a right.
branches.cn: 被当成权利来主张的强制供应。

branches.en: The royal prerogative and the resentment it caused.
branches.cn: 王室特权与它招来的怨恨。

intro.en: The -vey family includes convey, survey and purvey; purvey is the one that specialises in supply.
intro.cn: -vey 词族包括 convey、survey、purvey；purvey 是专管供应的那一个。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre, 'to see', sits behind provide and purvey; the French route kept the supplying sense, the Latin route kept the foreseeing one.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre（看见）在 provide 与 purvey 背后；法语路线保留了供应义，拉丁路线保留了预见义。

definition_zh: 好说话的人；容易被打败的对手；易如反掌的事
definition_en: someone or something that is easily pushed aside, persuaded or defeated
core_image: 一个人被轻轻一推就退到墙边，从不还手
scene: 每次开会他都答应额外加班，全办公室都知道他最好说话。He agreed to every extra shift, and the whole office knew he was a pushover.
sceneCN: 这里 pushover 指好说话的人（第 1 个义项：好说话的人）；句意为每次开会他都答应额外加班，全办公室都知道他最好说话。

pos.zh: 好说话的人；易被击败者；易如反掌的事

collocations.zh: 谈判中容易让步的一方

senses.title: A person who yields
senses.definition: someone who is easily persuaded, imposed on or defeated
senses.definitionCN: 容易被说服、被占便宜或被打败的人
senses.example: He agreed to every extra shift, and the whole office knew he was a pushover.
senses.exampleCN: 他答应了每一次额外加班，全办公室都知道他最好说话。
senses.why: The image is physical and applies to a person: one light push and there is no resistance.
senses.whyCN: 这个意象是物理性的，用在人身上：轻轻一推，毫无抵抗。

senses.title: An easy task or opponent
senses.definition: something that puts up no resistance, whether a job, an exam or a rival
senses.definitionCN: 无论是差事、考试还是对手，都提不出什么抵抗
senses.example: The exam was a pushover for anyone who had read the book.
senses.exampleCN: 对读过那本书的人来说，这场考试易如反掌。
senses.why: Here the word measures effort rather than character, and the same image serves tasks and rivals alike.
senses.whyCN: 这里衡量的是费力程度而不是人品，同一个意象既用于任务，也用于对手。

intro.en: Pushover is a late American compound of push and over: something that goes over as soon as it is pushed.
intro.cn: pushover 是较晚出现的美国复合词，由 push 与 over 组成：一推就倒的东西。

items.en: Push came into English from Old French poulser, to beat or drive.
items.cn: push 经古法语 poulser（推、驱）进入英语。

items.en: Over supplied the sense of falling across or down.
items.cn: over 提供了「翻过去、倒下」的意思。

items.en: The compound appeared in American speech in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 这个复合词在十九世纪出现在美国口语中。

items.en: Sporting pages applied it to teams that offered no resistance.
items.cn: 体育版面用它指毫无抵抗的球队。

items.en: Now it covers people, tasks and deals alike.
items.cn: 如今它同时覆盖人、任务和交易。

note.en: The look-alike group is other push- compounds; the near-meaning group separates doormat, weakling, walkover and easy mark.
note.cn: 形近组是其它 push 复合词；近义组把「门垫式的人」「弱者」「轻易取胜」「容易上当者」分开。

entries.definition: an exercise of raising the body.
a physically or morally weak person.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a person moving back at the first light push.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「轻轻一推，人就退开」的画面。

normal.en: Push plus over: the word is an instruction carried out at once.
normal.cn: push 加 over：这个词就是立刻被执行的一道指令。

normal.en: Picture a chess piece that falls before the finger touches it.
normal.cn: 想象一枚棋子，在手指碰到之前就倒了。

normal.en: Say PUSH-oh-ver; the stress sits on the pushing.
normal.cn: 读 PUSH-oh-ver，重音落在「推」上。

normal.en: The opposite is no pushover, said with a hard edge.
normal.cn: 反义说法是 no pushover，语气硬得很。

normal.en: Ask who moves: the one pushed, or the one doing the pushing?
normal.cn: 问一句：动的是被推的人，还是推的人？

abstract.en: A pushover is defined by the cost of resisting, not by strength.
abstract.cn: pushover 由抵抗的代价定义，而不是由力量定义。

abstract.en: The word turns kindness into weakness when the speaker wants it to.
abstract.cn: 当说话者需要时，这个词会把善意变成软弱。

abstract.en: Easy tasks and easy opponents share the same metaphor because both refuse to push back.
abstract.cn: 容易的任务与容易的对手共享同一个比喻，因为两者都不回推。

examples.en: He agreed to every extra shift, and the whole office knew he was a pushover.
examples.cn: 他答应了每一次额外加班，全办公室都知道他最好说话。

examples.en: The champion expected a pushover and was almost beaten.
examples.cn: 冠军以为对手不堪一击，结果差点被击败。

examples.en: Once the other side smelled a pushover, the terms only got worse.
examples.cn: 对方一旦嗅到软柿子的味道，条件就越来越差。

dict_mnemonic.text: push（推）+ over（翻倒）→ 一推就倒的人或事。

root: 英语 push（推）+ over（翻过）构成的美国口语复合词

sensesIntro.en: The two senses push the same image through a person who yields at a touch and through a task or rival that offers no resistance.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项把同一个意象推过两种对象：一碰就让步的人，以及毫无抵抗的任务或对手。

core.en: A FIGURE THAT FALLS AT A TOUCH

branches.en: A person who gives way at the first pressure.
branches.cn: 第一次受压就让步的人。

branches.en: The same weakness read as a character flaw.
branches.cn: 被读成品格缺陷的同一种软弱。

branches.en: A task that asks nothing of the person doing it.
branches.cn: 对做事者毫无要求的任务。

branches.en: A rival who does not push back.
branches.cn: 不回推的对手。

branches.en: Yielding and ease of use share one image.
branches.cn: 让步与省力共享同一个意象。

intro.en: Pushover is a compound, not a suffixed word: push supplies the action and over supplies the result.
intro.cn: pushover 是复合词，不是加后缀的词：push 提供动作，over 提供结果。

latinIntro.en: The parts are Germanic and French rather than Latin: push from poulser, over from Old English ofer.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部件分别来自日耳曼语和法语，而非拉丁语：push 来自 poulser，over 来自古英语 ofer。

definition_zh: 黄铁矿；愚人金
definition_en: a yellow metallic mineral that looks like gold but is iron sulphide
core_image: 淘金者捧着闪亮的石头，以为发了财，其实是黄铁矿
scene: 淘金者以为自己发现了金矿，其实那只是黄铁矿。The prospector thought he had struck gold, but the glitter was only pyrite.
sceneCN: 这里 pyrite 指黄铁矿（第 1 个义项：黄铁矿）；句意为淘金者以为自己发现了金矿，其实那只是黄铁矿。

pos.zh: 黄铁矿；愚人金

senses.title: The mineral
senses.definition: a hard yellow mineral made of iron and sulphur
senses.definitionCN: 由铁与硫构成的坚硬黄色矿物
senses.example: The prospector thought he had struck gold, but the glitter was only pyrite.
senses.exampleCN: 淘金者以为自己发现了金矿，但那点闪光只是黄铁矿。
senses.why: The first sense is the plain mineralogical one.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是最朴素的矿物学义项。

senses.title: Fool's gold
senses.definition: the popular name for pyrite because it deceives the eye
senses.definitionCN: 因能骗过眼睛而得的俗名
senses.example: Every mining camp has a story about a sack of fool's gold.
senses.exampleCN: 每个矿营都有一个关于一袋愚人金的故事。
senses.why: The nickname carries the disappointment inside it.
senses.whyCN: 这个绰号把失望装在里面。

senses.title: Its chemistry
senses.definition: iron sulphide, written as FeS2
senses.definitionCN: 硫化铁，写作 FeS2
senses.example: Pyrite is iron sulphide, not an ore of gold.
senses.exampleCN: 黄铁矿是硫化铁，不是金的矿石。
senses.why: The formula is the fact that ends the illusion.
senses.whyCN: 化学式就是终结幻觉的那个事实。

senses.title: Industrial use
senses.definition: a source of sulphur for making sulphuric acid
senses.definitionCN: 制造硫酸的硫来源
senses.example: The plant burned pyrite to produce sulphuric acid.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂焙烧黄铁矿来生产硫酸。
senses.why: Here the worthless-looking stone becomes useful.
senses.whyCN: 在这里，看似无价值的石头变得有用。

senses.title: In collections
senses.definition: a specimen valued for its bright cubic crystals
senses.definitionCN: 因其明亮立方晶体而受重视的标本
senses.example: The museum's pyrite specimen draws more photographers than geologists.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆那块黄铁矿标本吸引的摄影师比地质学家还多。
senses.why: Beauty and value are not the same thing.
senses.whyCN: 美与价值并不是一回事。

senses.title: Against real gold
senses.definition: harder and lighter than gold, and it tarnishes
senses.definitionCN: 比金更硬更轻，而且会失去光泽
senses.example: Real gold bends; pyrite cracks under the same hammer.
senses.exampleCN: 真金会弯，黄铁矿在同一把锤子下会裂。
senses.why: The practical tests are hardness and weight.
senses.whyCN: 实用的检验是硬度与重量。

senses.title: As a metaphor
senses.definition: any showy thing mistaken for something valuable
senses.definitionCN: 被误认为有价值之物的任何浮华东西
senses.example: The scheme had the shine of innovation and the substance of pyrite.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案有创新的光泽，实质却是黄铁矿。
senses.why: The mineral becomes a ready-made image for counterfeit promise.
senses.whyCN: 这种矿物成了现成的「虚假承诺」意象。

senses.title: The name from fire
senses.definition: the Greek name because it sparks when struck
senses.definitionCN: 因敲击时会迸出火花而得希腊名
senses.example: Strike pyrite against steel and you will see why it was named for fire.
senses.exampleCN: 把黄铁矿敲在钢上，你就明白它为何以火得名。
senses.why: The etymology restores the stone's original trick.
senses.whyCN: 词源恢复了这块石头最初的把戏。

intro.en: Pyrite comes from Greek pyr, 'fire', through pyrites lithos, the fire-stone that sparks when struck.
intro.cn: pyrite 经希腊语 pyrites lithos（火石）来自 pyr（火），因为敲击时会迸出火花。

items.en: Pyr was the ordinary Greek word for fire.
items.cn: pyr 是希腊语里普通的「火」字。

items.en: Pyrites lithos meant the stone that strikes fire.
items.cn: pyrites lithos 意为能击出火的石头。

items.en: Latin borrowed pyrites for a hard yellow mineral.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 pyrites，指一种坚硬的黄色矿物。

items.en: English shortened it to pyrite in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪把它缩略为 pyrite。

items.en: Miners added the name fool's gold from experience.
items.cn: 矿工凭经验加上了「愚人金」这个俗称。

note.en: The look-alike group plays on the pyre and pyr- roots; the near-meaning group separates fool's gold from its mineral relatives.
note.cn: 形近组玩的是 pyre 与 pyr 词根；近义组把「愚人金」与它的矿物亲属分开。

entries.definition: the plural and older mineral name.
entries.definitionCN: 复数形式，也是较早的矿物名。

entries.definition: a pile for burning a body.

entries.definitionCN: 任何被误认为金的矿物。
一种相关的硫化铁矿物。

entries.definition: rock from which metal can be extracted.
entries.definitionCN: 可从中提炼金属的岩石。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a glittering stone that cracks under a hammer.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一块闪光石头在锤下裂开」的画面。

normal.en: Pyrite begins with pyr, Greek for fire: strike it and it sparks.
normal.cn: pyrite 以 pyr 开头，希腊语的「火」：敲它就迸火花。

normal.en: Picture a prospector dancing, then a hammer ending the dance.
normal.cn: 想象淘金者先跳舞，然后一把锤子结束这支舞。

normal.en: Say PY-rite; it rhymes with bright, which is exactly the trap.
normal.cn: 读 PY-rite，与 bright 押韵，这正是陷阱所在。

normal.en: The plural pyrites also names a whole family of sulphides.
normal.cn: 复数 pyrites 也指整个硫化物家族。

normal.en: Gold bends, pyrite cracks: remember the hammer, not the shine.
normal.cn: 金会弯，黄铁矿会裂：记住锤子，不要记住光。

abstract.en: Pyrite is a lesson in valuation: the eye is a poor assay office.
abstract.cn: pyrite 是一堂估值课：眼睛是个糟糕的化验室。

abstract.en: The mineral is not a fraud; only the mistake about it is.
abstract.cn: 这种矿物本身不是骗局；骗局只在于对它的误判。

abstract.en: Every boom has its pyrite, and every boom learns the hammer test late.
abstract.cn: 每轮热潮都有自己的黄铁矿，而每轮热潮都太晚才学会锤子检验。

examples.en: The prospector thought he had struck gold, but the glitter was only pyrite.
examples.cn: 淘金者以为自己发现了金矿，但那点闪光只是黄铁矿。

examples.en: Pyrite is iron sulphide, not an ore of gold.
examples.cn: 黄铁矿是硫化铁，不是金的矿石。

examples.en: The scheme had the shine of innovation and the substance of pyrite.
examples.cn: 这个方案有创新的光泽，实质却是黄铁矿。

dict_mnemonic.text: pyr（火）+ ite（矿物后缀）→ 敲击迸火的石头，黄铁矿。

root: 希腊语 pyr（火）+ 矿物后缀 -ite

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses move from the mineral itself to its nickname, chemistry, industry, collections, the test against gold, the metaphor and the fiery name.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从矿物本身走到它的绰号、化学成分、工业、收藏、与真金的检验、比喻，以及那个带火的名字。

core.en: A GLITTER THAT CRACKS

branches.en: The mineral and its formula.
branches.cn: 矿物本身与它的化学式。

branches.en: The nickname and the metaphor it feeds.
branches.cn: 绰号以及它喂养的比喻。

branches.en: Industrial sulphur.
branches.cn: 工业上的硫。

branches.en: Beauty kept in a case.
branches.cn: 被收进陈列柜的美。

branches.en: The hammer test and the name from fire.
branches.cn: 锤子检验与来自火的名字。

intro.en: The pyr- family is about fire: pyrite, pyre, pyrometer and pyrotechnic all carry it.
intro.cn: pyr 词族关乎火：pyrite、pyre、pyrometer、pyrotechnic 都带着它。

latinIntro.en: Greek pyr goes through Latin as pyrites; the mineral suffix -ite was added later by scientific naming.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 pyr 经拉丁语作 pyrites；矿物后缀 -ite 是后来科学命名加上去的。

definition_zh: 象限；四分之一圆；象限仪；四分之一区域
definition_en: one of four parts, especially a quarter of a circle or a section of a graph
core_image: 一个圆被两条线切成四块，其中一块被涂成阴影
scene: 数学课上老师把圆切成四份，让学生在第一个象限里描点。The teacher divided the circle into four and asked the class to plot a point in the first quadrant.
sceneCN: 这里 quadrant 指象限（第 1 个义项：坐标象限）；句意为老师把圆切成四份，让学生在第一个象限里描点。

pos.zh: 象限；四分之一圆；象限仪

derivatives.zh: 古罗马的四分之一阿斯铜币

senses.title: The coordinate quadrant
senses.definition: one of the four regions into which axes divide a plane
senses.definitionCN: 坐标轴把平面分成的四个区域之一
senses.example: The teacher divided the circle into four and asked the class to plot a point in the first quadrant.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把圆切成四份，让学生在第一象限里描点。
senses.why: This is the sense most students meet first.
senses.whyCN: 这是学生最早遇到的义项。

senses.title: A quarter circle
senses.definition: an arc of ninety degrees together with its two radii
senses.definitionCN: 九十度的弧连同两条半径围成的部分
senses.example: The quadrant of the circle was shaded to show a right angle.
senses.exampleCN: 圆的这个四分之一被涂上阴影，用来显示直角。
senses.why: Geometry keeps the shape literal.
senses.whyCN: 几何学让这个形状保持字面意义。

senses.title: A navigational instrument
senses.definition: an old instrument for measuring angles at sea
senses.definitionCN: 在海上测量角度的古老仪器
senses.example: The sailor raised the quadrant to measure the height of the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 水手举起象限仪测量太阳的高度。
senses.why: The instrument is named for its quarter-circle shape.
senses.whyCN: 这件仪器因四分之一圆的形状而得名。

senses.title: An astronomical quadrant
senses.definition: a large quarter-circle used to fix the position of stars
senses.definitionCN: 用来确定恒星位置的大型四分之一圆仪
senses.example: The observatory's stone quadrant was accurate to a fraction of a degree.
senses.exampleCN: 天文台那座石制象限仪精确到不足一度。
senses.why: Here the word names a tool of measurement, not a region.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词命名的是测量工具，不是区域。

senses.title: A quarter of a district
senses.definition: a quarter of a city or a bounded area
senses.definitionCN: 城市或一片区域的四分之一
senses.example: The old market occupied the northeast quadrant of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 老市场占据了小镇的东北角。
senses.why: Space is divided the way a circle is divided.
senses.whyCN: 空间被划分的方式，和圆被划分一样。

senses.title: One quarter of a shield
senses.definition: one of the four divisions of a heraldic shield
senses.definitionCN: 纹章盾面四个分区之一
senses.example: Each quadrant of the shield carried a different family mark.
senses.exampleCN: 盾面的每个四分之一都带着不同的家族标记。
senses.why: Heraldry divides a shield the way geometry divides a circle.
senses.whyCN: 纹章划分盾面的方式，和几何划分圆一样。

senses.title: A dental quadrant
senses.definition: one of the four sections of the upper and lower teeth
senses.definitionCN: 上下牙列分成的四个区域之一
senses.example: The dentist worked on the lower right quadrant only.
senses.exampleCN: 牙医只处理了右下象限。
senses.why: The body is mapped with the same four-part grid.
senses.whyCN: 身体也用同样的四分网格来标定。

senses.title: A narrow corner of experience
senses.definition: a limited part of a larger field seen from one side
senses.definitionCN: 从一侧看到的较大领域中的有限部分
senses.example: The memoir shows only one quadrant of a long marriage.
senses.exampleCN: 这本回忆录只呈现一段漫长婚姻的一角。
senses.why: The metaphor turns the grid into a limit on vision.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把网格变成了视野的界限。

intro.en: Quadrant comes from Latin quadrans, 'a fourth part', built on quattuor, 'four'.
intro.cn: quadrant 来自拉丁语 quadrans（四分之一），词根是 quattuor（四）。

items.en: Quattuor was the ordinary word for four.
items.cn: quattuor 是拉丁语里普通的「四」。

items.en: Quadrans named a fourth part, including a small coin.
items.cn: quadrans 指四分之一，也包括一种小铜币。

items.en: The accusative form passed through French as quadrant.
items.cn: 宾格形式经法语变成 quadrant。

items.en: English used it for a quarter of a circle.
items.cn: 英语用它指圆的四分之一。

items.en: Navigators then named their quarter-circle tools after it.
items.cn: 航海者随后用它的名字称呼自己的四分之一圆工具。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quadr- family; the near-meaning group separates quarter, sector, sextant and octant.
note.cn: 形近组是 quadr 词族；近义组把「四分之一」「扇形」「六分仪」「八分仪」分开。

entries.definition: a slice bounded by two radii.
entries.definitionCN: 由两条半径围成的一块。

entries.definition: an instrument for a sixth of a circle.
entries.definitionCN: 用于六分之一圆的仪器。

entries.definition: an instrument or region of an eighth.
entries.definitionCN: 八分之一圆仪器或区域。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a circle cut into four shaded pieces.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一个圆被切成四块阴影」的画面。

normal.en: Quadrant carries quad, four: the word is a four-part division.
normal.cn: quadrant 里有 quad（四）：这个词就是四分法。

normal.en: Picture a compass rose with one quarter darkened.
normal.cn: 想象一枚罗盘玫瑰，四分之一被涂暗。

normal.en: Say KWAD-runt; the first syllable sounds like quad, a four-wheeled bike.
normal.cn: 读 KWAD-runt，第一音节像 quad，四轮车。

normal.en: The first quadrant is where both coordinates are positive.
normal.cn: 第一象限是两个坐标都为正的地方。

normal.en: An old sailor's quadrant is simply a quarter circle you can hold.
normal.cn: 老水手的象限仪，就是能拿在手里的四分之一圆。

abstract.en: A quadrant limits vision to a quarter while implying the whole.
abstract.cn: 象限把视野限制在四分之一，却暗示着整体。

abstract.en: Every grid is a promise that the world can be divided cleanly.
abstract.cn: 每个网格都是一项承诺：世界能被干净地划分。

abstract.en: The word moves easily from paper to sea to the body because a quarter is always a quarter.
abstract.cn: 这个词从纸面移到海上再移到身体都很容易，因为四分之一永远是四分之一。

examples.en: The teacher divided the circle into four and asked the class to plot a point in the first quadrant.
examples.cn: 老师把圆切成四份，让学生在第一象限里描点。

examples.en: The sailor raised the quadrant to measure the height of the sun.
examples.cn: 水手举起象限仪测量太阳的高度。

examples.en: The memoir shows only one quadrant of a long marriage.
examples.cn: 这本回忆录只呈现一段漫长婚姻的一角。

dict_mnemonic.text: quadr（四）+ ant（物）→ 分成四份中的一份，象限。

root: 拉丁语 quattuor（四）→ quadrans（四分之一）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses divide the same quarter: a graph, a circle, a ship's tool, an observatory, a district, a shield, a jaw and a narrowed view.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项分的是同一个「四分之一」：坐标图、圆、船上的工具、天文台、城区、盾面、牙列，以及被收窄的视野。

core.en: A CIRCLE CUT INTO FOUR

branches.en: Grids on paper and on land.
branches.cn: 纸上的网格与地上的网格。

branches.en: The literal quarter circle.
branches.cn: 字面上的四分之一圆。

branches.en: Tools that measure the sky and sea.
branches.cn: 测量天空与海洋的工具。

branches.en: Shields and jaws divided the same way.
branches.cn: 以同样方式划分的盾面与牙列。

branches.en: A quarter taken for the whole.
branches.cn: 以四分之一代替整体。

intro.en: The quadr- family is built on four: quadrant, quadrangle, quadrilateral and quadruple all count to four.
intro.cn: quadr 词族建立在「四」上：quadrant、quadrangle、quadrilateral、quadruple 都数到四。

latinIntro.en: Latin quattuor gives quadrans; the same root yields quadri-, quadru- and the English combining form quadr-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quattuor 给出 quadrans；同一词根还产出 quadri-、quadru- 以及英语组合形式 quadr-。

definition_zh: 每四年一次的；持续四年的；四周年纪念
definition_en: happening once every four years, or lasting four years
core_image: 日历上每隔四个数字出现一个红色标记
scene: 奥运会每四年举办一次，主办城市往往提前七年就开始准备。The games are quadrennial, and the host city often begins preparing seven years ahead.
sceneCN: 这里 quadrennial 指每四年一次的（第 1 个义项：四年一届）；句意为奥运会每四年举办一次，主办城市往往提前七年就开始准备。

pos.zh: 每四年一次的；四年的
四周年纪念

senses.title: Every four years
senses.definition: taking place once in every four-year interval
senses.definitionCN: 每隔四年发生一次
senses.example: The games are quadrennial, and the host city often begins preparing seven years ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 奥运会每四年举办一次，主办城市往往提前七年就开始准备。
senses.why: The adjective counts recurrence, and the interval is a fixed calendar unit.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词计算重现的频率，而那个间隔是固定的日历单位。

senses.title: A four-year term
senses.definition: lasting for a period of four years
senses.definitionCN: 持续四年的期限
senses.example: The quadrennial term ends with the same ceremony every time.
senses.exampleCN: 这个四年任期每次都随着同一场仪式结束。
senses.why: Here the same four years measure duration rather than interval, which is why terms and plans take the word.
senses.whyCN: 这里的同一个四年衡量的是长度而非间隔，所以任期与计划也用这个词。

senses.title: A quadrennial
senses.definition: the noun for a fourth anniversary or the ceremony marking it
senses.definitionCN: 名词，指第四个周年或为它举行的仪式
senses.example: The town held a quadrennial for its founding, with four candles on the cake.
senses.exampleCN: 小镇为建镇举行四周年纪念，蛋糕上插了四支蜡烛。
senses.why: The noun turns the interval into a date on the calendar rather than a schedule of recurrence.
senses.whyCN: 名词义项把这个间隔变成日历上的一个日子，而不是一份重现的日程。

intro.en: Quadrennial joins Latin quadri-, 'four', to annus, 'year', with the adjective ending -ial.
intro.cn: quadrennial 把拉丁语 quadri-（四）与 annus（年）结合，再加形容词词尾 -ial。

items.en: Quadri- was the combining form of four.
items.cn: quadri- 是「四」的组合形式。

items.en: Annus meant year, the base of annual and anniversary.
items.cn: annus 意为年，是 annual 与 anniversary 的词根。

items.en: A quadrennium was a space of four years.
items.cn: quadrennium 指四年的时段。

items.en: English formed quadrennial for four-year cycles.
items.cn: 英语造出 quadrennial，指四年的周期。

items.en: Elections and games fixed the word in public life.
items.cn: 选举与运动会把这个词固定在公共生活里。

note.en: The look-alike group is other quadr- compounds; the near-meaning group is the -ennial counting family.
note.cn: 形近组是其它 quadr 复合词；近义组是 -ennial 计数家族。

entries.definition: lasting or recurring year after year.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a calendar with a red mark every fourth year.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「日历上每逢第四年出现一个红标记」的画面。

normal.en: Quadrennial holds quadri, four, and annus, year: four years in one word.
normal.cn: quadrennial 里有 quadri（四）和 annus（年）：一个词装四年。

normal.en: Picture a stadium that wakes up only when three years have passed.
normal.cn: 想象一座体育场，只有过了三年才醒来一次。

normal.en: Say kwa-DREN-ee-al; the middle sounds like drain, years draining away.
normal.cn: 读 kwa-DREN-ee-al，中间像 drain，年份在流走。

normal.en: The -ennial ending is a ladder: biennial, triennial, quadrennial.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ennial 是一把梯子：两年、三年、四年。

normal.en: The noun quadrennium names the whole four-year block.
normal.cn: 名词 quadrennium 命名整个四年区块。

abstract.en: A quadrennial rhythm makes patience into an institution.
abstract.cn: 四年的节律把耐心变成一种制度。

abstract.en: The word measures time in blocks large enough to plan and small enough to remember.
abstract.cn: 这个词用足够规划、又足够记住的时间块来衡量。

abstract.en: Naming an interval is a way of agreeing when the next argument happens.
abstract.cn: 命名一个间隔，就是约定下一次争论何时发生。

examples.en: The games are quadrennial, and the host city often begins preparing seven years ahead.
examples.cn: 奥运会每四年举办一次，主办城市往往提前七年就开始准备。

examples.en: The quadrennial review decides which programmes continue.
examples.cn: 四年期审查决定哪些项目继续。

examples.en: A biennial fair comes twice as often as a quadrennial one.
examples.cn: 两年一次的博览会，频率是四年一次的两倍。

dict_mnemonic.text: quadri（四）+ enn（年）+ ial → 每四年一次的。

root: 拉丁语 quadri-（四）+ annus（年）+ 形容词词尾 -ial

sensesIntro.en: The three senses count the same four years as an interval between events, as a length of office, and as a date to be celebrated.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项数的是同一个四年：两次事件之间的间隔、一段任职的长度，以及一个要庆祝的日子。

core.en: A RED MARK EVERY FOURTH YEAR
core.cn: 每逢第四年出现的一道红标记

branches.en: Games and elections that return on a fixed cycle.
branches.cn: 按固定周期回归的运动会与选举。

branches.en: The return read as a rhythm rather than a single event.
branches.cn: 把回归读成节律而不是单个事件。

branches.en: A term whose length is four years.
branches.cn: 长度为四年的任期。

branches.en: A fourth anniversary and its ceremony.
branches.cn: 第四个周年与它的仪式。

branches.en: An interval counted and then dated.
branches.cn: 先被计数、再被定日期的间隔。

intro.en: The -ennial family counts years: annual, biennial, triennial, quadrennial, perennial.
intro.cn: -ennial 词族在数年：annual、biennial、triennial、quadrennial、perennial。

latinIntro.en: Latin annus gives the year; quadri- gives the four; -ial makes the adjective. The noun quadrennium keeps the same pieces.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 annus 给出「年」，quadri- 给出「四」，-ial 造形容词。名词 quadrennium 保留同样的部件。

definition_zh: 可量化的；能用数量表示的；可计量的
definition_en: able to be measured or expressed as a number
core_image: 一团模糊的感受被放上秤，秤盘上出现一个清楚的数字
scene: 评审会上，经理要求把顾客的感受变成能测量的数字。The manager asked the team to turn a vague feeling into something quantifiable.
sceneCN: 这里 quantifiable 指可量化的（第 1 个义项：可量化指标）；句意为评审会上，经理要求把顾客的感受变成能测量的数字。

pos.zh: 可量化的；能用数量表示的；可计量的

senses.title: Expressible as a quantity
senses.definition: capable of being written as an amount, size or rate
senses.definitionCN: 能够写成数量、大小或比率的形式
senses.example: Only part of the damage was quantifiable in money.
senses.exampleCN: 这场损害只有一部分能用金钱衡量。
senses.why: The question here is whether a thing has a numerical form at all, whatever the standard.
senses.whyCN: 这里问的是这件事究竟有没有数字形式，与采用什么标准无关。

senses.title: Reducible to metrics
senses.definition: able to be broken down into a set of tracked figures, often with a warning about what gets counted
senses.definitionCN: 能被拆成一组可追踪数字，常带一层「什么会被计入」的警示
senses.example: Trust is not easily quantifiable, yet funds demand a metric for it.
senses.exampleCN: 信任不易转化为指标，可基金却要求为它设一个指标。
senses.why: This sense carries a criticism: a thing may be squeezed into figures until the figure replaces the thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项带批评：一件事可能被压进数字，直到数字取代了事情本身。

intro.en: Quantifiable joins Latin quantus, 'how much', to the ending -ficare, 'to make', through the verb quantify.
intro.cn: quantifiable 把拉丁语 quantus（多少）与词尾 -ficare（使成为）经动词 quantify 连在一起。

items.en: Quantus asked 'how much' and gave English quantity.
items.cn: quantus 问「多少」，给出了英语的 quantity。

items.en: Scholastic Latin used quantificare for assigning a measure.
items.cn: 经院拉丁语用 quantificare 表示赋予度量。

items.en: English formed quantify from the same stem in the 1600s.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪用同一词干造出 quantify。

items.en: Laboratories made quantifiable the mark of a real result.
items.cn: 实验室让「可量化」成为真实结果的标志。

items.en: Today the word also criticises what can be counted too easily.
items.cn: 今天这个词也用来批评那些太容易被计数的东西。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quant- family; the near-meaning group separates measurable, countable, assessable and computable.
note.cn: 形近组是 quant 词族；近义组把「可测量的」「可计数的」「可评估的」「可计算的」分开。

entries.definition: a word or symbol expressing amount.
possible to count one by one.
possible to judge by a standard.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a vague feeling placed on a scale.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一团模糊的感受被放上秤」的画面。

normal.en: Quantifiable carries quant, how much: the word asks for a number.
normal.cn: quantifiable 里有 quant（多少）：这个词要的是一个数字。

normal.en: Picture a customer's smile being weighed like apples.
normal.cn: 想象顾客的一个微笑被像苹果一样称重。

normal.en: Say KWON-ti-fy-a-bl; the ending sounds like able to be.
normal.cn: 读 KWON-ti-fy-a-bl，词尾听起来就是「能够被」。

normal.en: The word is an adjective of permission: it says a number may be attached.
normal.cn: 这个词是许可性的形容词：它说可以附上一个数字。

normal.en: Ask: can this be counted without losing what it means?
normal.cn: 问一句：这东西能被计数而不丢掉它的意思吗？

abstract.en: Quantifiable is a gate word: it lets a claim enter the world of budgets and reports.
abstract.cn: quantifiable 是一道门：它让一个说法进入预算与报告的世界。

abstract.en: What resists the word is not smaller, only harder to defend in a meeting.
abstract.cn: 抗拒这个词的东西并不更小，只是在会议上更难辩护。

abstract.en: Every metric starts as a choice about what deserves to be counted.
abstract.cn: 每个指标最初都是一个选择：什么值得被计数。

examples.en: Only part of the damage was quantifiable in money.
examples.cn: 这场损害只有一部分能用金钱衡量。

examples.en: The new system delivered a quantifiable gain in delivery speed.
examples.cn: 新系统在交付速度上带来了可量化的收益。

examples.en: Trust is not easily quantifiable, yet funds demand a metric for it.
examples.cn: 信任不易转化为指标，可基金却要求为它设一个指标。

dict_mnemonic.text: quant（多少）+ ify（使）+ able（能）→ 能给出「多少」的。

root: 拉丁语 quantus（多少）+ -ficare（使）

sensesIntro.en: The two senses ask whether a number can be attached: first whether the thing has any numerical form, then what is lost when it is forced into a tracked metric.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都在问能不能附上一个数字：先问这件事有没有数字形式，再问它被压成可追踪指标时丢掉了什么。

core.en: A FEELING PUT ON A SCALE

branches.en: Damage, gains and targets that take a figure.
branches.cn: 能取一个数字的损害、收益与目标。

branches.en: The same thing refused a figure.
branches.cn: 拒绝被赋予数字的同一件事。

branches.en: What survives when a thing is turned into a metric.
branches.cn: 一件事变成指标后还剩下什么。

branches.en: The warning inside the word.
branches.cn: 这个词内部的警告。

branches.en: Permission and pressure in one adjective.
branches.cn: 一个形容词里的许可与压力。

intro.en: The quant- family counts: quantity, quantify, quantitative and quantifier all turn on the Latin question 'how much'.
intro.cn: quant 词族都在计数：quantity、quantify、quantitative、quantifier 都围绕拉丁语的「多少」。

latinIntro.en: Latin quantus supplies the stem, -ficare the verb ending and -abilis the sense of possibility; English rebuilt all three as one adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quantus 提供词干，-ficare 提供动词词尾，-abilis 提供「可能」的意思；英语把三者重组成一个形容词。

items.meaning: able to be given a number

items.exampleCN: every 和 some 都是量词。

definition_zh: 争吵；口角；抱怨；争吵的理由；[古] 方头箭
definition_en: an angry dispute between people, or to argue in an angry way
core_image: 两个人隔着一张小桌，声音越来越高，谁也不肯先闭嘴
scene: 两家人为了院子边上的一棵树吵了起来，声音惊动了整条街。The two families had quarrelled over a tree at the edge of the garden until the whole street heard.
sceneCN: 这里 quarrel 指争吵（第 1 个义项：口角冲突）；句意为两家人为了院子边上的一棵树吵了起来，声音惊动了整条街。

pos.zh: 争吵；口角；抱怨
争吵；抱怨；挑剔

senses.title: A family quarrel
senses.definition: an angry dispute between people, usually over something small
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间激烈的争执，起因往往很小
senses.example: The two families had quarrelled over a tree at the edge of the garden until the whole street heard.
senses.exampleCN: 两家人为了院子边上的一棵树争吵，声音惊动了整条街。
senses.why: The noun names the whole event: two sides, raised voices, a cause that looks small from outside.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词命名整个事件：两方、抬高的声音，以及在外人看来很小的起因。

senses.title: To quarrel
senses.definition: to argue angrily with someone, openly and without trying to hide it
senses.definitionCN: 公开而愤怒地与人争辩，并不试图掩饰
senses.example: They quarrelled in the street while the neighbours watched from their windows.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在街上争吵，邻居们都从窗户里看着。
senses.why: The verb shifts attention from the dispute to the act of conducting it.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词把注意力从争端本身移到进行争端的动作上。

senses.title: A quarrel with a plan
senses.definition: an objection or reason for disagreement, without any scene
senses.definitionCN: 一种反对或不同意的理由，并不伴随闹剧
senses.example: My only quarrel with the plan is the timetable.
senses.exampleCN: 我对这个计划唯一的意见是时间表。
senses.why: Here the word turns quiet: it names a disagreement with a thing or an idea rather than a fight with a person.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词安静下来：它指的是对某件事或某个想法的异议，而不是与人的争斗。

senses.title: A quarrel in the bow
senses.definition: a short square-headed bolt shot from a crossbow
senses.definitionCN: 十字弩射出的短方头箭
senses.example: The museum label reads: a quarrel, once used against armour.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆的标签写着：一支方头箭，曾用来对付盔甲。
senses.why: This is a separate borrowing, a weapon rather than a word spoken, and it survives mostly in archery history.
senses.whyCN: 这是另一个来源的借用，指一件武器而不是一句话，主要存活于射箭史里。

intro.en: Quarrel came into English from Old French querele, which goes back to Latin querela, 'a complaint'.
intro.cn: quarrel 经古法语 querele 进入英语，源头是拉丁语 querela（抱怨）。

items.en: Querela meant a complaint or a lament.
items.cn: querela 意为抱怨或哀诉。

items.en: French kept the legal sound of a formal complaint.
items.cn: 法语保留了正式控告的法律语气。

items.en: English first used quarrel for a complaint in court.
items.cn: 英语最初用 quarrel 指法庭上的控告。

items.en: The sense moved from a filed complaint to a loud dispute.
items.cn: 词义从提交的控告转向高声的争执。

items.en: A separate borrowing named the square-headed bolt.
items.cn: 另一个来源的借用命名了方头箭。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quar- family; the near-meaning group separates argument, dispute, squabble and feud.
note.cn: 形近组是 quar 词族；近义组把「论证」「争端」「拌嘴」「世仇」分开。

entries.definition: a place where stone is cut.

entries.definitionCN: 为阻断疾病而设的隔离。

entries.definition: a disagreement that may be formal.
a long bitter hostility between groups.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of two people at a small table, voices rising.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「两个人在小桌旁，声音越来越大」的画面。

normal.en: Quarrel hides querela, Latin for complaint: every fight starts as one.
normal.cn: quarrel 藏着 querela（拉丁语的抱怨）：每场争吵都从一句抱怨开始。

normal.en: Picture a tree at the edge of a garden and two families on either side.
normal.cn: 想象院子边上一棵树，两边各站一家人。

normal.en: Say KWOR-el; the word sounds blunt, like a door closing.
normal.cn: 读 KWOR-el，这个词听起来很钝，像一扇门关上。

normal.en: Double the l in the British spelling: quarrelled, quarrelling.
normal.cn: 英式拼写要双写 l：quarrelled、quarrelling。

normal.en: A quarrel is loud; a complaint can be silent. The word covers both.
normal.cn: quarrel 是响的，抱怨却可以是无声的；这个词两者都覆盖。

abstract.en: A quarrel is a complaint that has lost its patience.
abstract.cn: 争吵是失去了耐心的抱怨。

abstract.en: The word drifts from law to kitchen: the same form, a colder audience.
abstract.cn: 这个词从法庭漂到厨房：形式相同，听众更冷。

abstract.en: To quarrel with one's lot is to argue with a stone wall and still feel heard.
abstract.cn: 抱怨命运，就是跟一堵石墙争辩，却仍觉得自己被听见了。

examples.en: They quarrelled in the street while the neighbours watched from their windows.
examples.cn: 他们在街上争吵，邻居们都从窗户里看着。

examples.en: My only quarrel with the plan is the timetable.
examples.cn: 我对这个计划唯一的意见是时间表。

examples.en: He never quarrelled with his lot, though it gave him little.
examples.cn: 他从不抱怨自己的命运，尽管它给得很少。

dict_mnemonic.text: quar（抱怨）+ rel：一句抱怨没忍住，就变成一场争吵。

root: 拉丁语 querela（抱怨）→ 古法语 querele → 英语 quarrel

sensesIntro.en: The four senses run from the whole scene of a dispute, through the act of arguing and a quiet objection, to the old crossbow bolt that merely shares the spelling.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项从争执的整个场面，经过争吵的动作与安静的异议，最后到只是共用拼写的古老弩箭。

core.en: TWO VOICES RISING

branches.en: The whole scene of two sides falling out.
branches.cn: 两方失和的整个场面。

branches.en: The dispute and the act of conducting it.
branches.cn: 争端与进行争端的动作。

branches.en: A disagreement with a thing rather than a person.
branches.cn: 针对事情而非针对人的分歧。

branches.en: The old weapon that shares the spelling.
branches.cn: 共用这个拼写的古老武器。

branches.en: A loud fight and a quiet objection, one word.
branches.cn: 高声的争斗与安静的异议，同一个词。

intro.en: The quar- family is small in English but loud: quarrel, quarrelsome and quarreller all keep the sound of a complaint.
intro.cn: quar 词族在英语里不大，却很吵：quarrel、quarrelsome、quarreller 都保留着抱怨的声音。

latinIntro.en: Latin querela gives the noun, querelari the act of complaining; French trimmed the word to querele before English took it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 querela 提供名词，querelari 提供抱怨的动作；法语把它削成 querele，英语才接手。

items.meaning: in the middle of a dispute

items.exampleCN: 一个出了名爱吵架的人。

definition_zh: 四分卫；[喻] 组织者、指挥者；担任四分卫；主导指挥
definition_en: the player who directs a football attack, or to lead and direct an effort
core_image: 球场中央，一个人接了球，所有人都在等他的手势
scene: 暂停时，教练把战术板交给四分卫，让他自己挑下一次进攻。At the timeout the coach handed the board to the quarterback and let him choose the next play.
sceneCN: 这里 quarterback 指四分卫（第 1 个义项：球队的场上指挥）；句意为暂停时，教练把战术板交给四分卫，让他自己挑下一次进攻。

pos.zh: 四分卫；组织者；指挥者
担任四分卫；主导指挥

senses.title: The man behind the centre
senses.definition: the player who receives the snap and starts each play
senses.definitionCN: 接到开球并启动每一档进攻的球员
senses.example: At the timeout the coach handed the board to the quarterback and let him choose the next play.
senses.exampleCN: 暂停时，教练把战术板交给四分卫，让他自己挑下一次进攻。
senses.why: The literal sense is a position, not just a person.
senses.whyCN: 字面义项是一个位置，而不只是一个人。

senses.title: The position itself
senses.definition: the role in a football team that calls the plays
senses.definitionCN: 球队中负责呼叫战术的那个角色
senses.example: The position of quarterback carries more pressure than any other on the field.
senses.exampleCN: 四分卫这个位置承受的压力，比场上任何位置都大。
senses.why: Here the word names a slot in a system rather than a player.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词命名的是体系中的一个格子，而不是某个人。

senses.title: To play the position
senses.definition: to take the role and run the attack from behind the line
senses.definitionCN: 在锋线之后接任该角色并组织进攻
senses.example: He quarterbacked the college team for three seasons.
senses.exampleCN: 他在大学球队担任了三个赛季的四分卫。
senses.why: The verb is plain and technical, with no metaphor yet.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词朴素而技术化，还没有比喻。

senses.title: To lead an effort
senses.definition: to direct a group project the way a quarterback directs a play
senses.definitionCN: 像四分卫指挥一档进攻那样指挥一个团队项目
senses.example: She quarterbacked the merger through its first difficult year.
senses.exampleCN: 她主导了这次并购，撑过了最艰难的第一年。
senses.why: The sporting role becomes a model for any coordinated effort.
senses.whyCN: 运动角色变成了任何协同工作的模型。

senses.title: The field strategist
senses.definition: the person who reads the defence and changes the plan at the last second
senses.definitionCN: 读防守、在最后一秒改变计划的人
senses.example: A good quarterback sees the blitz before the ball is snapped.
senses.exampleCN: 好的四分卫在开球之前就看见了突袭。
senses.why: Strategy is the heart of the metaphor, not throwing.
senses.whyCN: 比喻的核心是策略，而不是投球。

senses.title: A political quarterback
senses.definition: a figure who coordinates a campaign from behind the scenes
senses.definitionCN: 在幕后协调一场竞选活动的人物
senses.example: The campaign's quarterback was never listed on the payroll.
senses.exampleCN: 这场竞选的操盘手从未出现在工资单上。
senses.why: The word migrates easily from sport to politics.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从体育迁移到政治毫不费力。

senses.title: A quarterback controversy
senses.definition: a public dispute over which player should hold the role
senses.definitionCN: 关于该由谁来担任这一角色的公开争执
senses.example: The coach's indecision turned into a full quarterback controversy.
senses.exampleCN: 教练的犹豫演变成了一场完整的四分卫之争。
senses.why: The word can name the drama around the position as well.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能命名围绕这个位置产生的戏码。

senses.title: Versus captain
senses.definition: the tactical caller, as opposed to the general leader
senses.definitionCN: 负责战术呼叫的人，与全面领导者相对
senses.example: A captain may speak for the team; a quarterback must decide for it.
senses.exampleCN: 队长可以为球队发言，四分卫却必须为球队决策。
senses.why: The pair separates voice from decision.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把发声与决策分开。

intro.en: Quarterback is an American football term built from quarter, 'a fourth', and back, 'the rear position'.
intro.cn: quarterback 是美式橄榄球术语，由 quarter（四分之一）与 back（后方位置）组合而成。

items.en: Quarter named a fourth of the field or of the team line.
items.cn: quarter 指球场或阵线的四分之一。

items.en: Back marked a player positioned behind the line.
items.cn: back 标记站在锋线之后的球员。

items.en: Early college rules created the position in the 1880s.
items.cn: 早期大学规则在十九世纪八十年代造出了这个位置。

items.en: Professional football made the role the centre of strategy.
items.cn: 职业橄榄球让这个角色成为战术中心。

items.en: Business and politics borrowed it for anyone who calls the play.
items.cn: 商业与政治借它指任何呼叫战术的人。

note.en: The look-alike group is built on quarter; the near-meaning group separates captain, playmaker, leader and strategist.
note.cn: 形近组建立在 quarter 上；近义组把「队长」「组织核心」「领导者」「战略家」分开。

entries.definition: the central office of an organisation.
a player positioned behind the line.
the official leader of a team.
a player who creates scoring chances.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a player behind the line, calling the play.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一名球员站在锋线之后，呼叫战术」的画面。

normal.en: Quarterback is quarter plus back: a fourth of the line, one step behind.
normal.cn: quarterback 是 quarter 加 back：阵线的四分之一，退后一步。

normal.en: Picture the ball snapped and every head turning to one person.
normal.cn: 想象球被开出，所有脑袋都转向同一个人。

normal.en: Say KWOR-ter-bak; the middle syllable is almost swallowed.
normal.cn: 读 KWOR-ter-bak，中间音节几乎被吞掉。

normal.en: In business, the quarterback is the one who decides, not the one who speaks.
normal.cn: 在商业里，四分卫是决定的人，不是发言的人。

normal.en: The word always implies a line in front and a plan in hand.
normal.cn: 这个词总暗示着身前有一条锋线，手里有一份计划。

abstract.en: A quarterback converts time into choice: seconds become a decision.
abstract.cn: 四分卫把时间变成选择：几秒钟变成一个决定。

abstract.en: The metaphor works because direction is visible: everyone waits for the same hand.
abstract.cn: 这个比喻成立，是因为方向看得见：所有人都在等同一只手。

abstract.en: To quarterback a project is to accept blame before the result is known.
abstract.cn: 主导一个项目，就是在结果未明之前先接下责任。

examples.en: He quarterbacked the college team for three seasons.
examples.cn: 他在大学球队担任了三个赛季的四分卫。

examples.en: She quarterbacked the merger through its first difficult year.
examples.cn: 她主导了这次并购，撑过了最艰难的第一年。

examples.en: A good quarterback sees the blitz before the ball is snapped.
examples.cn: 好的四分卫在开球之前就看见了突袭。

dict_mnemonic.text: quarter（四分之一）+ back（后方）→ 站在锋线后方的指挥者。

root: 英语 quarter（四分之一）+ back（后部位置）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses move from a player and a position to the act of playing, the leading of projects, the reading of a defence, a campaign role and the drama around the job.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从球员与位置，移到担任该位置、主导项目、读防守、竞选角色，以及围绕这个职位的戏码。

core.en: THE HAND THAT CALLS THE PLAY

branches.en: The player and the position.
branches.cn: 球员与位置。

branches.en: The plain act of playing there.
branches.cn: 担任该位置这一朴素动作。

branches.en: Projects and campaigns that need a caller.
branches.cn: 需要呼叫者的项目与竞选。

branches.en: The strategist reading the field.
branches.cn: 读场上的谋士。

branches.en: The drama of the role and the line to captain.
branches.cn: 角色的戏码以及与队长的界线。

intro.en: The word is a compound of two plain English pieces, quarter and back, and the metaphor grows from their position on the field.
intro.cn: 这个词由两个朴素的英语部件组成，quarter 与 back，比喻就从它们在球场上的位置长出来。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root here; the parts are English, though quarter itself goes back to Latin quartarius, a fourth part.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根；两个部件都是英语，不过 quarter 本身可追到拉丁语 quartarius（四分之一）。

items.exampleCN: 他曾担任该俱乐部四分卫。

definition_zh: 四分位数；四分位点；四等份之一
definition_en: one of the three points that divide a set of data into four equal parts
core_image: 一条排好队的数据长队被三刀切成四段，每段人数相同
scene: 统计课上，老师把全班成绩从低到高排好，再在四分之一处画了一道线。The teacher ranked the class scores and drew a line at the first quartile.
sceneCN: 这里 quartile 指四分位数（第 1 个义项：第一个四分位点）；句意为统计课上，老师把全班成绩从低到高排好，再在四分之一处画了一道线。

pos.zh: 四分位数；四分位点；四等份之一

senses.title: The first quartile
senses.definition: the point below which a quarter of the data falls
senses.definitionCN: 四分之一的数据落在其下方的那个点
senses.example: The teacher ranked the class scores and drew a line at the first quartile.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把全班成绩从低到高排好，在第一个四分位数处画了一道线。
senses.why: The sense is a position in a ranked list, not a score.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是排序表中的位置，而不是一个分数。

senses.title: The dividing points
senses.definition: any of the three cuts that split ranked data into four groups
senses.definitionCN: 把排序数据切成四组的任意一个切点
senses.example: Three quartiles are enough to describe the spread of the whole class.
senses.exampleCN: 三个四分位数就足以描述全班的分布范围。
senses.why: The word often appears in the plural for all three cuts.
senses.whyCN: 这个词常用复数指全部三个切点。

senses.title: The upper quartile
senses.definition: the point below which three quarters of the data fall
senses.definitionCN: 四分之三的数据落在其下方的点
senses.example: The upper quartile showed how far the top group pulled ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 上四分位数显示了头部那一组领先了多少。
senses.why: Position matters: the same word with 'upper' names the far cut.
senses.whyCN: 位置很重要：加上 upper，同一个词就指较远的那一刀。

senses.title: A quartile range
senses.definition: the distance between the lower and upper quartiles
senses.definitionCN: 下四分位数与上四分位数之间的距离
senses.example: The quartile range ignored the few extreme scores at both ends.
senses.exampleCN: 四分位距忽略了两端少数极端分数。
senses.why: Statistics uses the word to talk about spread, not average.
senses.whyCN: 统计学用这个词谈离散程度，而不是平均值。

senses.title: To divide into quartiles
senses.definition: to sort a set and cut it into four groups of equal count
senses.definitionCN: 把一组数据排序并切成四组等量
senses.example: The analyst quartiled the survey results before drawing the chart.
senses.exampleCN: 分析师先把调查结果分成四个等份，再画图。
senses.why: The verb sense is rarer but keeps the same four-part image.
senses.whyCN: 动词义项较少见，但保留同样的四分画面。

senses.title: A quartile rank
senses.definition: the group a value belongs to after the cuts are made
senses.definitionCN: 切分之后某个数值所属的那一组
senses.example: Her score put her in the top quartile of applicants.
senses.exampleCN: 她的分数让她落在申请者的最高四分之一组。
senses.why: Here the word names a band, not a boundary.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词命名的是一个区间，而不是边界。

senses.title: A quartile deviation
senses.definition: half the distance between the two outer quartiles
senses.definitionCN: 两个外侧四分位数之间距离的一半
senses.example: The quartile deviation gave a steadier picture than the standard range.
senses.exampleCN: 四分位偏差比全距给出更稳定的图景。
senses.why: The technical sense measures half the middle spread.
senses.whyCN: 这个技术义项量的是中间分布的一半。

senses.title: Versus percentile
senses.definition: a cut into four, as opposed to a cut into a hundred
senses.definitionCN: 切成四份，与切成一百份相对
senses.example: A quartile is a coarse percentile; a percentile is a fine quartile.
senses.exampleCN: 四分位数是粗糙的百分位，百分位是精细的四分位。
senses.why: The pair separates two grids laid over the same ranked data.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词分开铺在同一组排序数据上的两种网格。

intro.en: Quartile joins Latin quartus, 'fourth', with the statistical suffix -ile, modelled on percentile.
intro.cn: quartile 把拉丁语 quartus（第四）与统计学后缀 -ile 结合，仿照 percentile 造出。

items.en: Quartus was the ordinary word for fourth.
items.cn: quartus 是拉丁语里普通的「第四」。

items.en: Quarta pars named a fourth part of a whole.
items.cn: quarta pars 指整体的四分之一。

items.en: Victorian statisticians began cutting ranked data into parts.
items.cn: 维多利亚时代的统计学家开始把排序数据切段。

items.en: The suffix -ile was borrowed from percentile.
items.cn: 后缀 -ile 借自 percentile。

items.en: Quartiles entered textbooks as the simplest spread measure.
items.cn: 四分位数作为最简单的离散度量进入教科书。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quart- family; the near-meaning group separates percentile, median, quintile and decile.
note.cn: 形近组是 quart 词族；近义组把「百分位」「中位数」「五分位」「十分位」分开。

entries.definition: a book size from a folded sheet.
entries.definitionCN: 由纸张四折而成的书型。

entries.definition: one of a hundred cuts in ranked data.
entries.definitionCN: 排序数据的一百个切点之一。

entries.definition: the middle value of ranked data.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a ranked line cut three times into four equal groups.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一条排序长队被切三刀分成四段」的画面。

normal.en: Quartile carries quart, four: the data is cut into four.
normal.cn: quartile 里有 quart（四）：数据被切成四份。

normal.en: Picture a scoreboard sorted low to high and three chalk marks.
normal.cn: 想象一块从低到高排好的记分板，上面有三道粉笔线。

normal.en: Say KWOR-tyle; it rhymes with style and sounds like a label.
normal.cn: 读 KWOR-tyle，和 style 押韵，听起来像一个标签。

normal.en: Three cuts make four groups, so three quartiles describe four bands.
normal.cn: 三刀切出四组，所以三个四分位数描述四个区间。

normal.en: The upper quartile leaves a quarter above it, not below.
normal.cn: 上四分位数上方还留四分之一，不是下方。

abstract.en: A quartile is a promise that a crowd can be described by its edges.
abstract.cn: 四分位数是一项承诺：一群人可以用它的边缘来描述。

abstract.en: Cutting data is a way of making a crowd visible without meeting anyone in it.
abstract.cn: 切分数据，是一种不必见到人群中的任何人就能让这群人可见的方式。

abstract.en: Every cut is a choice: where you draw the line decides who counts as ahead.
abstract.cn: 每一刀都是选择：线画在哪里，决定了谁算领先。

examples.en: Three quartiles are enough to describe the spread of the whole class.
examples.cn: 三个四分位数就足以描述全班的分布范围。

examples.en: Her score put her in the top quartile of applicants.
examples.cn: 她的分数让她落在申请者的最高四分之一组。

examples.en: The quartile range ignored the few extreme scores at both ends.
examples.cn: 四分位距忽略了两端少数极端分数。

dict_mnemonic.text: quart（四）+ ile（统计切点）→ 把数据切成四份的切点。

root: 拉丁语 quartus（第四）+ 统计学后缀 -ile

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses all cut ranked data: the first point, the three cuts, the upper point, the range, the act of dividing, the band, the deviation and the contrast with percentiles.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在切分排序数据：第一个点、三个切点、上切点、间距、切分动作、区间、偏差，以及与百分位的对照。

core.en: A LINE CUT THREE TIMES

branches.en: The outer points that bound the middle.
branches.cn: 界定中间区域的外侧切点。

branches.en: All three cuts taken together.
branches.cn: 三个切点合在一起。

branches.en: Range and deviation as measures of spread.
branches.cn: 作为离散度量的间距与偏差。

branches.en: The act of dividing the set.
branches.cn: 切分这组数据的动作。

branches.en: The band a value falls in, and the finer percentile grid.
branches.cn: 数值所属的区间，以及更细的百分位网格。

intro.en: The quart- family is about fours: quart, quarter, quartile and quarto all divide a whole into a fourth or a four-part shape.
intro.cn: quart 词族都与四有关：quart、quarter、quartile、quarto 都把整体分成四分之一或四种形状。

latinIntro.en: Latin quartus, 'fourth', supplies the stem; the statistical ending -ile was copied from percentile to name a cut in ranked data.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quartus（第四）提供词干；统计学词尾 -ile 仿照 percentile，用来命名排序数据中的切点。

definition_zh: 颤抖的；发颤的；（声音）抖动的；颤音般的
definition_en: shaking slightly, especially of a voice that is unsteady with emotion
core_image: 一句话说到一半，声音像风里的烛火一样抖了一下
scene: 老人念到最后一句悼词时，声音抖得几乎听不清。As he reached the last line of the eulogy, his voice was quavering so much that few could follow it.
sceneCN: 这里 quavering 指颤抖的（第 1 个义项：声音发抖）；句意为老人念到最后一句悼词时，声音抖得几乎听不清。

pos.zh: 颤抖的；发颤的
颤抖；抖动的动作

senses.title: A quavering voice
senses.definition: a voice that shakes because the speaker is close to tears
senses.definitionCN: 因为接近哭泣而抖动的声音
senses.example: As he reached the last line of the eulogy, his voice was quavering so much that few could follow it.
senses.exampleCN: 他念到最后一句悼词时，声音抖得几乎没人听得清。
senses.why: The first sense ties the word to grief held barely in check.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项把这个词和勉强压住的悲伤绑在一起。

senses.title: Quavering hands
senses.definition: hands that tremble from cold, age or fear
senses.definitionCN: 因寒冷、年老或恐惧而发抖的手
senses.example: Her quavering hands could hardly hold the pen.
senses.exampleCN: 她发抖的手几乎握不住笔。
senses.why: The word spreads from voice to body without losing its shiver.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从声音扩到身体，抖动没有丢。

senses.title: A quavering note
senses.definition: a musical tone that wavers in pitch
senses.definitionCN: 音高来回摇摆的音
senses.example: The violin produced a quavering note that would not settle.
senses.exampleCN: 小提琴发出一个抖动的音，怎么也稳不下来。
senses.why: Music uses the word for controlled instability.
senses.whyCN: 音乐用这个词指受控的不稳定。

senses.title: A quavering light
senses.definition: a light that flickers as if about to go out
senses.definitionCN: 像要熄灭一样忽明忽暗的光
senses.example: A quavering light moved along the corridor.
senses.exampleCN: 一道摇曳的光沿着走廊移动。
senses.why: The image leaves the body and enters the room.
senses.whyCN: 这个意象离开身体，进入房间。

senses.title: Quavering courage
senses.definition: confidence that wavers under pressure
senses.definitionCN: 在压力下摇摆的信心
senses.example: His quavering courage held just long enough to finish the speech.
senses.exampleCN: 他动摇的勇气刚好撑到演讲结束。
senses.why: The word can describe resolve as well as sound.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既能描述声音，也能描述决心。

senses.title: The act of quavering
senses.definition: the physical event of shaking slightly and repeatedly
senses.definitionCN: 轻微而反复抖动的物理过程
senses.example: The quavering lasted only a second before she regained control.
senses.exampleCN: 那阵颤抖只持续了一秒，她就重新控制住了。
senses.why: As a noun the word names the event, not the quality.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时，这个词命名事件，而不是性质。

senses.title: A quavering reply
senses.definition: an answer given in a shaking voice, usually from fear
senses.definitionCN: 通常因恐惧而以发抖的声音给出的回答
senses.example: His quavering reply told the jury more than his words did.
senses.exampleCN: 他发颤的回答，比字面内容向陪审团透露得更多。
senses.why: The sense leans on the listener: a shake is heard as doubt.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项依赖听者：抖动会被听成犹疑。

senses.title: Versus trembling
senses.definition: a wavering sound, as opposed to a shaking body
senses.definitionCN: 摇摆的声音，与抖动的身体相对
senses.example: Trembling is felt in the limbs; quavering is heard in the throat.
senses.exampleCN: trembling 在四肢上被感觉到，quavering 在喉咙里被听见。
senses.why: The pair separates the channel through which fear escapes.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把恐惧逃出的通道分开。

intro.en: Quavering is the participle of quaver, a word probably imitative of a shaking sound.
intro.cn: quavering 是 quaver 的现在分词，而 quaver 很可能是模仿抖动之声的词。

items.en: The verb echoes the sound of a wavering tone.
items.cn: 这个动词模仿了摇摆音调的声响。

items.en: Quaver first named a short note in music.
items.cn: quaver 最初指音乐里的短音符。

items.en: It then described a voice that shakes while singing.
items.cn: 随后它描述唱歌时发抖的声音。

items.en: Romantic writing fixed the link between quavering and feeling.
items.cn: 浪漫主义写作固定了颤抖与情感的关联。

items.en: Today the word mostly signals fear, age or grief.
items.cn: 今天这个词多提示恐惧、年老或悲伤。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quav- family; the near-meaning group separates trembling, shaking, wavering and faltering.
note.cn: 形近组是 quav 词族；近义组把「发抖」「摇晃」「摇摆」「结巴」分开。

entries.definitionCN: 因恐惧或虚弱而发抖的。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a candle flame in wind and a voice that matches it.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「风里的烛火，以及与之相配的嗓音」的画面。

normal.en: Quavering shares its root with quiver: both are small, fast shakes.
normal.cn: quavering 与 quiver 同源：两者都是小而快的抖动。

normal.en: Picture a flame bending but not going out.
normal.cn: 想象一簇火苗弯下去，却没有熄灭。

normal.en: Say KWAY-ver-ing; the first syllable rhymes with wave.
normal.cn: 读 KWAY-ver-ing，第一音节与 wave 押韵。

normal.en: A quavering voice is a voice with a visible edge.
normal.cn: 颤抖的声音，是带着可见边缘的声音。

normal.en: The word usually needs an audience: trembling alone is silent.
normal.cn: 这个词通常需要一个听众：独自发抖是无声的。

abstract.en: Quavering is emotion leaking into sound.
abstract.cn: 颤抖是情绪漏进了声音。

abstract.en: A steady voice can lie; a quavering one rarely hides what it feels.
abstract.cn: 平稳的声音能撒谎，颤抖的声音很少藏得住感受。

abstract.en: The word marks the thin border between control and its loss.
abstract.cn: 这个词标记着控制与失控之间那道薄薄的边界。

examples.en: Her quavering hands could hardly hold the pen.
examples.cn: 她发抖的手几乎握不住笔。

examples.en: The violin produced a quavering note that would not settle.
examples.cn: 小提琴发出一个抖动的音，怎么也稳不下来。

examples.en: His quavering courage held just long enough to finish the speech.
examples.cn: 他动摇的勇气刚好撑到演讲结束。

dict_mnemonic.text: quaver（抖动）+ ing（进行）→ 一直在抖的。

root: 中古英语 quaveren（抖动），可能为拟声词

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses keep one shiver: a voice, hands, a note, a flame, courage, the event itself, an answer and the contrast with a bodily tremble.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项保留同一种抖动：嗓音、双手、音符、火焰、勇气、动作本身、回答，以及与身体颤抖的对照。

core.en: A FLAME THAT WILL NOT SETTLE
core.cn: 一簇安定不下来的火苗

branches.en: Voices that shake and answers heard through them.
branches.cn: 发抖的嗓音，以及透过它被听见的回答。

branches.en: The body joining the sound.
branches.cn: 身体加入这声音。

branches.en: Instability kept inside music.
branches.cn: 被留在音乐里的不稳定。

branches.en: The same wavering moved into light.
branches.cn: 同样的摇摆移进了光里。

branches.en: Resolve, the event itself and the bodily tremble.
branches.cn: 决心、动作本身与身体上的颤抖。

intro.en: The quav- family is small: quaver, quavery and quavering all keep the sense of a tone that will not hold still.
intro.cn: quav 词族很小：quaver、quavery、quavering 都保留「音调稳不住」的意思。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor; the word is English and probably imitative, built from the sound of a shaking note.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语祖先；这个词是英语词，很可能是拟声的，由抖动音符的声响构成。

items.exampleCN: 他话说到一半就迟疑了。

definition_zh: 反胃的；想吐的；令人不安的；易恶心的；晕船的
definition_en: feeling slightly sick, or uneasy in a way that resembles sickness
core_image: 船在浪里轻轻一晃，胃也跟着晃了一下
scene: 渡轮刚驶出港口，一个孩子就捂着肚子说难受。The ferry had barely left the harbour when one child turned queasy and asked to sit down.
sceneCN: 这里 queasy 指反胃的（第 1 个义项：身体想吐）；句意为渡轮刚驶出港口，一个孩子就捂着肚子说难受。

pos.zh: 反胃的；想吐的；令人不安的；易恶心的

senses.title: A queasy stomach
senses.definition: a stomach that feels close to vomiting
senses.definitionCN: 感觉快要吐出来的胃
senses.example: The ferry had barely left the harbour when one child turned queasy and asked to sit down.
senses.exampleCN: 渡轮刚驶出港口，一个孩子就捂着肚子说难受，要求坐下。
senses.why: The first sense is bodily and mild: not yet sick, but close.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是身体上的、轻微的：还没吐，但很近了。

senses.title: Queasy on a boat
senses.definition: sick from the motion of a boat, car or plane
senses.definitionCN: 因船、车或飞机的晃动而难受
senses.example: The crossing left half the passengers queasy for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这段航程让一半乘客难受了好几个小时。
senses.why: Motion is the usual cause, and the word keeps the sway in it.
senses.whyCN: 晃动是常见原因，这个词也保留着那种摇摆。

senses.title: A queasy feeling about a plan
senses.definition: a vague unease that the body registers before the mind explains
senses.definitionCN: 身体先感到、头脑后解释的一种模糊不安
senses.example: She felt queasy about the timing but could not say why.
senses.exampleCN: 她对时机感到不安，却说不出原因。
senses.why: The stomach becomes a place where doubt is felt.
senses.whyCN: 胃变成了感受怀疑的地方。

senses.title: A queasy smell
senses.definition: a smell that makes the stomach turn
senses.definitionCN: 让胃翻腾的气味
senses.example: A queasy smell came from the drain behind the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房后面的排水口传来一股令人反胃的气味。
senses.why: The adjective can move outward and describe the cause.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词可以向外移，描述造成不适的源头。

senses.title: Queasy about violence
senses.definition: easily upset by scenes that are violent or disgusting
senses.definitionCN: 容易被暴力或恶心的场面弄难受
senses.example: Some viewers are queasy about the film's opening scene.
senses.exampleCN: 有些观众受不了这部电影的开场。
senses.why: Here the word describes a low threshold, not an illness.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词描述的是低容忍度，而不是疾病。

senses.title: A queasy conscience
senses.definition: a moral discomfort that will not settle
senses.definitionCN: 安定不下来的道德不适
senses.example: He felt queasy about signing the report, though it was legal.
senses.exampleCN: 签署那份报告让他良心不安，尽管那合法。
senses.why: The metaphor lends the word to ethics.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把这个词借给了伦理。

senses.title: Queasy colours
senses.definition: colours that are jarring to look at
senses.definitionCN: 看起来让人不舒服的颜色
senses.example: The lobby was painted in a queasy shade of green.
senses.exampleCN: 大堂刷成了一种让人不舒服的绿色。
senses.why: The sense extends to the eye what began in the stomach.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把起于胃的感觉扩到眼睛。

senses.title: Versus nauseous
senses.definition: slightly sick and uneasy, as opposed to fully nauseated
senses.definitionCN: 轻微难受且不安，与完全恶心相对
senses.example: Queasy is the warning; nauseous is the event.
senses.exampleCN: queasy 是警告，nauseous 是事件的到来。
senses.why: The pair separates the approach of sickness from its arrival.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把不舒服的临近与它的到来分开。
