intro.en: Queasy came from Old French coisier, probably influenced by the English word quease, and its deeper origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: queasy 来自古法语 coisier，可能受英语 quease 影响，更早的来源并不确定。

items.en: Coisier suggested discomfort or unease.
items.cn: coisier 表示不适或不安。

items.en: English used queasy first for a sick stomach.
items.cn: 英语最初用 queasy 指翻腾的胃。

items.en: Sailors spread the word through motion sickness.
items.cn: 水手让这个词随晕船传播开来。

items.en: Writers extended it to moral and social unease.
items.cn: 作家把它扩到道德与社会的不安。

items.en: Today it covers stomach, conscience and colour alike.
items.cn: 今天它同时覆盖胃、良心与颜色。

note.en: The look-alike group is the -easy sound family; the near-meaning group separates nauseous, squeamish, uneasy and seasick.
note.cn: 形近组是 -easy 音族；近义组把「恶心的」「易反胃的」「不安的」「晕船的」分开。

entries.definition: a female monarch or the leading piece.
to put an end to something.

entries.definitionCN: 令人恶心或感到恶心的。

entries.definition: sick from the motion of a ship.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a small boat, a rolling stomach and a colour that will not sit still.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一条小船、翻腾的胃和一种安定不下来的颜色」的画面。

normal.en: Queasy contains easy with a q in front: not easy at all.
normal.cn: queasy 就是 easy 前面加个 q：一点也不 easy。

normal.en: Picture a ferry leaving harbour and one child going pale.
normal.cn: 想象渡轮离港，一个孩子脸色发白。

normal.en: Say KWEE-zee; the word sounds light, the feeling is not.
normal.cn: 读 KWEE-zee，词音很轻，感觉却不轻。

normal.en: The word starts in the stomach and ends in the conscience.
normal.cn: 这个词从胃里出发，最后落在良心上。

normal.en: Queasy is a warning light, not the crash itself.
normal.cn: queasy 是警告灯，不是碰撞本身。

abstract.en: Queasy describes doubt that the body feels before the mind names it.
abstract.cn: queasy 描述的是身体先感到、头脑后命名的怀疑。

abstract.en: A queasy colour is one that makes the eye feel what the stomach feels.
abstract.cn: 让人不舒服的颜色，是让眼睛感到胃里那种感觉的颜色。

abstract.en: The word keeps motion in it: something is still rocking when the feeling arrives.
abstract.cn: 这个词保留着晃动：感觉来的时候，什么东西还在摇。

examples.en: The crossing left half the passengers queasy for hours.
examples.cn: 这段航程让一半乘客难受了好几个小时。

examples.en: She felt queasy about the timing but could not say why.
examples.cn: 她对时机感到不安，却说不出原因。

examples.en: He felt queasy about signing the report, though it was legal.
examples.cn: 签署那份报告让他良心不安，尽管那合法。

dict_mnemonic.text: queasy 形似 easy 加 q：一点都不轻松，胃里翻腾。

root: 古法语 coisier（不适），来源不确定

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses follow one wave: a stomach, a boat, a doubt, a smell, a threshold, a conscience, a colour and the step before full nausea.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一道波浪：胃、船、怀疑、气味、容忍度、良心、颜色，以及完全恶心之前的那一步。

core.en: A STOMACH IN A SMALL BOAT

branches.en: The body at sea and the motion that causes it.
branches.cn: 海上的身体与造成它的晃动。

branches.en: Doubt in the stomach and in the conscience.
branches.cn: 胃里的怀疑与良心上的不安。

branches.en: Smells and colours that carry the feeling outward.
branches.cn: 把这种感觉送到外部的气味与颜色。

branches.en: A low threshold for what disgusts.
branches.cn: 对恶心之物的低容忍度。

branches.en: The warning state before nausea itself.
branches.cn: 恶心本身到来前的警告状态。

intro.en: The word has few relatives in English; queasily and queasiness are the main forms, and quease survives as a rare verb.
intro.cn: 这个词在英语里亲戚很少；queasily 与 queasiness 是主要形式，quease 作为罕见动词仍存在。

latinIntro.en: There is no settled Latin root; the line runs through Old French coisier and is probably linked to ease, the opposite of what the word now means.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有确定的拉丁词根；线索经古法语 coisier，很可能与 ease 有关，而 ease 正是它如今的反义。

definition_zh: 爱抱怨的；嘀嘀咕咕的；带着不满的
definition_en: often complaining in a whining, fretful way
core_image: 一个人对着已经端上来的饭菜，还在挑每一粒盐
scene: 老人几乎每顿都要抱怨汤太咸、椅子太硬、天气太闷。The old man had grown querulous, finding fault with the soup, the chair and the weather in turn.
sceneCN: 这里 querulous 指爱抱怨的（第 1 个义项：习惯性抱怨）；句意为老人几乎每顿都要抱怨汤太咸、椅子太硬、天气太闷。

pos.zh: 爱抱怨的；嘀嘀咕咕的；带着不满的

senses.title: A querulous old man
senses.definition: a person who habitually finds fault in a fretful voice
senses.definitionCN: 习惯性地以烦躁嗓音挑毛病的人
senses.example: The old man had grown querulous, finding fault with the soup, the chair and the weather in turn.
senses.exampleCN: 老人变得爱抱怨，轮流挑剔汤、椅子和天气。
senses.why: The first sense is a settled habit, not a single bad day.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是固定的习性，而不是一天的坏心情。

senses.title: A querulous voice
senses.definition: a tone that is thin, high and full of complaint
senses.definitionCN: 尖细、偏高、满是抱怨的语调
senses.example: Her querulous voice carried down the corridor.
senses.exampleCN: 她抱怨的嗓音沿着走廊传了下来。
senses.why: Sound alone can announce the sense before any words do.
senses.whyCN: 仅凭声音，就能在任何词句之前宣告这个义项。

senses.title: A querulous complaint
senses.definition: a complaint about something too small to deserve one
senses.definitionCN: 为不值得的小事发出的抱怨
senses.example: He offered a querulous complaint about the noise of the kettle.
senses.exampleCN: 他对水壶的声响发了一句嘀咕。
senses.why: The word judges the complaint as disproportionate.
senses.whyCN: 这个词判定这项抱怨与事由不相称。

senses.title: A querulous letter
senses.definition: a written message that lists grievances one after another
senses.definitionCN: 一条接一条列出不满的书面讯息
senses.example: Her querulous letter ran to four pages about a single missing chair.
senses.exampleCN: 她那封牢骚信为了把椅子写了整整四页。
senses.why: Writing keeps the voice, only slower.
senses.whyCN: 书写留住了那种嗓音，只是慢了下来。

senses.title: Querulous about trifles
senses.definition: fretting over details that others would ignore
senses.definitionCN: 为别人会忽略的细节烦躁
senses.example: He was querulous about trifles and silent about the real damage.
senses.exampleCN: 他对琐事牢骚满腹，对真正的损害却沉默。
senses.why: The sense exposes a misplaced attention.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项暴露了注意力放错了地方。

senses.title: A querulous mood
senses.definition: a temporary state in which everything irritates
senses.definitionCN: 一切都令人烦躁的临时状态
senses.example: The heat made the whole queue querulous by noon.
senses.exampleCN: 到了中午，热浪让整条队伍都烦躁起来。
senses.why: The word can describe a mood that will pass.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能描述一种会过去的心境。

senses.title: A querulous question
senses.definition: a question asked less to learn than to accuse
senses.definitionCN: 提问的目的更多是责怪而不是了解
senses.example: Her querulous question about the delay was really a charge.
senses.exampleCN: 她那句关于延误的抱怨式提问，其实是一项指控。
senses.why: The interrogative form hides an accusation.
senses.whyCN: 疑问的形式藏着一项指控。

senses.title: Versus petulant
senses.definition: fretful and complaining, as opposed to childishly sulking
senses.definitionCN: 烦躁抱怨，与孩子气地赌气相对
senses.example: A petulant child slams a door; a querulous one keeps the door open and complains.
senses.exampleCN: 赌气的孩子摔门，爱抱怨的孩子却开着门嘀咕。
senses.why: The pair separates sulking from nagging.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把赌气与唠叨分开。

intro.en: Querulous comes from Latin querulus, 'full of complaints', built on the verb queri, 'to complain'.
intro.cn: querulous 来自拉丁语 querulus（满是抱怨的），词根是动词 queri（抱怨）。

items.en: Queri meant to complain or lament.
items.cn: queri 意为抱怨或哀诉。

items.en: Querulus described a person always ready to complain.
items.cn: querulus 描述随时准备抱怨的人。

items.en: French kept the complaint in querele, the source of quarrel.
items.cn: 法语用 querele 保留这层抱怨，也是 quarrel 的来源。

items.en: English borrowed querulous for a fretful manner.
items.cn: 英语借入 querulous，指烦躁的做派。

items.en: The word now chiefly describes tone and habit.
items.cn: 今天这个词主要描述语调与习性。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quer- family; the near-meaning group separates petulant, peevish, grumbling and cantankerous.
note.cn: 形近组是 quer 词族；近义组把「赌气的」「暴躁的」「咕哝的」「难相处的」分开。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a person finding fault with a meal already served.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「面对已经端上来的饭菜还在挑毛病」的画面。

normal.en: Querulous shares its root with quarrel and complaint.
normal.cn: querulous 与 quarrel、complaint 同根。

normal.en: Picture a spoon lifted, tasted, and pushed away with a sigh.
normal.cn: 想象一把勺子被举起、尝过，又伴着叹息推开。

normal.en: Say KWEH-ru-lus; the middle syllable is light and thin.
normal.cn: 读 KWEH-ru-lus，中间音节又轻又细。

normal.en: The word is about habit, not one complaint.
normal.cn: 这个词讲的是习惯，不是一次抱怨。

normal.en: Ask whether the complaint matches the size of the cause.
normal.cn: 问一句：抱怨与事由的大小相称吗？

abstract.en: Querulous describes a voice that has learned to expect disappointment.
abstract.cn: querulous 描述一种已经学会期待失望的嗓音。

abstract.en: The word judges proportion: it is not the complaint but its smallness of cause that stings.
abstract.cn: 这个词评判比例：刺人的不是抱怨本身，而是它微不足道的缘由。

abstract.en: A querulous habit turns company into an audience for grievance.
abstract.cn: 爱抱怨的习惯，把同伴变成一群听牢骚的观众。

examples.en: Her querulous voice carried down the corridor.
examples.cn: 她抱怨的嗓音沿着走廊传了下来。

examples.en: He was querulous about trifles and silent about the real damage.
examples.cn: 他对琐事牢骚满腹，对真正的损害却沉默。

examples.en: The heat made the whole queue querulous by noon.
examples.cn: 到了中午，热浪让整条队伍都烦躁起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: quer（抱怨）+ ulous（多）→ 抱怨很多的。

root: 拉丁语 queri（抱怨）→ querulus（爱抱怨的）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses circle a single habit: a person, a voice, a complaint, a letter, trifles, a mood, a question and the contrast with a childish sulk.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一种习性：一个人、一副嗓音、一句牢骚、一封信、琐事、心境、提问，以及与孩子气赌气的对照。

core.en: A SPOON PUSHED AWAY

branches.en: A settled habit and a passing mood.
branches.cn: 固定的习性与一时的心境。

branches.en: Tone that complains before words do.
branches.cn: 先于词句抱怨的语调。

branches.en: Complaints out of proportion to their cause.
branches.cn: 与事由不相称的抱怨。

branches.en: The same voice slowed onto paper.
branches.cn: 同样的嗓音被放慢到纸上。

branches.en: Sulking set against nagging.
branches.cn: 赌气与唠叨的对照。

intro.en: The quer- family links complaint and dispute: querulous, quarrel and querulousness all keep the sound of a grievance.
intro.cn: quer 词族把抱怨与争执连在一起：querulous、quarrel、querulousness 都保留着委屈的声音。

latinIntro.en: Latin queri gives the verb, querulus the adjective and querela the noun of complaint; English took the adjective nearly unchanged.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 queri 提供动词，querulus 提供形容词，querela 提供抱怨的名词；英语几乎原样接收了那个形容词。

items.exampleCN: 她的爱抱怨让他们疲惫。

definition_zh: 可疑的；有问题的；未必正确的；品行可疑的
definition_en: open to doubt, or not clearly acceptable
core_image: 一份文件上的签名，墨迹新得像是刚写上去的
scene: 董事会上，有人指出那笔交易的资金来源存在疑点。At the board meeting someone pointed out that the source of the funds was questionable.
sceneCN: 这里 questionable 指可疑的（第 1 个义项：真实性存疑）；句意为董事会上，有人指出那笔交易的资金来源存在疑点。

pos.zh: 可疑的；有问题的；未必正确的；品行可疑的

senses.title: A questionable claim
senses.definition: a statement that may well be false
senses.definitionCN: 很可能不真实的陈述
senses.example: At the board meeting someone pointed out that the source of the funds was questionable.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会上，有人指出那笔交易的资金来源存在疑点。
senses.why: The first sense asks about truth, not morality.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项问的是真假，不是道德。

senses.title: Questionable practices
senses.definition: conduct that may be legal but is hard to defend
senses.definitionCN: 可能合法却难以辩护的行为
senses.example: The auditor listed several questionable practices in the accounts.
senses.exampleCN: 审计师在账目里列出了几项有问题的做法。
senses.why: The word moves from fact to conduct without changing shape.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从事实移到行为，形状不变。

senses.title: A questionable source
senses.definition: an origin that cannot be trusted to be accurate
senses.definitionCN: 不能保证准确的来源
senses.example: The story rested on a single questionable source.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇报道只靠一个来路可疑的消息源。
senses.why: The doubt here is about provenance, not about the reporter.
senses.whyCN: 这里的疑问针对来源，而不是记者本人。

senses.title: Questionable taste
senses.definition: a choice that others find vulgar or ill-judged
senses.definitionCN: 旁人觉得俗气或欠考虑的品味
senses.example: The decoration was not offensive, only questionable.
senses.exampleCN: 这装饰并不冒犯人，只是品味可疑。
senses.why: Here the judgement is aesthetic, not factual.
senses.whyCN: 这里评判的是审美，而不是事实。

senses.title: Open to question
senses.definition: not settled, and therefore fair to challenge
senses.definitionCN: 尚未确定，因此可以正当地质疑
senses.example: Whether the method scales up remains open to question.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方法能否放大，仍然存疑。
senses.why: The sense is procedural: the matter has not been closed.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是程序性的：事情还没有结案。

senses.title: A questionable victory
senses.definition: a success whose value or fairness is in doubt
senses.definitionCN: 价值或公平性存疑的成功
senses.example: It was a questionable victory, won on a technicality.
senses.exampleCN: 这是一场成色可疑的胜利，靠一个技术细节赢下。
senses.why: The result stands, but its worth does not.
senses.whyCN: 结果成立，它的价值却不成立。

senses.title: Questionable character
senses.definition: a person whose honesty has been doubted
senses.definitionCN: 诚实受到怀疑的人
senses.example: The witness was of questionable character and the jury knew it.
senses.exampleCN: 这名证人品行可疑，陪审团也知道。
senses.why: The oldest moral sense attaches to people, not facts.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的道德义项附着在人身上，而不是事实。

senses.title: Versus dubious
senses.definition: raising doubt, as opposed to feeling doubt
senses.definitionCN: 引起怀疑，与心怀怀疑相对
senses.example: A questionable deal makes you dubious about the seller.
senses.exampleCN: 一桩可疑的交易，会让你对卖家心生怀疑。
senses.why: The pair separates the object of doubt from the doubter.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把怀疑的对象与怀疑者分开。

intro.en: Questionable is question plus -able, from Latin quaestio, 'a seeking or inquiry'.
intro.cn: questionable 是 question 加 -able，源头是拉丁语 quaestio（探询、审问）。

items.en: Quaerere meant to seek or ask.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻找或询问。

items.en: Quaestio named an inquiry or a legal examination.
items.cn: quaestio 指调查或法律审问。

items.en: French narrowed the word to a question asked.
items.cn: 法语把词义收窄为被提出的问题。

items.en: English added -able to mean fit to be questioned.
items.cn: 英语加上 -able，表示「可以被质疑的」。

items.en: The word now carries a hint of conduct as well as fact.
items.cn: 今天这个词既指事实，也带上一丝品行的意味。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quest- family; the near-meaning group separates dubious, suspect, debatable and doubtful.
note.cn: 形近组是 quest 词族；近义组把「可疑的」「有嫌疑的」「可争辩的」「不确定的」分开。

entries.definition: the act of taking by force.
believed to be guilty or false.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a signature still wet on an old document.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「旧文件上一个还没干的签名」的画面。

normal.en: Questionable is question plus able: it invites a question.
normal.cn: questionable 是 question 加 able：它在邀请你提问。

normal.en: Picture a fresh signature on a document dated years ago.
normal.cn: 想象一份标着多年前日期的文件上有一个新鲜的签名。

normal.en: Say KWES-chun-a-bl; the middle syllable nearly vanishes.
normal.cn: 读 KWES-chun-a-bl，中间音节几乎消失。

normal.en: The word doubts without accusing: a gap, not a verdict.
normal.cn: 这个词只怀疑不指控：是一道缝，不是判决。

normal.en: Ask what exactly is in doubt: truth, conduct, taste or value?
normal.cn: 问清楚到底疑的是什么：真假、行为、品味还是价值？

abstract.en: Questionable is a polite word for a serious doubt.
abstract.cn: questionable 是对严重怀疑的礼貌说法。

abstract.en: It marks the space between what can be proved and what can be defended.
abstract.cn: 它标记「可证明」与「可辩护」之间的空隙。

abstract.en: The word protects the speaker: it raises a question without yet making a charge.
abstract.cn: 这个词保护说话者：提出问题，却尚未提出指控。

examples.en: The auditor listed several questionable practices in the accounts.
examples.cn: 审计师在账目里列出了几项有问题的做法。

examples.en: The story rested on a single questionable source.
examples.cn: 这篇报道只靠一个来路可疑的消息源。

examples.en: It was a questionable victory, won on a technicality.
examples.cn: 这是一场成色可疑的胜利，靠一个技术细节赢下。

dict_mnemonic.text: question（问题）+ able（能）→ 能被提出问题的，即可疑的。

root: 拉丁语 quaerere（询问）→ quaestio（审问）+ -able

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses ask what is in doubt: a claim, a practice, a source, a taste, an open matter, a victory, a character, and the difference from feeling dubious.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在问疑的是什么：说法、做法、来源、品味、未结之事、胜利、品行，以及与「心怀怀疑」的差别。

core.en: A SIGNATURE STILL WET

branches.en: Truth of a statement and trust in its source.
branches.cn: 陈述的真假与对来源的信任。

branches.en: Conduct and character under quiet suspicion.
branches.cn: 被悄然怀疑的行为与品行。

branches.en: Aesthetic judgement that stays polite.
branches.cn: 保持礼貌的审美判断。

branches.en: Matters left open and successes of unclear value.
branches.cn: 未结之事与价值不明的成功。

branches.en: The object of doubt set against the doubter.
branches.cn: 怀疑的对象与怀疑者的对照。

intro.en: The quest- family runs from question and questionnaire to quest and conquest, all built on the Latin act of seeking.
intro.cn: quest 词族从 question、questionnaire 延伸到 quest、conquest，全都建立在拉丁语「寻找」的动作上。

latinIntro.en: Quaerere gives quaestio the noun and quaestus the search; English added -able to make the modern adjective.
latinIntro.cn: quaerere 给出名词 quaestio 与表示寻找的 quaestus；英语加上 -able 造出现代形容词。

definition_zh: 流沙；[喻] 让人越陷越深的处境；陷阱
definition_en: loose wet sand that swallows what rests on it, or a situation that traps a person
core_image: 一只脚踩上看似结实的地面，地面却开始把脚往下吸
scene: 向导喊住队伍，说那片看着平坦的沙地其实是流沙。The guide stopped the group and warned that the flat stretch ahead was quicksand.
sceneCN: 这里 quicksand 指流沙（第 1 个义项：会下沉的沙地）；句意为向导喊住队伍，说那片看着平坦的沙地其实是流沙。

pos.zh: 流沙；让人越陷越深的处境；陷阱

senses.title: A patch of quicksand
senses.definition: wet sand that yields under weight and pulls things down
senses.definitionCN: 受重压就松动、把东西往下拉的湿沙
senses.example: The guide stopped the group and warned that the flat stretch ahead was quicksand.
senses.exampleCN: 向导喊住队伍，警告前方那片平坦的沙地是流沙。
senses.why: The first sense is geological and concrete.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是地质的、具体的。

senses.title: Sinking in quicksand
senses.definition: the experience of being drawn down faster the more one struggles
senses.definitionCN: 越挣扎被拉得越快的体验
senses.example: The more he struggled, the faster the quicksand took him.
senses.exampleCN: 他越挣扎，流沙把他吞得越快。
senses.why: The image carries a lesson about effort turned against itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个意象带着一条教训：力气反而与自己作对。

senses.title: A moral quicksand
senses.definition: a situation in which each attempt to escape makes the position worse
senses.definitionCN: 每一次脱身的尝试都让处境更糟的局面
senses.example: The committee found itself in moral quicksand over the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会在这份合同上陷入了道德的流沙。
senses.why: The word moves from ground to conscience without losing its pull.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从地面移到良心，吸力没有丢。

senses.title: The quicksand of debt
senses.definition: a financial trap where borrowing to pay debt deepens it
senses.definitionCN: 靠借新债还旧债而越陷越深的财务陷阱
senses.example: Short-term loans became the quicksand of debt.
senses.exampleCN: 短期贷款变成了债务的流沙。
senses.why: Economics uses the image for a self-feeding cycle.
senses.whyCN: 经济学用这个意象指自我喂养的循环。

senses.title: A political quicksand
senses.definition: a controversy that consumes everyone who tries to settle it
senses.definitionCN: 会吞掉每个试图解决它的人的政治争议
senses.example: The minister stepped into political quicksand with one remark.
senses.exampleCN: 部长一句话就踏进了政治流沙。
senses.why: Public life borrows the ground that cannot hold weight.
senses.whyCN: 公共生活借用了这片承不住重量的地面。

senses.title: Quicksand as a trap
senses.definition: any trap that looks like solid ground until it is entered
senses.definitionCN: 任何在踏入之前都像坚实土地的陷阱
senses.example: The offer looked solid, but it was quicksand under a thin crust.
senses.exampleCN: 那个提议看起来坚实，其实薄壳之下就是流沙。
senses.why: The sense abstracts the deception, not the sand.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项抽象的是欺骗，而不是沙。

senses.title: A person who drags others down
senses.definition: someone whose problems pull everyone near them into the same pit
senses.definitionCN: 其问题把身边人都拖进同一个坑的人
senses.example: He was quicksand to every friend who tried to help.
senses.exampleCN: 对每个想帮他的朋友来说，他就是流沙。
senses.why: The metaphor can attach to a person, unusually.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻罕见地可以附着在人身上。

senses.title: Versus swamp
senses.definition: dry-looking sand that swallows, as opposed to open standing water
senses.definitionCN: 看似干燥却会吞人的沙，与敞开的积水相对
senses.example: A swamp is seen before it is entered; quicksand is not.
senses.exampleCN: 沼泽在踏入前就看得见，流沙却看不见。
senses.why: The pair separates the visible bog from the hidden one.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把看得见的泥沼与看不见的分开。

intro.en: Quicksand joins quick, in its old sense 'living or moving', with sand.
intro.cn: quicksand 把 quick（古义为「活的、会动的」）与 sand 组合在一起。

items.en: Quick once meant alive or moving, as in the quick and the dead.
items.cn: quick 古义为活着的、会动的，如 the quick and the dead。

items.en: The compound named sand that moves like a living thing.
items.cn: 这个复合词指像活物一样会动的沙。

items.en: Sailors and mapmakers spread the warning word.
items.cn: 水手与制图者传播了这个警告词。

items.en: Novelists turned the sand into a metaphor for moral traps.
items.cn: 小说家把这种沙变成道德陷阱的比喻。

items.en: Today it names any situation that swallows effort.
items.cn: 今天它命名任何吞没努力的处境。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quick- family; the near-meaning group separates swamp, bog, mire and sinkhole.
note.cn: 形近组是 quick 词族；近义组把「沼泽」「泥炭沼」「泥潭」「天坑」分开。

entries.definition: to make faster or more alive.
soft wet ground of decaying plants.
deep mud that holds the foot.
a hole formed by collapsed ground.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of firm-looking ground that begins to pull a boot down.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「看似结实的地面开始把靴子往下吸」的画面。

normal.en: Quicksand is quick plus sand: sand that moves like something alive.
normal.cn: quicksand 是 quick 加 sand：像活物一样会动的沙。

normal.en: Picture a flat grey stretch that looks easier than the path.
normal.cn: 想象一片平坦的灰色地带，看起来比小路还好走。

normal.en: Say KWIK-sand; the first syllable is short and sharp.
normal.cn: 读 KWIK-sand，第一音节短而利。

normal.en: Struggling makes it worse: the image is about effort turned against itself.
normal.cn: 挣扎会让它更糟：这个意象讲的是力气反噬自己。

normal.en: The word always begins with a surface that lies.
normal.cn: 这个词总以一个说谎的表面开场。

abstract.en: Quicksand is a trap that rewards panic with speed.
abstract.cn: 流沙是一个用速度奖励恐慌的陷阱。

abstract.en: Every metaphor of quicksand is about a system that feeds on the attempt to escape.
abstract.cn: 每个流沙的比喻，都关于一个靠脱身尝试来喂养自己的系统。

abstract.en: The safest move is to spread weight and stop struggling, which is hard advice in any crisis.
abstract.cn: 最安全的做法是摊开重量、停止挣扎，这在任何危机里都是难听的忠告。

examples.en: The more he struggled, the faster the quicksand took him.
examples.cn: 他越挣扎，流沙把他吞得越快。

examples.en: Short-term loans became the quicksand of debt.
examples.cn: 短期贷款变成了债务的流沙。

examples.en: The offer looked solid, but it was quicksand under a thin crust.
examples.cn: 那个提议看起来坚实，其实薄壳之下就是流沙。

dict_mnemonic.text: quick（活的、会动）+ sand（沙）→ 会动的沙，流沙。

root: 英语 quick（古义「活的」）+ sand（沙）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses sink through one image: the sand itself, the sinking, a moral trap, a debt cycle, a political fight, deception, a person and the contrast with a visible swamp.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沉进同一个意象：沙本身、下沉、道德陷阱、债务循环、政治争斗、欺骗、一个人，以及与可见沼泽的对照。

core.en: GROUND THAT PULLS DOWN

branches.en: The sand and the experience of sinking.
branches.cn: 沙本身与下沉的体验。

branches.en: Moral and financial traps that feed themselves.
branches.cn: 自我喂养的道德与财务陷阱。

branches.en: Public controversy as ground that cannot hold.
branches.cn: 作为承不住重量的地面的公共争议。

branches.en: Deception itself and the person who spreads it.
branches.cn: 欺骗本身与传播它的人。

branches.en: The hidden trap set against the visible bog.
branches.cn: 隐藏的陷阱与可见的泥沼相对。

intro.en: The quick- family keeps the old sense of alive or moving: quicksand, quicksilver and quickset all describe something that seems to live.
intro.cn: quick 词族保留「活的、会动的」古义：quicksand、quicksilver、quickset 都描述看似有生命的东西。

latinIntro.en: The parts are plain English; quick goes back to Old English cwic, 'alive', and sand to sand, with no Latin layer in between.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部件都是朴素的英语；quick 可追到古英语 cwic（活着的），sand 就是沙，中间没有拉丁语层。

items.example: The delta is full of quicksands.

definition_zh: 寂静主义者；政治上的消极无为者；寂静主义的
definition_en: a person who seeks inner calm and avoids outward action, especially in religion or politics
core_image: 外面锣鼓喧天，一个人闭着眼坐在角落，什么都不做
scene: 镇上为是否修路吵成一团，只有那位老人始终不表态。In a town split over the new road, the old teacher remained a quietist and refused to take sides.
sceneCN: 这里 quietist 指消极无为者（第 1 个义项：不介入公共事务的人）；句意为镇上为是否修路吵成一团，只有那位老人始终不表态。

pos.zh: 寂静主义者；消极无为者
寂静主义的；消极无为的

senses.title: A religious quietist
senses.definition: a mystic who seeks union with the divine by suppressing all effort
senses.definitionCN: 通过压住一切努力来寻求与神合一的神秘主义者
senses.example: In a town split over the new road, the old teacher remained a quietist and refused to take sides.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上为修路分成两派，这位老教师始终保持不表态，拒绝站队。
senses.why: The first sense is theological: passivity is the method.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是神学的：被动就是方法。

senses.title: A political quietist
senses.definition: a person who avoids political action and trusts inner peace instead
senses.definitionCN: 回避政治行动、转而相信内心平静的人
senses.example: He was a quietist by temperament and never voted.
senses.exampleCN: 他天性消极，从不投票。
senses.why: The word moves from prayer to public life.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从祈祷移到公共生活。

senses.title: Quietist doctrine
senses.definition: the belief that effort and ceremony should be set aside
senses.definitionCN: 认为努力与仪式都应被搁置的主张
senses.example: Quietist doctrine was condemned as dangerously passive.
senses.exampleCN: 寂静主义教义曾被斥为危险的消极。
senses.why: Here the word names a system, not a person.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词命名一套体系，而不是一个人。

senses.title: A quietist attitude
senses.definition: a habit of accepting events rather than trying to change them
senses.definitionCN: 接受事情而不试图改变的习惯
senses.example: Her quietist attitude kept the meeting calm and the problem unsolved.
senses.exampleCN: 她消极的态度让会议保持平静，也让问题原样未解。
senses.why: The sense carries the criticism built into the word.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项带着这个词内置的批评。

senses.title: A quietist in a crisis
senses.definition: one who stays still while others organise and act
senses.definitionCN: 别人在组织行动时保持不动的人
senses.example: In the crisis he proved a quietist, waiting for others to move.
senses.exampleCN: 危机中他证明自己是个旁观者，等着别人行动。
senses.why: The label is applied to behaviour under pressure.
senses.whyCN: 这个标签被用在压力之下的行为上。

senses.title: Quietist calm
senses.definition: a stillness that looks like wisdom and may be avoidance
senses.definitionCN: 看似智慧、也可能是回避的静止
senses.example: His quietist calm irritated the people who had work to do.
senses.exampleCN: 他那份寂静的平静，让真正要干活的人恼火。
senses.why: The adjective softens the noun into a manner.
senses.whyCN: 形容词把名词软化成一种做派。

senses.title: A quietist community
senses.definition: a group that withdraws from worldly affairs on principle
senses.definitionCN: 原则上退出世俗事务的群体
senses.example: The village became a quietist community, known for silence.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子成了一个寂静主义团体，以沉默闻名。
senses.why: The word can describe a whole body of people.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能描述一整群人。

senses.title: Versus activist
senses.definition: one who withdraws, as opposed to one who pushes for change
senses.definitionCN: 退开的人，与推动改变的人相对
senses.example: A quietist waits for the world to settle; an activist tries to settle it.
senses.exampleCN: 寂静主义者等世界平静，行动者则试着让它平静。
senses.why: The pair marks the two ends of a response to injustice.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词标出面对不公的两种回应端点。

intro.en: Quietist comes from Latin quietus, 'at rest', through the religious term quietism.
intro.cn: quietist 源自拉丁语 quietus（静止），经宗教术语 quietism 而来。

items.en: Quietus meant at rest, free from motion.
items.cn: quietus 意为静止、不受搅动。

items.en: Spanish and French mystics practised a passive prayer.
items.cn: 西班牙与法国的神秘主义者实践一种被动的祈祷。

items.en: The movement was named quietism by its critics.
items.cn: 这场运动被批评者命名为 quietism。

items.en: English used quietist for the people and the doctrine.
items.cn: 英语用 quietist 指这批人及其教义。

items.en: The word moved to anyone who avoids public action.
items.cn: 这个词移到任何回避公共行动的人身上。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quiet- family; the near-meaning group separates passive, apathetic, pacifist and recluse.
note.cn: 形近组是 quiet 词族；近义组把「被动的」「冷漠的」「和平主义者」「隐居者」分开。

entries.definition: one who lives apart from others.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a person sitting still while the room argues.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「满屋在争，一个人静坐不动」的画面。

normal.en: Quietist contains quiet: the person believes silence is the answer.
normal.cn: quietist 里有 quiet：这个人相信沉默就是答案。

normal.en: Picture a meeting where one chair stays empty by choice.
normal.cn: 想象一场会议里，有一把椅子是自愿空着的。

normal.en: Say KWAI-e-tist; the ending -ist marks a person or a doctrine.
normal.cn: 读 KWAI-e-tist，词尾 -ist 标记人或主义。

normal.en: The word is usually a criticism when used about politics.
normal.cn: 用在政治上时，这个词通常是批评。

normal.en: Ask whether stillness is wisdom or just avoidance.
normal.cn: 问一句：静止是智慧，还是只是回避？

abstract.en: A quietist turns inner peace into a public position, and that is what makes the word political.
abstract.cn: 寂静主义者把内心平静变成一种公共立场，这正是这个词的政治性所在。

abstract.en: The word marks the border between contemplation and neglect.
abstract.cn: 这个词标记默想与疏忽之间的边界。

abstract.en: Every activist needs a quietist to argue with, if only to test the urgency.
abstract.cn: 每个行动者都需要一个寂静主义者来争辩，哪怕只是为了检验紧迫感。

examples.en: Quietist doctrine was condemned as dangerously passive.
examples.cn: 寂静主义教义曾被斥为危险的消极。

examples.en: Her quietist attitude kept the meeting calm and the problem unsolved.
examples.cn: 她消极的态度让会议保持平静，也让问题原样未解。

examples.en: In the crisis he proved a quietist, waiting for others to move.
examples.cn: 危机中他证明自己是个旁观者，等着别人行动。

dict_mnemonic.text: quiet（安静）+ ist（人）→ 主张安静无为的人。

root: 拉丁语 quietus（静止）+ -ism / -ist

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses follow withdrawal: a mystic, a citizen, a doctrine, an attitude, a crisis, a manner, a community and the contrast with an activist.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着「退开」：神秘主义者、公民、教义、态度、危机、做派、团体，以及与行动者的对照。

core.en: A CHAIR LEFT EMPTY ON PURPOSE
core.cn: 一把被自愿空着的椅子

branches.en: The mystic and the doctrine behind the stillness.
branches.cn: 静坐者与静坐背后的教义。

branches.en: The citizen and the community that withdraw.
branches.cn: 退开的公民与团体。

branches.en: An attitude and a manner that look like calm.
branches.cn: 看似平静的态度与做派。

branches.en: Behaviour under pressure that names the person.
branches.cn: 压力之下给人定名的行为。

branches.en: Withdrawal set against organised action.
branches.cn: 退开与组织行动相对。

intro.en: The quiet- family runs from quiet and quietly to quietism, quietist and quietistic, all resting on the Latin word for rest.
intro.cn: quiet 词族从 quiet、quietly 延伸到 quietism、quietist、quietistic，全都建立在拉丁语的「休息」上。

latinIntro.en: Latin quietus gives the adjective, quies the noun of rest; the religious suffix -ism and -ist turned rest into a doctrine and a person.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quietus 提供形容词，quies 提供「休息」的名词；宗教后缀 -ism 与 -ist 把休息变成教义与人。

definition_zh: 公担（一百公斤）；英担（约一百一十二磅）；[旧] 谷物计量单位
definition_en: a unit of weight equal to a hundred kilograms, or an older hundredweight
core_image: 一只麻袋被吊上磅秤，指针停在一百公斤的刻度
scene: 粮仓的会计在表格上写下一百公斤，旁边标注单位是公担。The granary clerk wrote one hundred kilograms in the column and marked the unit as a quintal.
sceneCN: 这里 quintal 指公担（第 1 个义项：一百公斤的重量单位）；句意为粮仓的会计在表格上写下一百公斤，旁边标注单位是公担。

pos.zh: 公担；英担；谷物计量单位

senses.title: A metric quintal
senses.definition: a hundred kilograms, used in metric trade
senses.definitionCN: 公制贸易中使用的一百公斤
senses.example: The granary clerk wrote one hundred kilograms in the column and marked the unit as a quintal.
senses.exampleCN: 粮仓的会计在表格上写下一百公斤，并在旁边标注单位是公担。
senses.why: The first sense is the modern metric unit.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是现代的公制单位。

senses.title: An imperial quintal
senses.definition: about a hundred and twelve pounds, the old hundredweight
senses.definitionCN: 约一百一十二磅，即旧的英担
senses.example: The old ledger still measured wool by the imperial quintal.
senses.exampleCN: 那本旧账仍以英制英担计量羊毛。
senses.why: The same word covers a slightly heavier unit.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词覆盖了一个稍重的单位。

senses.title: A Spanish quintal
senses.definition: a Spanish unit of about forty-six kilograms
senses.definitionCN: 西班牙约四十六公斤的单位
senses.example: The Spanish quintal was roughly half the metric one.
senses.exampleCN: 西班牙公担大约是公制公担的一半。
senses.why: Local meanings made the word dangerous in trade.
senses.whyCN: 地方性的含义让这个词在贸易中很危险。

senses.title: A Portuguese quintal
senses.definition: a Portuguese unit of about fifty-nine kilograms
senses.definitionCN: 葡萄牙约五十九公斤的单位
senses.example: The Portuguese quintal varied by region until it was fixed.
senses.exampleCN: 葡萄牙公担在固定之前因地区而异。
senses.why: The word records how weights travelled badly.
senses.whyCN: 这个词记录了重量单位怎样在传播中走样。

senses.title: Quintals of grain
senses.definition: a way of counting harvests in bulk
senses.definitionCN: 以整批方式计算收成的方法
senses.example: The mill bought grain by the quintal, not by the sack.
senses.exampleCN: 磨坊按公担买谷物，而不是按麻袋。
senses.why: The plural is the usual commercial form.
senses.whyCN: 复数形式是常见的商业用法。

senses.title: A price per quintal
senses.definition: a quoted price for each hundred kilograms
senses.definitionCN: 每百公斤的报价
senses.example: The price per quintal doubled after the poor harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 歉收之后，每公担的价格翻了一倍。
senses.why: Commodity markets still quote in this unit.
senses.whyCN: 大宗商品市场仍以这个单位报价。

senses.title: A historical weight
senses.definition: one of many old units that preceded the metric system
senses.definitionCN: 公制之前众多旧单位之一
senses.example: Historians convert the quintal before comparing two markets.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家在比较两个市场之前会先换算公担。
senses.why: The sense is about the history of measurement.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项关乎度量衡的历史。

senses.title: Versus hundredweight
senses.definition: the metric hundred kilos, as opposed to the imperial hundred and twelve pounds
senses.definitionCN: 公制的一百公斤，与英制的一百一十二磅相对
senses.example: A quintal is round; a hundredweight is not.
senses.exampleCN: 公担是整数，英担却不是。
senses.why: The pair separates two systems that share a name in part.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把两个部分同名的体系分开。

intro.en: Quintal comes from Latin centenarius, 'of a hundred', through Arabic and Spanish.
intro.cn: quintal 经阿拉伯语与西班牙语，源自拉丁语 centenarius（百的）。

items.en: Centum was the Latin word for a hundred.
items.cn: centum 是拉丁语里的「一百」。

items.en: Arabic qintar named a hundred-pound weight.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 qintar 指百磅重。

items.en: Spanish took the word and fixed a local weight.
items.cn: 西班牙语接收这个词并固定了本地重量。

items.en: English traders imported the unit with the goods.
items.cn: 英语商人随货物把单位一并引入。

items.en: The metric system redefined it as a hundred kilograms.
items.cn: 公制把它重新定义为一百公斤。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quint- family; the near-meaning group separates hundredweight, tonne, bushel and stone.
note.cn: 形近组是 quint 词族；近义组把「英担」「公吨」「蒲式耳」「英石」分开。

entries.definitionCN: 统计上的五个切点之一。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a sack on a scale stopping at a round number.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一只麻袋在磅秤上停在整数刻度」的画面。

normal.en: Quintal hides centum, hundred: it is the hundred-kilo unit.
normal.cn: quintal 藏着 centum（百）：它就是百公斤单位。

normal.en: Picture a grain sack lifted by a hook and a pointer at 100.
normal.cn: 想象一只谷物袋被钩子吊起，指针停在 100。

normal.en: Say KWIN-tl; the last syllable is barely heard.
normal.cn: 读 KWIN-tl，最后一个音节几乎听不见。

normal.en: The same word meant different weights in different countries.
normal.cn: 同一个词在不同国家指不同的重量。

normal.en: It is a trade word: prices are quoted per quintal, not per bag.
normal.cn: 这是个贸易词：报价按公担，而不是按袋。

abstract.en: A quintal is a hundred kilos pretending to be a natural unit.
abstract.cn: 公担是一百公斤在假装成一个自然的单位。

abstract.en: Every unit hides a decision about what to count and for whom.
abstract.cn: 每个单位都藏着一个决定：数什么，为谁数。

abstract.en: The word's history shows how trade smooths differences and then forgets them.
abstract.cn: 这个词的历史显示，贸易抹平差异，然后忘记差异。

examples.en: The mill bought grain by the quintal, not by the sack.
examples.cn: 磨坊按公担买谷物，而不是按麻袋。

examples.en: The price per quintal doubled after the poor harvest.
examples.cn: 歉收之后，每公担的价格翻了一倍。

examples.en: Historians convert the quintal before comparing two markets.
examples.cn: 历史学家在比较两个市场之前会先换算公担。

dict_mnemonic.text: quint（五）音近 centum（百）：一百公斤的一担。

root: 拉丁语 centum（百）→ 阿拉伯语 qintar → 西班牙语 quintal

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses weigh the same unit across systems: metric, imperial, Spanish, Portuguese, grain, price, history and the contrast with hundredweight.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项称量同一个单位在不同体系里的样子：公制、英制、西班牙、葡萄牙、谷物、价格、历史，以及与英担的对照。

core.en: A SACK STOPPING AT ONE HUNDRED

branches.en: The metric and imperial readings of one word.
branches.cn: 同一个词的公制与英制读数。

branches.en: Local weights that made trade uncertain.
branches.cn: 让贸易变得不确定的地方重量。

branches.en: Bulk counting and quoted prices.
branches.cn: 整批计数与报价。

branches.en: The unit as a historical object.
branches.cn: 作为历史对象的单位。

branches.en: A round hundred set against an odd hundredweight.
branches.cn: 整数的一百与零碎的英担相对。

intro.en: The quint- family counts to five in music and statistics, though quintal itself counts to a hundred through an older root.
intro.cn: quint 词族在音乐与统计里数到五，不过 quintal 本身通过更古老的词根数到一百。

latinIntro.en: Centum, 'hundred', became qintar in Arabic and quintal in Spanish; the spelling changed more than the meaning did.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 centum（百）在阿拉伯语变成 qintar，在西班牙语变成 quintal；拼写的变化大过词义的变化。

definition_zh: 五重奏；五重唱；五人一组；五件一套
definition_en: a group of five performers, or a piece written for five
core_image: 五把椅子围成半圆，五个人各自拿着乐器，等着同一个起拍
scene: 小剧场的舞台上摆了五把椅子，五个人准备合奏一支曲子。Five chairs stood on the small stage, and the group was about to play a quintet.
sceneCN: 这里 quintet 指五重奏（第 1 个义项：五人合奏的乐曲）；句意为小剧场的舞台上摆了五把椅子，五个人准备合奏一支曲子。

pos.zh: 五重奏；五重唱；五人一组；五件一套

senses.title: A string quintet
senses.definition: a piece written for five string players
senses.definitionCN: 为五名弦乐手写的作品
senses.example: Five chairs stood on the small stage, and the group was about to play a quintet.
senses.exampleCN: 小舞台上摆着五把椅子，五个人准备合奏一首五重奏。
senses.why: The first sense is a musical work, not the players.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是音乐作品，而不是演奏者。

senses.title: A jazz quintet
senses.definition: five jazz musicians who play as one band
senses.definitionCN: 作为一个乐队演奏的五名爵士乐手
senses.example: The jazz quintet toured for a decade without changing a member.
senses.exampleCN: 这支爵士五重奏巡演十年，成员一个没换。
senses.why: The same word names the group when used of people.
senses.whyCN: 指人时，同一个词命名的是团体。

senses.title: A quintet of singers
senses.definition: five voices trained to blend
senses.definitionCN: 五个训练有素、彼此融合的嗓音
senses.example: The quintet of singers held the last chord for a full breath.
senses.exampleCN: 五人合唱组把最后一个和弦拖了整整一口气。
senses.why: Voice replaces instruments, the count stays.
senses.whyCN: 嗓音替换了乐器，数目不变。

senses.title: A quintet of dancers
senses.definition: five dancers whose steps depend on one another
senses.definitionCN: 五个彼此依存完成舞步的舞者
senses.example: The quintet of dancers moved as a single body.
senses.exampleCN: 五人舞群像一具身体那样移动。
senses.why: The word extends beyond music to any five-part group.
senses.whyCN: 这个词越过音乐，指任何五人组合。

senses.title: The starting quintet
senses.definition: the five players who begin a basketball game
senses.definitionCN: 篮球比赛开场的五名球员
senses.example: The coach changed the starting quintet after three losses.
senses.exampleCN: 三连败之后，教练换掉了首发五人。
senses.why: Sport borrows the musical number word.
senses.whyCN: 体育借用了这个音乐数字词。

senses.title: A quintet of problems
senses.definition: a set of five things considered together
senses.definitionCN: 被放在一起考虑的五件事
senses.example: The report listed a quintet of failures in the same paragraph.
senses.exampleCN: 报告在同一段里列出了五个一组的问题。
senses.why: The word can count anything, not only performers.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以数任何东西，不只是表演者。

senses.title: A quintet in chamber music
senses.definition: the specific form with five parts and no conductor
senses.definitionCN: 五个声部、没有指挥的特定形式
senses.example: Chamber music treats the quintet as a conversation of equals.
senses.exampleCN: 室内乐把五重奏当作一场平等的对话。
senses.why: The sense is technical and refers to the form.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是技术性的，指这种形式。

senses.title: Versus quartet
senses.definition: five, as opposed to four, in the same musical frame
senses.definitionCN: 同样音乐框架里的五，与四相对
senses.example: A quartet leaves one fewer voice to answer.
senses.exampleCN: 与四重奏相比，五重奏少了一个应答的声部。
senses.why: The pair marks one added voice and a different balance.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词标记多出的一个声部与不同的平衡。

intro.en: Quintet comes from Italian quintetto, built on Latin quintus, 'fifth'.
intro.cn: quintet 来自意大利语 quintetto，词根是拉丁语 quintus（第五）。

items.en: Quintus was the ordinary word for fifth.
items.cn: quintus 是拉丁语里普通的「第五」。

items.en: Italian named a group of five in music.
items.cn: 意大利语命名音乐中的五人组合。

items.en: English borrowed the term for chamber works.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词指室内乐作品。

items.en: Jazz kept the label for five-piece bands.
items.cn: 爵士乐沿用它指五人乐队。

items.en: Today it names any five-part set.
items.cn: 今天它命名任何五件一套。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quint- family; the near-meaning group separates quartet, trio, ensemble and sextet.
note.cn: 形近组是 quint 词族；近义组把「四重奏」「三重奏」「合奏团」「六重奏」分开。

entries.definitionCN: 统计上的五个切点之一。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of five chairs set in a half circle.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「五把椅子围成半圆」的画面。

normal.en: Quintet carries quint, five: count the chairs before you listen.
normal.cn: quintet 里有 quint（五）：听之前先数椅子。

normal.en: Picture five musicians waiting for the same downbeat.
normal.cn: 想象五名乐手在等同一个起拍。

normal.en: Say kwin-TET; the stress falls on the last syllable.
normal.cn: 读 kwin-TET，重音在最后一个音节。

normal.en: The -et ending marks a group, as in quartet and trio's cousin sextet.
normal.cn: 词尾 -et 标记一个团体，如同 quartet 与 sextet。

normal.en: The word can count singers, dancers or even problems.
normal.cn: 这个词可以数歌手、舞者，甚至问题。

abstract.en: A quintet is a small democracy: five voices, no conductor.
abstract.cn: 五重奏是一个小型的民主：五个声部，没有指挥。

abstract.en: Adding a fifth player changes the conversation more than the arithmetic suggests.
abstract.cn: 增加第五个演奏者，对对话的改变大于算术所暗示的。

abstract.en: The word turns a number into a social form.
abstract.cn: 这个词把一个数字变成一种社会形式。

examples.en: The jazz quintet toured for a decade without changing a member.
examples.cn: 这支爵士五重奏巡演十年，成员一个没换。

examples.en: The quintet of singers held the last chord for a full breath.
examples.cn: 五人合唱组把最后一个和弦拖了整整一口气。

examples.en: The coach changed the starting quintet after three losses.
examples.cn: 三连败之后，教练换掉了首发五人。

dict_mnemonic.text: quint（五）+ et（小团体）→ 五个人组成的小团体。

root: 拉丁语 quintus（第五）→ 意大利语 quintetto

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses count five in different rooms: strings, jazz, voices, dancers, a basketball court, a list, chamber form and the contrast with four.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项在不同的房间里数到五：弦乐、爵士、人声、舞者、篮球场、清单、室内乐形式，以及与四的对照。

core.en: FIVE CHAIRS IN A HALF CIRCLE

branches.en: The written work and the chamber form.
branches.cn: 写成的作品与室内乐形式。

branches.en: Bands of instruments and of voices.
branches.cn: 乐器与人声的组合。

branches.en: Dancers and a starting five on court.
branches.cn: 舞者与球场上的首发五人。

branches.en: Any set of five considered together.
branches.cn: 任何被放在一起的五个。

branches.en: One added voice against the quartet.
branches.cn: 与四重奏相比多出的一个声部。

intro.en: The quint- family counts five: quint, quintet, quintile and quintuplet all divide or gather by five.
intro.cn: quint 词族数到五：quint、quintet、quintile、quintuplet 都以五来分或聚。

latinIntro.en: Latin quintus gives the stem, Italian -etto the diminutive ending that makes a group sound small and warm.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quintus 提供词干，意大利语 -etto 提供指小词尾，让一个团体听起来小而温暖。

definition_zh: 困惑的；探询的；带着调侃意味的；疑问的
definition_en: showing mild puzzlement or amused inquiry
core_image: 一个人挑起一边眉毛，嘴角压着一点笑，等你把话说完
scene: 老师看完学生交上来的答案，挑起了半边眉毛。The teacher raised one eyebrow in a quizzical look at the answer on the page.
sceneCN: 这里 quizzical 指探询而略带困惑的（第 1 个义项：疑问的神情）；句意为老师看完学生交上来的答案，挑起了半边眉毛。

pos.zh: 困惑的；探询的；带着调侃意味的

senses.title: A quizzical look
senses.definition: a look that asks a question without speaking
senses.definitionCN: 不说话却在提问的目光
senses.example: The teacher raised one eyebrow in a quizzical look at the answer on the page.
senses.exampleCN: 老师看完学生交上来的答案，挑起了半边眉毛，露出探询的目光。
senses.why: The first sense is silent inquiry.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是无声的询问。

senses.title: A quizzical smile
senses.definition: amusement mixed with not quite believing what is heard
senses.definitionCN: 觉得好笑，又不完全相信听到的话
senses.example: She gave a quizzical smile when he claimed to have read the whole book.
senses.exampleCN: 当他说自己读完了整本书时，她露出带笑的疑惑。
senses.why: The sense keeps the joke and the doubt together.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把玩笑与怀疑放在一起。

senses.title: A quizzical eyebrow
senses.definition: the facial gesture that carries the whole expression
senses.definitionCN: 承载整个表情的那一个面部动作
senses.example: One quizzical eyebrow did more work than the whole reply.
senses.exampleCN: 挑起的半边眉毛，比整句回答干的活还多。
senses.why: The word can attach to a single feature.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以附着在单个面部特征上。

senses.title: A quizzical tone
senses.definition: a voice that invites an explanation rather than demands one
senses.definitionCN: 邀请解释、而不是要求解释的语调
senses.example: He asked, in a quizzical tone, whether the plan had ever worked.
senses.exampleCN: 他以探询的语调问，这个计划到底有没有奏效过。
senses.why: Sound can carry the raised eyebrow.
senses.whyCN: 声音可以承载那挑起的眉毛。

senses.title: A quizzical expression
senses.definition: a face that says it is still waiting for the point
senses.definitionCN: 一张仍在等待重点的脸
senses.example: Her quizzical expression lasted until the second sentence.
senses.exampleCN: 她疑惑的表情一直持续到第二句话。
senses.why: The sense is the general word for the whole face.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是描述整张脸的总称。

senses.title: A quizzical glance
senses.definition: a brief look that registers surprise and asks about it
senses.definitionCN: 短暂记下惊讶并就此发问的一眼
senses.example: He threw a quizzical glance at the empty chair.
senses.exampleCN: 他向那把空椅子投去疑惑的一瞥。
senses.why: Brevity is part of the meaning here.
senses.whyCN: 短暂是这个义项的一部分。

senses.title: Quizzical amusement
senses.definition: enjoyment that comes from not understanding something yet
senses.definitionCN: 因尚未理解某事而产生的乐趣
senses.example: The audience watched the machine with quizzical amusement.
senses.exampleCN: 观众带着带疑问的乐趣看着那台机器。
senses.why: The word can name a whole mood, not only a look.
senses.whyCN: 这个词能命名一整个心境，而不只是一种目光。

senses.title: Versus puzzled
senses.definition: mildly questioning and amused, as opposed to genuinely confused
senses.definitionCN: 温和的疑问加趣味，与真正的困惑相对
senses.example: A puzzled face wants an answer; a quizzical one wants a better story.
senses.exampleCN: 困惑的脸想要答案，探询的脸想要更好的说法。
senses.why: The pair separates real confusion from playful doubt.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把真正的困惑与玩笑式的怀疑分开。

intro.en: Quizzical comes from quiz, a word of uncertain origin that first meant an odd person or a joke.
intro.cn: quizzical 来自 quiz，而 quiz 来源不明，最初指古怪的人或玩笑。

items.en: Quiz first appeared as a word for a strange fellow.
items.cn: quiz 最初指古怪的人。

items.en: It also named a hoax played on a person.
items.cn: 它也指对某人开的恶作剧。

items.en: The word shifted to a short test of knowledge.
items.cn: 这个词转向简短的知测验。

items.en: Quizzical kept the mocking, questioning look.
items.cn: quizzical 保留了那种调侃而探询的神情。

items.en: Today it describes mild, amused doubt.
items.cn: 今天它描述温和而带趣味的怀疑。

note.en: The look-alike group is the quiz- family; the near-meaning group separates puzzled, puzzled-looking, arch and sceptical.
note.cn: 形近组是 quiz 词族；近义组把「困惑的」「疑惑的」「俏皮的」「怀疑的」分开。

entries.definition: the act of testing or questioning.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of one raised eyebrow and a half-hidden smile.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一边眉毛挑起、笑意半藏」的画面。

normal.en: Quizzical is a quiz in the face: a question with a smile.
normal.cn: quizzical 就是写在脸上的 quiz：带笑的疑问。

normal.en: Picture one eyebrow up and the mouth trying not to laugh.
normal.cn: 想象一边眉毛上扬，嘴在忍着不笑。

normal.en: Say KWIZ-i-kal; the z buzzes in the middle.
normal.cn: 读 KWIZ-i-kal，中间的 z 带嗡嗡声。

normal.en: The look invites a better explanation, not a defence.
normal.cn: 这种神情是在邀请更好的解释，而不是辩护。

normal.en: Ask: is this confusion, or is it a joke waiting?
normal.cn: 问一句：这是困惑，还是一个等着开的玩笑？

abstract.en: Quizzical is doubt wearing good manners.
abstract.cn: quizzical 是戴着礼貌的怀疑。

abstract.en: The word marks the moment before laughter, when the mind has not decided.
abstract.cn: 这个词标记笑声之前的那一刻，头脑还没决定。

abstract.en: A quizzical face keeps the conversation open; a puzzled one closes it.
abstract.cn: 探询的脸让对话继续，困惑的脸让它结束。

examples.en: She gave a quizzical smile when he claimed to have read the whole book.
examples.cn: 当他说自己读完了整本书时，她露出带笑的疑惑。

examples.en: He asked, in a quizzical tone, whether the plan had ever worked.
examples.cn: 他以探询的语调问，这个计划到底有没有奏效过。

examples.en: The audience watched the machine with quizzical amusement.
examples.cn: 观众带着带疑问的乐趣看着那台机器。

dict_mnemonic.text: quiz（考问）+ ical → 脸上带着考问的。

root: 英语 quiz（测验、盘问，来源不明）+ -ical

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses keep one expression: a look, a smile, an eyebrow, a tone, a face, a glance, a mood and the contrast with plain confusion.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项保留同一种神情：目光、微笑、眉毛、语调、面容、一瞥、心境，以及与单纯困惑的对照。

core.en: ONE EYEBROW RAISED

branches.en: The look and the brief glance that carries it.
branches.cn: 目光与承载它的短暂一瞥。

branches.en: Amusement that keeps the doubt playful.
branches.cn: 让怀疑保持趣味的笑意。

branches.en: A single feature doing the whole work.
branches.cn: 一个独立完成全部工作的面部特征。

branches.en: The tone and the face in general.
branches.cn: 语调与整张脸。

branches.en: Playful doubt set against real confusion.
branches.cn: 玩笑式的怀疑与真正的困惑相对。

intro.en: The quiz- family is recent and playful: quiz, quizzing, quizzical and quizzically all keep the sense of a small test.
intro.cn: quiz 词族年轻而俏皮：quiz、quizzing、quizzical、quizzically 都保留「小考问」的意思。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; quiz appeared in English in the late 1700s and its origin is still debated.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根；quiz 在十八世纪末出现在英语里，来源至今仍有争论。

definition_zh: 球拍；喧闹声；[口] 非法生意；敲诈勾当；吵闹
definition_en: a bat for ball games, a loud noise, or an illegal money-making scheme
core_image: 一只球拍放在桌上，窗外传来一阵让人皱眉的喧哗
scene: 楼下有人开始练鼓，整栋楼都被那阵喧闹震得发慌。Someone started practising drums downstairs and the whole building shook with the racket.
sceneCN: 这里 racket 指喧闹声（第 1 个义项：吵闹的声响）；句意为楼下有人开始练鼓，整栋楼都被那阵喧闹震得发慌。

pos.zh: 球拍；喧闹声；非法生意
吵闹；喧哗

senses.title: A tennis racket
senses.definition: a bat with a netted face used in ball games
senses.definitionCN: 球类运动中带网面的拍子
senses.example: She kept her racket in the car so she could play after work.
senses.exampleCN: 她把球拍放在车里，下班后就能去打。
senses.why: The concrete sense is the oldest and the most physical.
senses.whyCN: 具体义项最古老，也最物理。

senses.title: The racket of traffic
senses.definition: a loud, confused noise that goes on and on
senses.definitionCN: 持续不断、混杂的响亮声响
senses.example: Someone started practising drums downstairs and the whole building shook with the racket.
senses.exampleCN: 楼下有人开始练鼓，整栋楼都被那阵喧闹震得发慌。
senses.why: The word judges the noise as excessive, not merely loud.
senses.whyCN: 这个词判定这声响过分，而不只是响。

senses.title: A protection racket
senses.definition: an illegal business that sells safety it also threatens
senses.definitionCN: 既威胁安全又出售安全的非法生意
senses.example: The shop owners paid a protection racket for years.
senses.exampleCN: 店主们多年来向一个收取保护费的团伙交钱。
senses.why: The criminal sense grew from the idea of a noisy disturbance.
senses.whyCN: 犯罪义项从「吵闹骚扰」的意思长出来。

senses.title: A racket of complaints
senses.definition: a chorus of protest from many voices at once
senses.definitionCN: 许多声音同时发出的抗议
senses.example: The new timetable raised a racket of complaints from parents.
senses.exampleCN: 新时间表引来了家长们一片抱怨声。
senses.why: The word can describe a human chorus, not only machines.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以描述人声的合唱，不只是机器。

senses.title: To racket about
senses.definition: to move around making noise and disturbance
senses.definitionCN: 四处走动、发出噪音与骚扰
senses.example: The children racketed through the house until dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在屋里闹到天黑。
senses.why: The verb keeps the noise as an activity.
senses.whyCN: 动词把噪音当作一种活动。

senses.title: A numbers racket
senses.definition: an illegal lottery or betting operation
senses.definitionCN: 非法的彩票或赌博经营
senses.example: The numbers racket ran out of a barbershop.
senses.exampleCN: 那个地下彩票勾当就在一家理发店里运作。
senses.why: This is the organised-crime sense in its classic form.
senses.whyCN: 这是有组织犯罪义项的经典形态。

senses.title: A rackety old car
senses.definition: a machine that is noisy and in poor condition
senses.definitionCN: 吵闹且状况不佳的机器
senses.example: They toured the coast in a rackety old car.
senses.exampleCN: 他们开着一辆破旧吵闹的老车沿海岸旅行。
senses.why: The adjective extends the noise to the object itself.
senses.whyCN: 形容词把噪音延伸到了物件本身。

senses.title: Versus noise
senses.definition: a din that is judged excessive and annoying, as opposed to any sound
senses.definitionCN: 被判定为过分而恼人的喧闹，与任何声音相对
senses.example: Noise can be measured; a racket is complained about.
senses.exampleCN: noise 可以被测量，racket 会被投诉。
senses.why: The pair separates a physical event from a social judgement.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把物理事件与社会评判分开。

intro.en: Racket has two histories: the bat probably comes from French raquette, while the noise may be imitative.
intro.cn: racket 有两条历史：球拍大概来自法语 raquette，喧闹义则可能是拟声的。

items.en: The bat came through French from an Arabic root.
items.cn: 球拍经法语来自一个阿拉伯词根。

items.en: The din sense probably echoes the sound itself.
items.cn: 喧闹义很可能是对声音本身的模仿。

items.en: London slang turned a disturbance into an extortion scheme.
items.cn: 伦敦俚语把骚扰变成敲诈勾当。

items.en: Lawn tennis fixed the bat as the main sense.
items.cn: 草地网球把球拍固定为主要义项。

items.en: Today the word covers sport, noise and crime at once.
items.cn: 今天这个词同时覆盖运动、噪音与犯罪。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rack- family; the near-meaning group separates din, clamour, commotion and racketeering.
note.cn: 形近组是 rack 词族；近义组把「喧闹」「嘈杂」「骚动」「敲诈」分开。

entries.definition: an alternative spelling of the bat.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep both pictures: a bat on a table and a noise coming through the floor.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想同时留住两幅画面：桌上的球拍，和从地板传来的响声。

normal.en: Racket covers bat and noise: one object, one disturbance.
normal.cn: racket 兼指球拍与噪音：一件东西，一种骚扰。

normal.en: Picture a tennis racket on a table while drums shake the floor.
normal.cn: 想象桌上放着一只网球拍，鼓声震着地板。

normal.en: Say RAK-it; it sounds short and hard, like a slap.
normal.cn: 读 RAK-it，听起来短而硬，像一记拍打。

normal.en: The criminal sense came from the noise of harassment.
normal.cn: 犯罪义项来自骚扰的噪音。

normal.en: Ask which racket is meant: sport, sound or scheme?
normal.cn: 问清是哪种 racket：运动、声音，还是勾当？

abstract.en: A racket is noise with a purpose when someone is being shaken down.
abstract.cn: 当有人被敲诈时，喧闹就带上了目的。

abstract.en: The word joins the tool and the disturbance: both are things you swing.
abstract.cn: 这个词把工具与骚扰连在一起：两者都是可以挥动的东西。

abstract.en: Every racket needs an audience, whether a crowd or a victim.
abstract.cn: 每个 racket 都需要观众，无论是一群人还是一名受害者。

examples.en: She kept her racket in the car so she could play after work.
examples.cn: 她把球拍放在车里，下班后就能去打。

examples.en: The shop owners paid a protection racket for years.
examples.cn: 店主们多年来向一个收取保护费的团伙交钱。

examples.en: The new timetable raised a racket of complaints from parents.
examples.cn: 新时间表引来了家长们一片抱怨声。

dict_mnemonic.text: racket 一物两义：手上挥的拍子，和耳边炸开的吵闹。

root: 法语 raquette（球拍）；喧闹义可能为拟声

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses swing between object and noise: a bat, a din, a criminal scheme, a chorus, the act of making noise, a lottery, a broken car and the contrast with plain noise.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项在物件与声响之间摆动：球拍、喧闹、犯罪勾当、一片人声、吵闹的动作、地下彩票、破车，以及与单纯噪音的对照。

core.en: A BAT AND A DIN

branches.en: The sporting object itself.
branches.cn: 运动物件本身。

branches.en: Noise from machines and noise from people.
branches.cn: 机器的噪音与人的噪音。

branches.en: Criminal schemes small and organised.
branches.cn: 零散与有组织的犯罪勾当。

branches.en: The verb that keeps the noise in motion.
branches.cn: 让噪音保持在动作里的动词。

branches.en: A broken noisy object and the line to plain noise.
branches.cn: 破旧吵闹的物件以及与单纯噪音的界线。

intro.en: The racket family spreads into crime and quality: racketeer, racketeering and rackety all grow from the same loud word.
intro.cn: racket 词族扩展到犯罪与质地：racketeer、racketeering、rackety 都从同一个喧闹的词长出来。

latinIntro.en: French raquette gives the bat, possibly from Arabic rakdat, 'palm of the hand'; the noise sense has no settled root.
latinIntro.cn: 法语 raquette 提供球拍义，可能来自阿拉伯语 rakdat（手掌）；喧闹义没有确定的词根。

items.meaning: an old spelling of the bat

definition_zh: 辐射；散发（热、光）；流露；呈放射状散开
definition_en: to send out heat, light or feeling from a centre, or to spread outward
core_image: 一块烧红的铁把热一圈圈推向四周，越远越淡
scene: 炉子烧起来以后，热从铁皮中心一圈圈散到房间各处。Once the stove was lit, heat began to radiate from its centre across the room.
sceneCN: 这里 radiate 指散发热量（第 1 个义项：向外辐射）；句意为炉子烧起来以后，热从铁皮中心一圈圈散到房间各处。

pos.zh: 辐射；散发；流露；呈放射状散开
放射状的

senses.title: To radiate heat
senses.definition: to give off heat in all directions from a source
senses.definitionCN: 从热源向各个方向放出热量
senses.example: Once the stove was lit, heat began to radiate from its centre across the room.
senses.exampleCN: 炉子烧起来以后，热从铁皮中心一圈圈散到房间各处。
senses.why: The first sense is physical and directional.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是物理的、有方向的。

senses.title: To radiate light
senses.definition: to send out light that spreads from a point
senses.definitionCN: 从一点向四周放出的光
senses.example: The lamp radiated a soft yellow light over the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 台灯在书桌上散出柔和的黄光。
senses.why: Light and heat share the same outward motion.
senses.whyCN: 光与热共享同一种向外的运动。

senses.title: To radiate joy
senses.definition: to show a feeling so strongly that others feel it coming from you
senses.definitionCN: 强烈地表现一种情感，别人感到它从你身上发出
senses.example: She radiated joy from the moment she entered the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她一走进房间，就流露出喜悦。
senses.why: The metaphor makes a person into a source.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把一个人变成一个光源。

senses.title: To radiate confidence
senses.definition: to give others a strong impression of assurance
senses.definitionCN: 给别人强烈的可靠感
senses.example: The young speaker radiated confidence without raising his voice.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻演讲者没有提高音量，却流露出自信。
senses.why: The sense is social: a quality is transmitted outward.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是社会的：一种品质被向外传送。

senses.title: Radiating lines
senses.definition: lines that spread from a common point like spokes
senses.definitionCN: 像辐条一样从同一点散开的线
senses.example: The map showed roads radiating from the old market square.
senses.exampleCN: 地图上，道路从老市场广场呈放射状散开。
senses.why: Geometry keeps the shape and drops the energy.
senses.whyCN: 几何学保留形状，丢掉能量。

senses.title: Radiate from a centre
senses.definition: to spread outward in every direction from a single origin
senses.definitionCN: 从单一原点向各方向扩散
senses.example: Every rumour seemed to radiate from one small office.
senses.exampleCN: 所有传闻似乎都从那间小办公室散开。
senses.why: The sense can describe information as easily as warmth.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项描述信息，和描述温度一样容易。

senses.title: A radiating pattern
senses.definition: a design of lines or rays that run outward from a middle
senses.definitionCN: 由中心向外延伸的线或射线构成的图案
senses.example: The ceiling carried a radiating pattern of thin wooden strips.
senses.exampleCN: 天花板上有一种细木条构成的放射状图案。
senses.why: Design borrows the geometry of light.
senses.whyCN: 设计借用了光的几何。

senses.title: Versus emit
senses.definition: to spread in all directions, as opposed to sending out in one
senses.definitionCN: 向各方向散开，与朝一个方向发出相对
senses.example: A lamp emits light; a fire radiates warmth.
senses.exampleCN: 灯发出光，火散发热。
senses.why: The pair separates a beam from a glow.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把光束与光晕分开。

intro.en: Radiate comes from Latin radiare, 'to emit rays', from radius, a spoke or ray.
intro.cn: radiate 来自拉丁语 radiare（放出射线），词根是 radius（辐条、光线）。

items.en: Radius named a spoke of a wheel and a ray of light.
items.cn: radius 指车轮的辐条，也指光线。

items.en: Radiare meant to send out rays.
items.cn: radiare 意为放出射线。

items.en: English used radiate for light and heat first.
items.cn: 英语最初用 radiate 指光与热。

items.en: Radiation became a technical term for transmitted energy.
items.cn: radiation 成为传递能量的技术术语。

items.en: The word now also describes a person who seems to glow.
items.cn: 今天这个词也描述一个仿佛在发光的人。

note.en: The look-alike group is the radi- family; the near-meaning group separates emit, diffuse, emanate and spread.
note.cn: 形近组是 radi 词族；近义组把「发出」「扩散」「散发」「传播」分开。

entries.definitionCN: 以射线形式发出的能量。

entries.definition: a device that gives off heat.
a line from the centre to the edge.
to send out light, sound or gas.
to spread widely through a space.
to come out from a source.
to extend over a wider area.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a hot iron sending warmth outward in rings.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一块烧红的铁一圈圈向外送热」的画面。

normal.en: Radiate shares its root with radius and ray: everything leaves a centre.
normal.cn: radiate 与 radius、ray 同根：一切都从中心离开。

normal.en: Picture spokes on a wheel and heat travelling along each one.
normal.cn: 想象车轮上的辐条，热沿着每一根往外走。

normal.en: Say RAY-dee-ate; the first syllable sounds like ray.
normal.cn: 读 RAY-dee-ate，第一音节听起来就是 ray。

normal.en: The word moves easily from stoves to smiles.
normal.cn: 这个词从炉子移到微笑，毫不费力。

normal.en: Ask which direction: outward from a point, or straight along a beam?
normal.cn: 问方向：是从一点向外，还是沿一条光束直走？

abstract.en: To radiate is to make your centre visible.
abstract.cn: 辐射，就是让你的中心变得可见。

abstract.en: Heat, light and feeling obey one grammar: a source, a direction, a distance.
abstract.cn: 热、光与情感遵守同一套语法：一个源、一个方向、一段距离。

abstract.en: The word flatters people: it turns a mood into a form of energy.
abstract.cn: 这个词抬举人：它把一种心境变成一种能量。

examples.en: The lamp radiated a soft yellow light over the desk.
examples.cn: 台灯在书桌上散出柔和的黄光。

examples.en: She radiated joy from the moment she entered the room.
examples.cn: 她一走进房间，就流露出喜悦。

examples.en: The map showed roads radiating from the old market square.
examples.cn: 地图上，道路从老市场广场呈放射状散开。

dict_mnemonic.text: radi（光线、辐条）+ ate（动词）→ 像辐条一样向外散。

root: 拉丁语 radius（辐条、光线）→ radiare（放出射线）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses send one motion outward: heat, light, joy, confidence, lines, rumours, ornament and the contrast with a straight beam.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把同一种运动向外送：热、光、喜悦、自信、线条、传闻、装饰，以及与直射光束的对照。

core.en: HEAT LEAVING A CENTRE

branches.en: Heat and light as the physical pair.
branches.cn: 作为物理一对的热与光。

branches.en: Joy and confidence felt as energy.
branches.cn: 被感受为能量的喜悦与自信。

branches.en: Geometry and design made from rays.
branches.cn: 由射线构成的几何与图案。

branches.en: Anything that spreads from one office or point.
branches.cn: 任何从一处散开的事物。

branches.en: A glow set against a beam.
branches.cn: 光晕与光束相对。

intro.en: The radi- family is built on rays: radiate, radiant, radiation, radiator and radius all start from a line leaving a centre.
intro.cn: radi 词族建立在射线上：radiate、radiant、radiation、radiator、radius 都从一条离开中心的线开始。

latinIntro.en: Latin radius gives the noun of spoke and ray, radiare the verb, and -atio the process noun that became radiation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 radius 提供辐条与射线的名词，radiare 提供动词，-atio 提供过程名词，后来成为 radiation。

definition_zh: 铁路；铁道系统；铁路公司；铁路旅行
definition_en: a track of rails for trains, or the whole system that runs on it
core_image: 两条钢轨穿过山谷，一直伸到看不清的远处
scene: 山谷里，两条钢轨沿着河弯一直伸向远处的隧道。In the valley the railway followed the bend of the river towards a distant tunnel.
sceneCN: 这里 railway 指铁路（第 1 个义项：铺设钢轨的线路）；句意为山谷里，两条钢轨沿着河弯一直伸向远处的隧道。

pos.zh: 铁路；铁道系统；铁路公司

senses.title: A railway line
senses.definition: the set of rails on which trains run
senses.definitionCN: 列车行驶其上的那组钢轨
senses.example: In the valley the railway followed the bend of the river towards a distant tunnel.
senses.exampleCN: 山谷里，铁路沿着河弯一直伸向远处的隧道。
senses.why: The first sense is the physical track.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是物理的轨道。

senses.title: The railway network
senses.definition: the whole system of lines, stations and services
senses.definitionCN: 线路、车站与服务构成的整个系统
senses.example: The railway network reached every province within a century.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路网在一个世纪内延伸到每个省。
senses.why: The word scales from a track to a system.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从一条轨道扩到一个系统。

senses.title: A railway company
senses.definition: the business that owns and runs the trains
senses.definitionCN: 拥有并运营列车的企业
senses.example: The railway employed more people than any other company in the county.
senses.exampleCN: 这家铁路公司雇的人比郡里任何企业都多。
senses.why: In British English the word often stands for the operator.
senses.whyCN: 在英式英语里，这个词常指运营方。

senses.title: Railway travel
senses.definition: the experience of journeying by train
senses.definitionCN: 乘火车出行的体验
senses.example: Railway travel made the coast reachable in a single day.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路旅行让海岸在一天之内就能到达。
senses.why: The word can name an activity, not just a structure.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以命名一种活动，而不只是结构。

senses.title: The railway age
senses.definition: the historical period that trains transformed
senses.definitionCN: 被列车改变的历史时期
senses.example: The railway age redrew the map of work and home.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路时代重画了工作与居所的地图。
senses.why: History uses the word as a label for a whole era.
senses.whyCN: 历史学把这个词当作一整个时代的标签。

senses.title: A railway town
senses.definition: a settlement that grew because a line passed through it
senses.definitionCN: 因线路经过而发展起来的聚落
senses.example: The railway town doubled in size in ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座铁路城镇十年间规模翻了一倍。
senses.why: The word marks a cause of urban growth.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标记城市增长的一个原因。

senses.title: A narrow railway
senses.definition: a line built to a smaller gauge for hills or mines
senses.definitionCN: 为山地或矿山铺设的较小轨距线路
senses.example: A narrow railway carried ore down from the mine.
senses.exampleCN: 一条窄轨铁路把矿石从矿上运下来。
senses.why: The word can be qualified by gauge and purpose.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以用轨距与用途来限定。

senses.title: Versus railroad
senses.definition: the British term for the track, as opposed to the American one
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语的轨道说法，与美式相对
senses.example: A British passenger says railway; an American says railroad.
senses.exampleCN: 英国乘客说 railway，美国乘客说 railroad。
senses.why: The pair separates two dialects of the same machine.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把同一台机器的两种方言分开。

intro.en: Railway joins rail, from Latin regula, 'a straight bar', with way.
intro.cn: railway 把 rail（源自拉丁语 regula，直条）与 way 组合在一起。

items.en: Regula meant a straight rule or bar.
items.cn: regula 指直的尺或条。

items.en: French turned it into a bar of wood or metal.
items.cn: 法语把它变成木条或金属条。

items.en: English rail first named a fence bar.
items.cn: 英语 rail 最初指栅栏条。

items.en: Iron rails laid for wagons became the railway.
items.cn: 为货车铺的铁轨变成了铁路。

items.en: The word grew to mean the whole network.
items.cn: 这个词长成了整个网络的意思。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rail- family; the near-meaning group separates railroad, track, line and tramway.
note.cn: 形近组是 rail 词族；近义组把「美式铁路」「轨道」「线路」「有轨电车路」分开。

entries.definition: a metal bar or a handrail.
the pair of rails and its bed.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of two steel lines running to a distant tunnel.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「两条钢轨伸向远处隧道」的画面。

normal.en: Railway is rail plus way: a way made of rails.
normal.cn: railway 是 rail 加 way：由钢轨构成的路。

normal.en: Picture a valley, a river bend and a tunnel at the end.
normal.cn: 想象一个山谷、一道河弯，尽头是一个隧道。

normal.en: Say RAYL-way; the first syllable is long and open.
normal.cn: 读 RAYL-way，第一音节长而开。

normal.en: British railway, American railroad: same steel, different word.
normal.cn: 英式 railway，美式 railroad：同样的钢，不同的词。

normal.en: The word can mean a track, a company or a whole age.
normal.cn: 这个词可以指一条轨道、一家公司，或整个时代。

abstract.en: A railway is a promise that distance can be scheduled.
abstract.cn: 铁路是一项承诺：距离可以被排进时刻表。

abstract.en: The word turned geography into a timetable.
abstract.cn: 这个词把地理变成了时刻表。

abstract.en: Every railway town is a place that agreed to be passed through.
abstract.cn: 每座铁路城镇，都是一个同意被经过的地方。

examples.en: The railway network reached every province within a century.
examples.cn: 铁路网在一个世纪内延伸到每个省。

examples.en: Railway travel made the coast reachable in a single day.
examples.cn: 铁路旅行让海岸在一天之内就能到达。

examples.en: A narrow railway carried ore down from the mine.
examples.cn: 一条窄轨铁路把矿石从矿上运下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: rail（钢条）+ way（路）→ 用钢条铺成的路。

root: 拉丁语 regula（直条）→ 法语 reille → 英语 rail + way

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses run along one track: the rails, the network, the company, the journey, the era, the town, the gauge and the American twin.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一条轨道：钢轨、网络、公司、旅程、时代、城镇、轨距，以及美式同义词。

core.en: TWO STEEL LINES INTO THE DISTANCE

branches.en: The track and the system built on it.
branches.cn: 轨道与建在其上的系统。

branches.en: The company and the journey.
branches.cn: 公司与旅程。

branches.en: The era and the town it made.
branches.cn: 时代与它造就的城镇。

branches.en: A line built to a different gauge.
branches.cn: 以不同轨距铺设的线路。

branches.en: The British word beside its American twin.
branches.cn: 英式说法与它的美式双胞胎。

intro.en: The rail- family runs from the bar itself to the whole system: rail, railing, railway and railroad all begin with a straight line of metal.
intro.cn: rail 词族从一根钢条延伸到整个系统：rail、railing、railway、railroad 都从一条笔直的金属开始。

latinIntro.en: Latin regula, 'rule or bar', became French reille and English rail; way is the plain English word for road.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 regula（尺、条）变成法语 reille 与英语 rail；way 是英语里朴素的「路」。

items.meaning: a car that runs on rails
the end of a built line
a rule or bar in Latin

definition_zh: 雨衣；防水外套
definition_en: a waterproof coat worn to keep dry in the rain
core_image: 一件挂在门后的胶面外套，袖口还在往下滴水
scene: 雨突然落下来，出门的人从包里掏出一件外套披上。The rain began suddenly, and the walkers pulled a raincoat from the bag.
sceneCN: 这里 raincoat 指雨衣（第 1 个义项：挡雨的外套）；句意为雨突然落下来，出门的人从包里掏出一件外套披上。

pos.zh: 雨衣；防水外套

senses.title: A waterproof raincoat
senses.definition: a coat made to shed water instead of soaking it
senses.definitionCN: 不吸水、能把水排开的外套
senses.example: The rain began suddenly, and the walkers pulled a raincoat from the bag.
senses.exampleCN: 雨突然落下来，出门的人从包里掏出一件雨衣披上。
senses.why: The first sense is defined by its material.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项由材质定义。

senses.title: A long raincoat
senses.definition: a raincoat cut below the knee to protect more of the body
senses.definitionCN: 长过膝盖、保护更多身体的雨衣
senses.example: The detective wore a long raincoat and no umbrella.
senses.exampleCN: 那位侦探穿着一件长雨衣，没打伞。
senses.why: Length is a practical choice with a strong image.
senses.whyCN: 长度是实用选择，也带着强烈的意象。

senses.title: A folded raincoat
senses.definition: a raincoat carried in a bag in case of weather
senses.definitionCN: 为防天气变化而放在包里的雨衣
senses.example: He kept a folded raincoat in the bottom of his rucksack.
senses.exampleCN: 他在背包底部放了一件叠好的雨衣。
senses.why: The sense is about preparedness, not the garment.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项关乎有备而来，而不是衣服本身。

senses.title: A cheap plastic raincoat
senses.definition: a thin disposable coat sold at a kiosk
senses.definitionCN: 在售货亭出售的薄型一次性外套
senses.example: The festival sold a plastic raincoat for the price of a coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐节上一件塑料雨衣卖一杯咖啡的价钱。
senses.why: Material and price attach to the word.
senses.whyCN: 材质与价格附着在这个词上。

senses.title: A raincoat pocket
senses.definition: the deep pocket sewn into a waterproof coat
senses.definitionCN: 缝在防水外套上的深口袋
senses.example: He found the ticket in a raincoat pocket weeks later.
senses.exampleCN: 几周后他在雨衣口袋里找到了那张票。
senses.why: The compound can name parts of the garment.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词也能命名衣服的部件。

senses.title: To take off a raincoat
senses.definition: to remove the coat once the weather clears
senses.definitionCN: 天气转晴后把外套脱下来
senses.example: She took off the raincoat and shook it twice.
senses.exampleCN: 她脱下雨衣，抖了两下。
senses.why: The word marks a small ceremony of relief.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标记一个小小的如释重负的仪式。

senses.title: A raincoat as a shield
senses.definition: a garment used as a general protection against the weather
senses.definitionCN: 用来抵御天气的广义防护衣物
senses.example: On the coast the raincoat doubled as a windbreak.
senses.exampleCN: 在海岸上，雨衣兼作挡风的屏障。
senses.why: The sense stretches the purpose beyond rain.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把用途扩展到雨之外。

senses.title: Versus trench coat
senses.definition: a practical waterproof, as opposed to a tailored fashion coat
senses.definitionCN: 实用防水外套，与讲究剪裁的风衣相对
senses.example: A raincoat keeps you dry; a trench coat keeps you looking dry.
senses.exampleCN: raincoat 让你保持干燥，trench coat 让你看起来干燥。
senses.why: The pair separates use from style.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把用途与风格分开。

intro.en: Raincoat is a plain English compound of rain and coat, named in the age of rubberised cloth.
intro.cn: raincoat 是 rain 与 coat 的朴素英语复合词，诞生于防水布流行的年代。

items.en: Rain has been the ordinary word for weather water.
items.cn: rain 一直是英语里「雨水」的常用词。

items.en: Coat named an outer garment by the 1300s.
items.cn: coat 在十四世纪已指外衣。

items.en: Waterproof cloth made the compound necessary.
items.cn: 防水布的出现让这个复合词成为必要。

items.en: Walking and hunting spread the garment.
items.cn: 徒步与打猎让这种衣服流行。

items.en: The word now covers cheap disposable versions.
items.cn: 今天这个词也覆盖廉价的一次性版本。

note.en: The look-alike group is the -coat family; the near-meaning group separates mackintosh, slicker, poncho and umbrella.
note.cn: 形近组是 coat 词族；近义组把「胶布雨衣」「防水外套」「斗篷雨披」「雨伞」分开。

entries.definition: an arc of colours in the sky.
the amount of rain that falls.
a sheet of waterproof cloth with a hole.
a folding shield held over the head.
entries.definitionCN: 举在头上的折叠遮蔽物。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a dripping coat on a hook by the door.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「门后挂钩上一件还在滴水的外套」的画面。

normal.en: Raincoat is rain plus coat: the word says exactly what it does.
normal.cn: raincoat 是 rain 加 coat：这个词把功能写在了名字里。

normal.en: Picture a plastic hood, wet shoulders and a bag that stayed dry.
normal.cn: 想象塑料帽檐、湿肩膀，和一个保持干燥的包。

normal.en: Say RAYN-kote; the first syllable is weather, the second is clothing.
normal.cn: 读 RAYN-kote，第一音节是天气，第二音节是衣物。

normal.en: Keep one folded in the bag; the word implies foresight.
normal.cn: 在包里放一件叠好的；这个词暗示先见。

normal.en: The garment ends the argument between weather and plan.
normal.cn: 这件衣服结束了天气与计划之间的争论。

abstract.en: A raincoat is a small treaty with the sky.
abstract.cn: 雨衣是与天空签的一纸小条约。

abstract.en: The word is honest: it promises less than a coat and delivers more than an umbrella.
abstract.cn: 这个词很诚实：它承诺的比外套少，做到的比雨伞多。

abstract.en: Every raincoat carries the memory of a day that changed plans.
abstract.cn: 每件雨衣都带着一个改变计划的日子的记忆。

examples.en: The detective wore a long raincoat and no umbrella.
examples.cn: 那位侦探穿着一件长雨衣，没打伞。

examples.en: He kept a folded raincoat in the bottom of his rucksack.
examples.cn: 他在背包底部放了一件叠好的雨衣。

examples.en: On the coast the raincoat doubled as a windbreak.
examples.cn: 在海岸上，雨衣兼作挡风的屏障。

dict_mnemonic.text: rain（雨）+ coat（外套）→ 挡雨的外套。

root: 英语 rain（雨）+ coat（外衣）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses dress one garment differently: material, length, packing, price, pocket, removal, wider protection and the contrast with a fashion coat.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项给同一件衣服换装：材质、长度、收纳、价格、口袋、脱下、更广的防护，以及与时尚风衣的对照。

core.en: A COAT THAT SHEDS WATER

branches.en: What it is made of and what it costs.
branches.cn: 它由什么做成，以及它值多少钱。

branches.en: Length and the habit of carrying it.
branches.cn: 长度与随身携带的习惯。

branches.en: The pocket and the small ceremony of removal.
branches.cn: 口袋与脱下时的小仪式。

branches.en: Protection stretched past rain.
branches.cn: 扩展到雨之外的防护。

branches.en: Use set against style.
branches.cn: 用途与风格相对。

intro.en: The -coat family is plain English: raincoat, overcoat, topcoat and greatcoat all name a garment by its job or its cut.
intro.cn: coat 词族是朴素英语：raincoat、overcoat、topcoat、greatcoat 都按功能或剪裁命名外衣。

latinIntro.en: Rain and coat are both English; coat itself came through Old French cotte from a Latin word for a tunic.
latinIntro.cn: rain 与 coat 都是英语词；coat 本身经古法语 cotte，来自拉丁语指长袍的词。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 拉丁语用法中的束腰外衣

definition_zh: 牧场；大农场；经营牧场；牧场住宅
definition_en: a large farm where cattle or other animals are raised
core_image: 一大片围起来的草地，几头牛在远处慢慢移动
scene: 山谷里的草地上散着牛群，围栏一直拉到看不见的坡顶。Cattle moved slowly across the grass while the fence of the ranch ran up the hill out of sight.
sceneCN: 这里 ranch 指牧场（第 1 个义项：养牛的农场）；句意为山谷里的草地上散着牛群，围栏一直拉到看不见的坡顶。

pos.zh: 牧场；大农场
经营牧场；在牧场工作

senses.title: A cattle ranch
senses.definition: a large holding where cattle are raised on open land
senses.definitionCN: 在开阔土地上养牛的大农场
senses.example: Cattle moved slowly across the grass while the fence of the ranch ran up the hill out of sight.
senses.exampleCN: 牛群在草地上慢慢移动，牧场的围栏一直拉到看不见的坡顶。
senses.why: The first sense is land and animals together.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是土地与牲畜的结合。

senses.title: To run a ranch
senses.definition: to own and manage such a holding
senses.definitionCN: 拥有并管理这样一片农场
senses.example: His family had ranched the valley for three generations.
senses.exampleCN: 他家在这个山谷经营牧场已经三代。
senses.why: The verb turns the place into a livelihood.
senses.whyCN: 动词把地点变成生计。

senses.title: A ranch house
senses.definition: the main dwelling on such a farm, often low and wide
senses.definitionCN: 这类农场上的主要住所，通常低矮宽阔
senses.example: The ranch house had one long porch facing the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 牧场住宅有一个长长的门廊，正对着群山。
senses.why: The word attaches to buildings as well as land.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也附着在建筑上，而不只是土地。

senses.title: A ranch hand
senses.definition: a worker hired to care for animals and fences
senses.definitionCN: 受雇照看牲畜与围栏的工人
senses.example: A ranch hand checked the water trough before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 一名牧场工人在天亮前检查了水槽。
senses.why: The compound names the people the land needs.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词命名土地所需要的人。

senses.title: A dude ranch
senses.definition: a working farm that takes paying guests
senses.definitionCN: 接待付费客人的牧场
senses.example: The dude ranch taught city visitors to ride.
senses.exampleCN: 这家度假牧场教城里来的客人骑马。
senses.why: The word can be sold as an experience.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以被当作一种体验出售。

senses.title: A sheep ranch
senses.definition: the same holding turned to sheep or other stock
senses.definitionCN: 改为养羊或其他牲畜的同类农场
senses.example: The sheep ranch needed fewer hands than the old cattle one.
senses.exampleCN: 这家养羊场需要的人手比原来的养牛场少。
senses.why: The word adapts to whatever is raised.
senses.whyCN: 这个词随所养的东西而变。

senses.title: A distant ranch
senses.definition: a place measured by distance and isolation
senses.definitionCN: 以距离与孤立来衡量的地方
senses.example: The nearest ranch was a day's ride across the plain.
senses.exampleCN: 最近的牧场要横穿平原骑一天马。
senses.why: The sense is about separation, not agriculture.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项关乎隔绝，而非农业。

senses.title: Versus farm
senses.definition: open grazing land, as opposed to cultivated fields
senses.definitionCN: 开阔的放牧地，与耕作田地相对
senses.example: A farm grows crops; a ranch raises stock.
senses.exampleCN: farm 种庄稼，ranch 养牲畜。
senses.why: The pair separates two ways of working the same ground.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把同一片土地上的两种经营方式分开。

intro.en: Ranch comes from Spanish rancho, 'a group of people eating together', which named a hut and then a grazing farm.
intro.cn: ranch 来自西班牙语 rancho（一起吃饭的一群人），先指简陋住处，后指放牧农场。

items.en: Rancho first named a mess or a shared meal.
items.cn: rancho 最初指集体用餐或餐桌。

items.en: It then named a rough dwelling for workers.
items.cn: 随后指工人的简陋住处。

items.en: Mexican usage applied it to grazing estates.
items.cn: 墨西哥用法把它用在放牧庄园上。

items.en: English settlers carried the word north.
items.cn: 英国移民把这个词带向北方。

items.en: Today it covers cattle, sheep and guest farms.
items.cn: 今天它覆盖养牛、养羊与接待客人的农场。

note.en: The look-alike group is the ranch- family; the near-meaning group separates farm, estate, station and homestead.
note.cn: 形近组是 ranch 词族；近义组把「农场」「庄园」「牧站」「宅地」分开。

entries.definition: land used to grow crops or keep stock.
entries.definitionCN: 种庄稼或养牲畜的土地。

entries.definition: a large area of owned land.
a sheep or cattle property in Australia.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of open grass, a long fence and slow cattle.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「开阔草地、长围栏、慢慢走的牛」的画面。

normal.en: Ranch sounds like branch but means land: one grows on trees, one grows cattle.
normal.cn: ranch 听起来像 branch，却指土地：一个长在树上，一个养着牛。

normal.en: Picture a fence climbing a hill until it disappears.
normal.cn: 想象一道围栏爬上山坡，直到看不见。

normal.en: Say RAANCH; the vowel is long and open like the plain.
normal.cn: 读 RAANCH，元音长而开阔，像平原一样。

normal.en: A ranch hand works, a rancher owns, a dude ranch sells the day.
normal.cn: 牧场工人干活，牧场主拥有，度假牧场出售一天的生活。

normal.en: Farm grows crops; ranch raises stock.
normal.cn: farm 种作物，ranch 养牲畜。

abstract.en: A ranch is a business measured in acres and patience.
abstract.cn: 牧场是一门以英亩与耐心计量的生意。

abstract.en: The word carries the West as an image, even when the land is ordinary.
abstract.cn: 这个词带着西部的意象，哪怕土地很普通。

abstract.en: Distance is part of the meaning: a ranch is somewhere you must ride to.
abstract.cn: 距离是词义的一部分：牧场是你必须骑马才能到的地方。

examples.en: His family had ranched the valley for three generations.
examples.cn: 他家在这个山谷经营牧场已经三代。

examples.en: A ranch hand checked the water trough before dawn.
examples.cn: 一名牧场工人在天亮前检查了水槽。
