examples.en: The nearest ranch was a day's ride across the plain.
examples.cn: 最近的牧场要横穿平原骑一天马。

dict_mnemonic.text: ranch 音近 branch，但牧场长的是牛，不是树枝。

root: 西班牙语 rancho（集体用餐处、简陋住处）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses work the same land: cattle, the livelihood, the house, the hands, the guests, the sheep, the distance and the contrast with a crop farm.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项经营同一片土地：牛群、生计、住宅、工人、客人、羊群、距离，以及与作物农场的对照。

core.en: OPEN GRASS BEHIND A FENCE

branches.en: The livelihood and the people it hires.
branches.cn: 生计与它雇用的人。

branches.en: Cattle and sheep as the stock raised.
branches.cn: 作为饲养对象的牛与羊。

branches.en: The house that faces the hills.
branches.cn: 面朝群山的住宅。

branches.en: The farm sold as an experience.
branches.cn: 被当作体验出售的农场。

branches.en: Isolation and the line to a crop farm.
branches.cn: 隔绝以及与作物农场的界线。

intro.en: The ranch- family is small and Western: ranch, rancher and ranching all describe the same holding and the people who work it.
intro.cn: ranch 词族小而带西部味：ranch、rancher、ranching 都描述同一片土地与经营它的人。

latinIntro.en: Spanish rancho is the direct source; it probably goes back to a Latin word for a shared meal, which explains the early sense of a workers' hut.
latinIntro.cn: 西班牙语 rancho 是直接来源；它很可能回到拉丁语指共餐的词，这也解释了早先「工人棚屋」的意思。

items.exampleCN: 一位有经验的牧场工人。

definition_zh: 全神贯注地；入迷地；着了魔似地
definition_en: in a state of complete attention, as if carried away
core_image: 一圈人围坐着听故事，谁也没有动一下
scene: 孩子们围在火边听故事，连呼吸都放轻了。The children listened raptly by the fire and hardly dared to breathe.
sceneCN: 这里 raptly 指全神贯注地（第 1 个义项：听得入迷）；句意为孩子们围在火边听故事，连呼吸都放轻了。

pos.zh: 全神贯注地；入迷地

senses.title: Absorbed in something
senses.definition: with attention so complete that the self and the surroundings drop away
senses.definitionCN: 专注到忘我、周围的一切都退开
senses.example: The hall listened raptly as the old man told his story.
senses.exampleCN: 老人讲故事时，整个大厅的人都听得入迷。
senses.why: This is the everyday sense: raptly describes attention that has been taken over, not attention merely offered.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常最常用的一层：raptly 写的是注意力被拿走，而不是自己把注意力交出去。

senses.title: In a state of rapture
senses.titleCN: 欣喜若狂地；如痴如醉地
senses.definition: carried out of oneself by joy or wonder
senses.definitionCN: 因喜悦或惊叹而忘形
senses.example: She smiled raptly at the first snow of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 看着那年第一场雪，她欣喜若狂地笑了。
senses.why: The older sense survives in rapture: the feeling is joy, not study.
senses.whyCN: 更古老的一层保存在 rapture（狂喜）里：这里是被喜悦带走，不是读书读到入迷。

intro.en: Raptly is the adverb of rapt, from Latin raptus, 'seized and carried away'.
intro.cn: raptly 是 rapt 的副词，rapt 来自拉丁语 raptus（被抓住并带走）。

items.en: Rapere meant to seize and carry off.
items.cn: rapere 意为抓住并带走。

items.en: Raptus named the act of being carried away.
items.cn: raptus 指被带走的状态。

items.en: English used rapt for a mind lifted out of itself.
items.cn: 英语用 rapt 指脱离自身的头脑。

items.en: The same root gave rapture, a transport of joy.
items.cn: 同一词根给出 rapture（狂喜的忘形）。

items.en: Today rapt usually means absorbed, not ecstatic.
items.cn: 今天 rapt 通常指专注，而不是狂喜。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rapt- family; the near-meaning group separates attentively, intently, engrossed and spellbound.
note.cn: 形近组是 rapt 词族；近义组把「专注地」「专心地」「全神投入」「着迷」分开。

entries.definitionCN: 带着强烈而固定的目的。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a circle of listeners who have stopped moving.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一圈听者连动都不动了」的画面。

normal.en: Raptly comes from rapt, which means carried off: attention kidnaps you.
normal.cn: raptly 来自 rapt（被带走）：注意力把你绑走了。

normal.en: Picture a fire, a story and a row of still faces.
normal.cn: 想象一堆火、一个故事，和一排静止的脸。

normal.en: Say RAPT-lee; it sounds like wrapped, as if wrapped up in a story.
normal.cn: 读 RAPT-lee，听起来像 wrapped，仿佛被故事裹住。

normal.en: The word describes the outside as much as the inside: nobody moves.
normal.cn: 这个词既写内心也写外表：没有人动。

normal.en: Ask whether the attention was given or taken.
normal.cn: 问一句：这份注意力是被付出的，还是被夺走的？

abstract.en: Raptly is what attention looks like when it stops being effort.
abstract.cn: raptly 是注意力不再费力时的样子。

abstract.en: The word remembers its violent root: to be absorbed is to be carried away.
abstract.cn: 这个词记得它暴烈的词根：被吸住就是被带走。

abstract.en: A rapt audience is a gift and a risk, because it can be held by anything.
abstract.cn: 入迷的观众是礼物也是风险，因为它可以被任何东西握住。

examples.en: The crowd watched raptly as the rope walker crossed the gap.
examples.cn: 走绳者越过缺口时，人群全神贯注地看着。

examples.en: She read raptly until the lamp burned out.
examples.cn: 她读得入迷，直到灯油耗尽。

examples.en: The students were raptly absorbed in the experiment.
examples.cn: 学生们完全被实验吸住了。

dict_mnemonic.text: rapt（被带走）+ ly → 魂被带走般地听着。

root: 拉丁语 rapere（抓住带走）→ raptus

sensesIntro.en: Raptly has two senses: attention taken over by something outside you, and the rarer rapture that the noun rapture still keeps.
sensesIntro.cn: raptly 有两层：被身外之物接管的注意力，以及名词 rapture 仍然保留的那层较罕见的狂喜。

core.en: A STILL RING OF LISTENERS

branches.en: An ear, an eye or a page that takes the mind.
branches.cn: 把心神拿走的耳朵、眼睛或书页。

branches.en: A body that stops moving while a story lasts.
branches.cn: 故事还在，身体已经不动。

branches.en: Joy that lifts a person out of himself.
branches.cn: 把人带出自身的喜悦。

branches.en: Both are states of being carried away.
branches.cn: 两者都是被带走的状态。

branches.en: The warmer, older sense kept in rapture.
branches.cn: 保存在 rapture 里更温暖、更古老的一层。

intro.en: The rapt- family keeps the sense of being carried off: rapt, raptly, rapture and enraptured all describe a mind taken somewhere else.
intro.cn: rapt 词族保留「被带走」的意思：rapt、raptly、rapture、enraptured 都描述被带到别处的头脑。

latinIntro.en: Latin rapere gives raptus, the participle of seizure; English kept the image and softened the violence into delight or attention.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rapere 给出分词 raptus（被夺取）；英语保留意象，把暴力软化成喜悦或专注。

definition_zh: 无赖；骗子；小淘气；〔古〕下等人
definition_en: a dishonest person, a mischievous child spoken of with affection, or an old word for one of the rabble
core_image: 一个孩子嘴角还沾着果酱，却笑着摇头说不是自己
scene: 那孩子偷吃了果酱，被问起时还笑着摇头否认。The child had eaten the jam and, when asked, shook his head with the smile of a rascal.
sceneCN: 这里 rascal 指小淘气（第 2 个义项：过错很小、被笑着原谅的孩子）；句意为那孩子偷吃了果酱，被问起时还笑着摇头否认。

pos.zh: 无赖；骗子；小淘气；〔古〕下等人

senses.title: A dishonest person
senses.definition: a person who lies or cheats to get what he wants
senses.definitionCN: 为得到想要的东西而撒谎或行骗的人
senses.example: The landlord was a rascal who raised the rents twice a year.
senses.exampleCN: 那房东是个无赖，一年涨两次租。
senses.why: This is the plain, cold sense; no affection softens it.
senses.whyCN: 这是最直白、最冷的一层，没有任何亲昵来软化它。

senses.title: A mischievous child
senses.definition: a child whose small tricks are forgiven because they are funny
senses.definitionCN: 因为小把戏好笑而被原谅的孩子
senses.example: The child had eaten the jam and shook his head like a rascal.
senses.exampleCN: 那孩子偷吃了果酱，还像个小淘气一样摇头否认。
senses.why: Tone decides this sense: the same fault is reported with a smile, and blame turns into fondness.
senses.whyCN: 语气决定了这一层：同样的过错被带笑地说出来，责备就变成了疼爱。

senses.title: (Archaic) a low-born person
senses.definition: an old use for one of the rabble, before the word narrowed to a single man
senses.definitionCN: 旧时指乌合之众中的一员，那时这个词还没有收窄到一个人
senses.example: In old comedy the rascal is usually a quick-tongued servant.
senses.exampleCN: 在旧喜剧里，这种下等人通常是嘴快的仆人。
senses.why: The fourteenth-century sense explains the word's origin: rascaille first meant a crowd, not a person.
senses.whyCN: 十四世纪的那层意思解释了这个词的来历：rascaille 最初指一群人，而不是一个人。

intro.en: Rascal came through Old French from a Latin word for a shaven head or a common soldier.
intro.cn: rascal 经古法语，来自拉丁语指剃头者或普通士兵的词。

items.en: Rasus meant shaved or scraped.
items.cn: rasus 意为剃过的、刮过的。

items.en: French used rascaille for the rabble.
items.cn: 法语用 rascaille 指乌合之众。

items.en: English first used rascal for a low-born person.
items.cn: 英语最初用 rascal 指出身低微的人。

items.en: The sense moved to a dishonest man.
items.cn: 词义转向不诚实的人。

items.en: The word now often softens into a term of affection.
items.cn: 今天这个词常软化成亲昵的称呼。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rasc- family; the near-meaning group separates scoundrel, rogue, imp and scalawag.
note.cn: 形近组是 rasc 词族；近义组把「恶棍」「浪子」「小淘气」「无赖」分开。

entries.definition: a rough file or a harsh sound.
an American word for a rascal.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a child with jam on his lip, shaking his head.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「孩子嘴角沾着果酱，却还在摇头」的画面。

normal.en: Rascal sounds like rustle: something small has been moved.
normal.cn: rascal 听起来像 rustle：有什么小东西被挪动了。

normal.en: Picture a jam jar, a spoon and a very innocent face.
normal.cn: 想象一个果酱罐、一把勺子，和一张非常无辜的脸。

normal.en: Say RAS-kul; the second syllable is swallowed.
normal.cn: 读 RAS-kul，第二音节被吞掉。

normal.en: The word can be an insult or a hug, depending on the tone.
normal.cn: 这个词可以是骂人，也可以是拥抱，全看语气。

normal.en: Ask the size of the offence: petty charm or real harm?
normal.cn: 问过错的大小：是小巧的魅力，还是真实的伤害？

abstract.en: A rascal is a fault with a smile attached.
abstract.cn: rascal 是附带微笑的过错。

abstract.en: The word shows how tone can change blame into affection without changing the facts.
abstract.cn: 这个词显示语气如何在不改变事实的情况下，把责备变成亲昵。

abstract.en: Every community needs a rascal to test its rules and keep its stories.
abstract.cn: 每个社群都需要一个无赖来检验规则、维持故事。

examples.en: The landlord was an utter rascal who raised rents twice a year.
examples.cn: 那房东是个十足的无赖，一年涨两次租。

examples.en: He was a charming rascal and everybody knew it.
examples.cn: 他是个有魅力的坏家伙，人人都知道。

examples.en: The rascally trick cost the shop only a few coins.
examples.cn: 那点无赖伎俩只让店里损失了几枚硬币。

dict_mnemonic.text: rascal 里有 rasc：小打小闹的坏，常带着笑。

root: 拉丁语 rasus（剃过的）→ 古法语 rascaille（乌合之众）

sensesIntro.en: Rascal has three senses: a dishonest man, an affectionate name for a mischievous child, and an archaic word for one of the rabble.
sensesIntro.cn: rascal 有三层：不诚实的无赖、对小淘气的亲昵称呼，以及旧时指乌合之众一员的用法。

core.en: JAM ON A SMILING FACE

branches.en: The cheat who is not forgiven.
branches.cn: 不被原谅的骗子。

branches.en: The child whose fault is small and funny.
branches.cn: 过错很小、很好笑的孩子。

branches.en: One word, two tones: blame or affection.
branches.cn: 同一个词，两种语气：责备或疼爱。

branches.en: The archaic crowd word behind the modern insult.
branches.cn: 现代骂名背后那个古老的群体词。

branches.en: From a whole rabble to one smiling face.
branches.cn: 从一整群乌合之众到一张笑脸。

intro.en: The rasc- family is thin but lively: rascal, rascally and rascality all describe small dishonesty with a grin.
intro.cn: rasc 词族不厚却活泼：rascal、rascally、rascality 都描述带笑的小不诚实。

latinIntro.en: Latin rasus, 'scraped bare', gave French rascaille, the rabble; English softened the crowd word into one person.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rasus（刮得精光）给出法语 rascaille（乌合之众）；英语把这个群体词软化成一个人。

definition_zh: 响尾蛇；[喻] 阴险的人、暗藏危险者
definition_en: a poisonous snake that shakes its tail to make a rattling warning
core_image: 沙地上一段盘起的身体，尾巴抬起，发出干燥的沙沙声
scene: 沙地上一条蛇抬起尾端，干燥的响声先于它的动作出现。On the sand a rattlesnake lifted its tail, and the dry sound came before any movement.
sceneCN: 这里 rattlesnake 指响尾蛇（第 1 个义项：会摇尾发声的蛇）；句意为沙地上一条响尾蛇抬起尾端，干燥的响声先于它的动作出现。

pos.zh: 响尾蛇；阴险的人

senses.title: The snake and its rattle
senses.definition: a venomous American snake whose jointed tail rattles as a warning before it strikes
senses.definitionCN: 一种美洲毒蛇，尾端有环节，在攻击之前摇动发声以示警告
senses.example: On the sand a rattlesnake lifted its tail, and the dry sound came before any movement.
senses.exampleCN: 沙地上一条响尾蛇抬起尾端，干燥的响声先于它的动作出现。
senses.why: The name is the animal and the sound together: rattle plus snake, a warning built into the body.
senses.whyCN: 名字把动物和声音合在一起：rattle 加 snake，警告器长在身体里。

senses.title: A treacherous person
senses.definition: a person who gives friendly signals and strikes anyway, or hides a threat under a calm manner
senses.definitionCN: 发出友善信号却照样下手的人，或把危险藏在温和外表下的人
senses.example: He was a rattlesnake in negotiations, smiling before he bit.
senses.exampleCN: 他在谈判中像条响尾蛇，咬人之前还先笑。
senses.why: The figure keeps the warning and drops the mercy, and that is where the insult lies.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻留下警告、丢掉仁慈，侮辱性正来自这里：会响，却照样咬。

intro.en: Rattlesnake is an English compound of rattle and snake, named for the sound of its tail.
intro.cn: rattlesnake 是 rattle 与 snake 的英语复合词，因尾部声响得名。

items.en: Rattle first meant to make a quick knocking sound.
items.cn: rattle 最初指发出急促敲击声。

items.en: Snake has named the animal since Old English.
items.cn: snake 自古英语起就指这种动物。

items.en: Settlers in America named the species by its noise.
items.cn: 美洲移民按它的声响为这个物种命名。

items.en: Naturalists fixed the compound in print.
items.cn: 博物学家把这个复合词固定进书里。

items.en: Writers borrowed it for a treacherous person.
items.cn: 作家借它指阴险的人。

note.en: The look-alike group is the rattle- family; the near-meaning group separates viper, copperhead, adder and serpent.
note.cn: 形近组是 rattle 词族；近义组把「蝰蛇」「铜头蛇」「毒蛇」「巨蛇」分开。

entries.definition: to make a quick knocking sound.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a tail lifted on sand and a dry sound arriving first.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「沙地上抬起的尾巴，干燥的响声先到」的画面。

normal.en: Rattlesnake is rattle plus snake: the name is the sound.
normal.cn: rattlesnake 是 rattle 加 snake：名字就是那个声音。

normal.en: Picture a warning arriving before the body moves.
normal.cn: 想象警告先于身体的动作到达。

normal.en: Say RAT-l-snayk; the middle is thin and quick.
normal.cn: 读 RAT-l-snayk，中间又薄又快。

normal.en: The metaphor keeps the warning and drops the mercy.
normal.cn: 这个比喻留下警告，丢掉仁慈。

normal.en: Ask whether a warning is kindness or a threat made polite.
normal.cn: 问一句：警告是善意，还是被说得客气的威胁？

abstract.en: A rattlesnake is danger with a public address system.
abstract.cn: 响尾蛇是装了广播的危险。

abstract.en: The sound is a contract: I have told you, so what follows is your choice.
abstract.cn: 那声音是一份契约：我已经告诉你了，接下来的就是你的选择。

abstract.en: The word teaches that warnings are only mercy when the striker can be avoided.
abstract.cn: 这个词教人：只有攻击能被避开时，警告才算仁慈。

examples.en: The rattlesnake's rattle is a warning, and a warning is a kind of mercy.
examples.cn: 响尾蛇的尾响是一种警告，而警告也是一种仁慈。

examples.en: He was a rattlesnake in negotiations, smiling before he bit.
examples.cn: 他在谈判中像条响尾蛇，咬人之前还先笑。

examples.en: A rattlesnake gives a warning you can hear before it strikes.
examples.cn: 响尾蛇在攻击之前，会给出一个你听得见的警告。

dict_mnemonic.text: rattle（沙沙响）+ snake（蛇）→ 会摇响的蛇。

root: 英语 rattle（急促响声）+ snake（蛇）

sensesIntro.en: Rattlesnake has two senses: the animal with a built-in warning, and the person whose courtesy hides a strike.
sensesIntro.cn: 响尾蛇有两层：带着天生警报器的动物，以及用客气藏起攻击的人。

core.en: A DRY SOUND ON SAND

branches.en: The animal and the jointed tail that warns.
branches.cn: 动物与发出警告的环节状尾。

branches.en: A dry sound crossing open sand.
branches.cn: 在空旷沙地上传开的一声干响。

branches.en: The human double who warns and bites.
branches.cn: 既警告又咬人的人类替身。

branches.en: Mercy kept in the snake, removed in the figure.
branches.cn: 仁慈在蛇身上还在，在比喻里被拿掉。

branches.en: Courtesy read as a threat made polite.
branches.cn: 被读成「说得客气的威胁」的客气。

intro.en: The rattle- family is built on sound: rattle, rattling, rattled and rattlesnake all begin with a quick knocking noise.
intro.cn: rattle 词族建立在声音上：rattle、rattling、rattled、rattlesnake 都从急促的敲击声开始。

latinIntro.en: Both parts are English; snake goes back to Old English snaca, and rattle is probably imitative of the sound itself.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部件都是英语；snake 可追到古英语 snaca，rattle 很可能是对声音本身的模仿。

items.meaning: a toy or plant that rattles

definition_zh: 饿极了的；贪婪的；贪得无厌的
definition_en: extremely hungry, or eager to consume something in large amounts
core_image: 一个人盯着桌上的面包，眼睛比手先动
scene: 队伍两天没吃东西，一见到面包就扑了上去。After two days without food, the group fell on the bread like ravenous animals.
sceneCN: 这里 ravenous 指饿极了的（第 1 个义项：极度饥饿）；句意为队伍两天没吃东西，一见到面包就扑了上去。

pos.zh: 饿极了的；贪婪的；贪得无厌的

senses.title: Extremely hungry
senses.definition: so hungry that food fills the mind and the body moves before it thinks
senses.definitionCN: 饿到食物占满头脑、身体先于思考而动
senses.example: After two days without food, the group fell on the bread like ravenous animals.
senses.exampleCN: 两天没吃东西之后，队伍像饿极了的野兽一样扑向面包。
senses.why: This is the physical sense, and it keeps the violence of the Latin root inside a hungry body.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体的一层，它把拉丁词根里的那股猛劲留在饥饿的身体上。

senses.title: Greedily eager for something
senses.titleCN: 贪婪渴求的；贪得无厌的
senses.definition: eager to take in something other than food, such as news, power or resources, in amounts that cannot be satisfied
senses.definitionCN: 对食物以外的东西（消息、权力、资源）渴求到无法满足
senses.example: The reporters were ravenous for any detail of the case.
senses.exampleCN: 记者们贪求这个案子的一切细节。
senses.why: The hunger moves from stomach to another appetite, while the word keeps its taking edge.
senses.whyCN: 饥饿从胃移到了另一种欲望上，而那个伸手就拿的锋芒还在。

intro.en: Ravenous comes from Latin ravinosus, 'given to seizing', from ravere, a form linked to rapacity.
intro.cn: ravenous 来自拉丁语 ravinosus（惯于夺取的），与表示掠夺的词相关。

items.en: Rapere meant to seize and carry off.
items.cn: rapere 意为抓住带走。

items.en: Ravina named a rushing or a seizure.
items.cn: ravina 指猛冲或夺取。

items.en: The adjective described a seizing hunger.
items.cn: 这个形容词描述夺取般的饥饿。

items.en: English used ravenous for extreme hunger.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪用 ravenous 指极度饥饿。

items.en: The word now also describes greedy use of resources.
items.cn: 今天这个词也描述对资源的贪婪使用。

note.en: The look-alike group is the raven- family; the near-meaning group separates starving, famished, voracious and insatiable.
note.cn: 形近组是 raven 词族；近义组把「濒饿的」「饿坏的」「贪婪的」「无法满足的」分开。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a hand reaching before the mind has spoken.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「手在头脑开口之前先伸出去」的画面。

normal.en: Ravenous shares a root with ravenous beasts and rapacity: hunger that grabs.
normal.cn: ravenous 与掠夺同根：会抓取的饥饿。

normal.en: Picture a loaf on a table and a whole group moving at once.
normal.cn: 想象桌上一条面包，一整群人在同一刻动起来。

normal.en: Say RAV-e-nus; the middle sounds like ravine.
normal.cn: 读 RAV-e-nus，中间听起来像 ravine。

normal.en: The word can describe appetite for food, news or water use.
normal.cn: 这个词可以描述对食物、消息或水资源的胃口。

normal.en: Ask whether the hunger is a body or a system.
normal.cn: 问一句：这饥饿属于一具身体，还是一个系统？

abstract.en: Ravenous describes need that has begun to look like appetite.
abstract.cn: ravenous 描述一种已经开始像胃口的需要。

abstract.en: The word makes hunger active: it reaches, it takes, it does not wait.
abstract.cn: 这个词让饥饿变成主动的：它伸手、它拿取、它不等。

abstract.en: Every economy has a ravenous edge where demand outruns supply.
abstract.cn: 每个经济体都有一条贪婪的边，那里需求跑在供给前面。

examples.en: The long walk gave the children a ravenous appetite.
examples.cn: 长途步行让孩子们胃口大开。

examples.en: The reporters were ravenous for any detail of the case.
examples.cn: 记者们急于吞下这个案子的任何细节。

examples.en: The city's ravenous consumption of water emptied the reservoir.
examples.cn: 这座城市对水的贪婪消耗掏空了水库。

dict_mnemonic.text: raven（猛夺）+ ous（充满）→ 饿得像要抢食一样。

root: 拉丁语 rapere（夺取）→ ravinosus（惯于夺取的）

sensesIntro.en: Ravenous has two senses: a body made violent by hunger, and a hunger of the mind that no amount can satisfy.
sensesIntro.cn: ravenous 有两层：被饥饿变得凶猛的身体，以及任何数量都无法满足的头脑之饥。

core.en: A HAND REACHING FIRST

branches.en: The body that reaches before it thinks.
branches.cn: 先伸手、后思考的身体。

branches.en: Bread, and hands moving at once.
branches.cn: 面包，以及同时伸出的手。

branches.en: Hunger moved to news, books or resources.
branches.cn: 饥饿移向消息、书本或资源。

branches.en: Food in one sense, everything else in the other.
branches.cn: 一层是食物，另一层是食物之外的一切。

branches.en: A hunger that consumption cannot end.
branches.cn: 消耗无法终止的饥饿。

intro.en: The ravenous family is built on grabbing: ravenous, ravenously and ravenousness all keep the sense of a hunger that takes.
intro.cn: ravenous 词族建立在抓取上：ravenous、ravenously、ravenousness 都保留「会拿取的饥饿」这层意思。

latinIntro.en: Latin rapere, 'to seize', gives ravina and ravinosus; the English word kept the violence and lost the Latin noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rapere（夺取）给出 ravina 与 ravinosus；英语保留暴力感，丢掉了拉丁名词。

definition_zh: 人造丝；粘胶纤维；人造丝织物
definition_en: a manufactured fibre made from cellulose, used like silk
core_image: 一匹光滑发亮的布，摸起来凉，标签上写着不是蚕丝
scene: 衣架上挂着一条光滑的裙子，标签上写的是人造丝。A smooth dress hung on the rail, and its label said the cloth was rayon.
sceneCN: 这里 rayon 指人造丝（第 1 个义项：人造的丝状纤维）；句意为衣架上挂着一条光滑的裙子，标签上写的是人造丝。

pos.zh: 人造丝；粘胶纤维；人造丝织物

senses.title: The manufactured fibre
senses.definition: a fibre spun from cellulose, chiefly wood pulp, and sold as a cheap substitute for silk
senses.definitionCN: 由纤维素（主要是木浆）纺成的纤维，作为蚕丝的廉价替代品出售
senses.example: A smooth dress hung on the rail, and its label said the cloth was rayon.
senses.exampleCN: 衣架上挂着一条光滑的裙子，标签上写着布料是人造丝。
senses.why: The word first names the fibre itself, and the name was coined to avoid saying silk.
senses.whyCN: 这个词首先指纤维本身；它本身就是为避开「丝」字而造出来的新词。

senses.title: Cloth or garments made of it
senses.titleCN: 人造丝织物；人造丝衣物
senses.definition: fabric woven from the fibre, or a garment made from that fabric, usually glossy and cheap
senses.definitionCN: 用这种纤维织成的布，或由此做成的衣服，通常有光泽而便宜
senses.example: The curtains were made of a heavy rayon fabric.
senses.exampleCN: 窗帘用的是厚重的人造丝面料。
senses.why: Trade and labels use the material name for the product, as they do with cotton or linen.
senses.whyCN: 和 cotton、linen 一样，行业与标签习惯用材料名直接指成品布。

intro.en: Rayon was coined around 1924 from ray, a beam of light, plus the ending -on, to suggest shiny cloth.
intro.cn: rayon 约在 1924 年由 ray（光线）加词尾 -on 造出，用来暗示有光泽的布。

items.en: The fibre is made from wood pulp treated with chemicals.
items.cn: 这种纤维由化学处理过的木浆制成。

items.en: It was first sold as artificial silk.
items.cn: 它最初以「人造丝」的名义出售。

items.en: American makers coined rayon to avoid the word silk.
items.cn: 美国厂商造出 rayon，以避开「丝」这个词。

items.en: Cheap glossy cloth changed everyday dress.
items.cn: 廉价而有光泽的布改变了日常衣着。

items.en: Today it is usually blended with other fibres.
items.cn: 今天它通常与其他纤维混纺。

note.en: The look-alike group is the ray- family; the near-meaning group separates silk, nylon, polyester and viscose.
note.cn: 形近组是 ray 词族；近义组把「蚕丝」「尼龙」「聚酯」「粘胶」分开。

entries.definition: a line of light or energy.
a fine fibre spun by silkworms.
the cellulose solution used for rayon.
entries.definitionCN: 用于制人造丝的纤维素溶液。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of glossy cloth and a label that denies the silkworm.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「有光泽的布，和一个否认蚕的标签」的画面。

normal.en: Rayon contains ray: the cloth was named for its shine.
normal.cn: rayon 里有 ray（光线）：这种布因光泽得名。

normal.en: Picture a dress that looks like silk under shop lights.
normal.cn: 想象一条在店灯下像丝的裙子。

normal.en: Say RAY-on; it sounds like a beam of light switched on.
normal.cn: 读 RAY-on，听起来像一束光被打开。

normal.en: Rayon comes from wood, not from a worm.
normal.cn: 人造丝来自木头，不是来自虫。

normal.en: The word always carries a small confession: it is an imitation.
normal.cn: 这个词总带着一点自白：它是仿的。

abstract.en: Rayon is a promise that luxury can be manufactured.
abstract.cn: 人造丝是一项承诺：奢侈可以被制造。

abstract.en: The name avoids the word silk because the law and the market both care about origin.
abstract.cn: 这个名字避开「丝」，因为法律与市场都在乎来源。

abstract.en: Every imitation teaches us which part of the original we actually valued.
abstract.cn: 每一种仿制品都在教我们：原物里我们真正看重的是哪一部分。

examples.en: The rayon dress looked expensive under the shop lights.
examples.cn: 那条人造丝连衣裙在店灯下看起来很贵。

examples.en: The curtains were made of a heavy rayon fabric.
examples.cn: 窗帘用的是厚重的人造丝面料。

examples.en: A rayon blend drapes well but creases easily.
examples.cn: 人造丝混纺垂感好，却容易起皱。

dict_mnemonic.text: ray（光线）+ on → 有光泽的人造丝。

root: 英语 ray（光线）+ -on（构词词尾，1924 年新造）

sensesIntro.en: Rayon has two senses: the cellulose fibre itself, and the cloth or garment woven from it.
sensesIntro.cn: rayon 有两层：纤维素纤维本身，以及用它织成的布或衣物。

core.en: GLOSS WITHOUT A WORM

branches.en: Wood pulp turned into thread.
branches.cn: 木浆变成纱线。

branches.en: Thread woven into glossy cloth.
branches.cn: 纱线织成有光泽的布。

branches.en: A dress that looks like silk under shop lights.
branches.cn: 在店灯下像丝的连衣裙。

branches.en: The fibre and every product that carries its name.
branches.cn: 纤维，以及所有以它为名的成品。

branches.en: Cheap shine sold as imitation luxury.
branches.cn: 当作仿制奢侈品出售的廉价光泽。

intro.en: The ray- family is small and bright: ray, rayon and array all keep a sense of lines or shine laid out.
intro.cn: ray 词族小而明亮：ray、rayon、array 都保留「线或光被铺开」的意思。

latinIntro.en: Rayon has no Latin root; it was coined in English from ray, which comes through French from Latin radius.
latinIntro.cn: rayon 没有拉丁词根；它是英语新造词，ray 经法语来自拉丁语 radius。

definition_zh: 可到达的；可联系上的；可实现的；可够到的
definition_en: possible to arrive at, contact or achieve
core_image: 地图上标着一条短路径，尽头就在手心够得到的地方
scene: 向导说山顶的营地在两小时脚程之内，天黑前一定到得了。The guide said the camp on the ridge was reachable in two hours before dark.
sceneCN: 这里 reachable 指可到达的（第 1 个义项：能够走到）；句意为向导说山顶的营地在两小时脚程之内，天黑前一定到得了。

pos.zh: 可到达的；可联系上的；可实现的

senses.title: Able to be arrived at
senses.definition: possible to arrive at, especially after a known distance or route
senses.definitionCN: 可以抵达的，尤指经过一段已知的距离或路线之后
senses.example: The guide said the camp on the ridge was reachable in two hours before dark.
senses.exampleCN: 向导说山顶的营地在两小时脚程之内，天黑前一定到得了。
senses.why: This is the map sense: reachable places are measured in roads and hours.
senses.whyCN: 这是地图上的一层：可达的地方用道路和小时来量。

senses.title: Able to be contacted
senses.definition: possible to get in touch with, by phone, message or another channel
senses.definitionCN: 可以通过电话、讯息或其他渠道联系到的
senses.example: The number was reachable only during office hours.
senses.exampleCN: 那个号码只在办公时间能打通。
senses.why: Contact replaces geography here: a signal can make a person reachable in an instant.
senses.whyCN: 这一层里联系取代了地理：一个信号就能让人瞬间可达。

senses.title: Able to be achieved
senses.definition: possible to achieve with the means and the time actually available
senses.definitionCN: 用实际可用的手段与时间能够做到的
senses.example: The first version of the product had to be reachable in three months.
senses.exampleCN: 产品的第一个版本必须在三个月内做出来。
senses.why: The word moves from distance to effort and asks what a given team can really finish.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从距离移到力气与时间，问的是一支具体的团队究竟能做完什么。

intro.en: Reachable joins reach, from Old English reccan, 'to stretch out', with -able.
intro.cn: reachable 把 reach（古英语 reccan，伸手）与 -able 组合在一起。

items.en: Reccan meant to stretch out a hand.
items.cn: reccan 意为伸出手。

items.en: Reach grew to mean arrive at or attain.
items.cn: reach 长成「抵达」或「达到」。

items.en: The ending marks what can be done.
items.cn: 词尾标记「能够被做到」。

items.en: Steam travel popularised reachable places.
items.cn: 蒸汽交通让「可达的地方」流行起来。

items.en: Today it also describes goals and budgets.
items.cn: 今天它也描述目标与预算。

note.en: The look-alike group is the reach- family; the near-meaning group separates accessible, attainable, available and approachable.
note.cn: 形近组是 reach 词族；近义组把「可进入的」「可达到的」「可获得的」「易接近的」分开。

entries.definition: to arrive at or stretch to.
able to be entered or used.
ready to be used or obtained.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a short path ending inside the hand's range.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一条短路径，尽头就在手能够到的范围」的画面。

normal.en: Reachable is reach plus able: a hand can get there.
normal.cn: reachable 是 reach 加 able：一只手能到那里。

normal.en: Picture a map with a dotted line short enough to walk.
normal.cn: 想象地图上一条短到可以走完的虚线。

normal.en: Say REE-chuh-bl; it sounds like a door that opens.
normal.cn: 读 REE-chuh-bl，听起来像一扇会开的门。

normal.en: The word covers roads, signals, goals and budgets.
normal.cn: 这个词覆盖道路、信号、目标和预算。

normal.en: Ask reachable for whom: a fit walker, a caller, a team, a grant?
normal.cn: 问对谁可达：健步的人、打电话的人、团队，还是一笔拨款？

abstract.en: Reachable is a map word that became a planning word.
abstract.cn: reachable 是一个地图词，后来成了计划词。

abstract.en: It measures the gap between desire and means without naming either.
abstract.cn: 它量的是欲望与手段之间的缝隙，却不点名任何一方。

abstract.en: What is reachable is not always what is worth reaching.
abstract.cn: 可达的，并不总是值得抵达的。

examples.en: The number was reachable only during office hours.
examples.cn: 那个号码只在办公时间能打通。

examples.en: The first version of the product had to be reachable in three months.
examples.cn: 产品的第一个版本必须在三个月内做出来。

examples.en: The chair proposed a smaller package that was actually reachable.
examples.cn: 主席提出了一个更小、实际可达成的方案。

dict_mnemonic.text: reach（伸手够到）+ able（能）→ 能够到的。

root: 古英语 reccan（伸出手）+ -able

sensesIntro.en: Reachable has three senses: a place you can arrive at, a person you can contact, and a result you can actually achieve.
sensesIntro.cn: reachable 有三层：能抵达的地方、能联系上的人、真正能做到的结果。

core.en: A PATH ENDING IN THE HAND

branches.en: A route and a measured number of hours.
branches.cn: 一条路线与量过的若干小时。

branches.en: A signal that finds a person.
branches.cn: 找到某人的一个信号。

branches.en: A target within the means at hand.
branches.cn: 手头手段之内的目标。

branches.en: Distance turned into effort and time.
branches.cn: 距离变成力气与时间。

branches.en: Reachable by phone, reachable on budget.
branches.cn: 电话可及，预算可及。

intro.en: The reach- family is about extending: reach, reachable, unreachable and reachably all describe how far an arm or a plan can go.
intro.cn: reach 词族讲的是伸展：reach、reachable、unreachable、reachably 都描述手臂或计划能走多远。

latinIntro.en: Old English reccan gives the verb; the -able ending came through French from Latin -abilis, meaning fit to be.
latinIntro.cn: 古英语 reccan 提供动词；-able 词尾经法语来自拉丁语 -abilis，意为「可以被……的」。

latinEntries.meaning: to stretch out in Old English

definition_zh: 反动的；反对变革的；反动分子
definition_en: opposing political or social change, often wanting to return to an earlier order
core_image: 一扇旧门被几个人合力顶住，门后的人还在喊「退回去」
scene: 镇上的老议员一听要拆旧钟楼，立刻站出来反对任何改动。The reactionary alderman opposed every plan to pull down the old clock tower.
sceneCN: 这里 reactionary 指反动的、反对变革的（第 1 个义项：反对改革）；句意为镇上的老议员一听要拆旧钟楼，立刻站出来反对任何改动。

pos.zh: 反动的；反对变革的
反动分子

senses.title: Opposed to change
senses.titleCN: 反动的；反对变革的（形容词）
senses.definition: opposing political or social change and wishing to restore an earlier order
senses.definitionCN: 反对政治或社会变革，希望恢复旧秩序的
senses.example: The reactionary policy rolled back the housing rules passed a year earlier.
senses.exampleCN: 这项反动政策撤销了一年以前通过的住房规定。
senses.why: The adjective is the label used in debate: it accuses a measure of moving backwards.
senses.whyCN: 形容词形态是辩论里用的标签：它指控一项措施在往后退。

senses.title: A person of that view
senses.definition: a person who works to undo reforms and bring back the old order
senses.definitionCN: 致力于撤销改革、恢复旧秩序的人
senses.example: The old reactionary called every new machine a waste of money.
senses.exampleCN: 那位老反动派把每一台新机器都称作浪费钱。
senses.why: The noun turns the accusation into an identity, which is why it is often a fighting word.
senses.whyCN: 名词形态把指控变成一种身份，所以它常常是骂战里的词。

intro.en: Reactionary comes from reaction, from Latin re- 'back' plus agere 'to do', and was first applied to politics after the French Revolution.
intro.cn: reactionary 来自 reaction，源于拉丁语 re-（向后）加 agere（做），法国大革命之后才用于政治。

items.en: Agere meant to do or drive.
items.cn: agere 意为做、驱动。

items.en: Re-action was a doing back, a return movement.
items.cn: re-action 是「做回去」，一种回退的运动。

items.en: French politics named those who wished to undo the revolution.
items.cn: 法国政治把想撤销革命的人命名出来。

items.en: English carried the label into debates on reform.
items.cn: 英语把这个标签带入改革的辩论。

items.en: The word now marks resistance to change in many fields.
items.cn: 今天这个词标记许多领域里对变革的抵抗。

note.en: The look-alike group is the react- family; the near-meaning group separates conservative, diehard, traditionalist and ultraconservative.
note.cn: 形近组是 react 词族；近义组把「保守的」「死硬的」「传统主义者」「极端保守的」分开。

entries.definition: a vessel or plant where reactions occur.
entries.definitionCN: 发生反应的容器或装置。

entries.definition: refusing to give up an old position.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of people holding an old door shut against a crowd.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一群人合力顶住旧门，不让外面的人进来」的画面。

normal.en: Reactionary is reaction plus ary: a person who does back.
normal.cn: reactionary 是 reaction 加 ary：一个「做回去」的人。

normal.en: Picture hands pressed on a door that should have been replaced.
normal.cn: 想象一双手按在一扇早该换掉的门上。

normal.en: Say ree-AK-shun-air-ee; the stress sits on AK.
normal.cn: 读 ree-AK-shun-air-ee，重音在 AK。

normal.en: The word is not neutral: it always accuses.
normal.cn: 这个词不中性：它总是在指控。

normal.en: Ask what is being restored, and for whom.
normal.cn: 问一句：要恢复的是什么，为谁恢复？

abstract.en: Reactionary measures time backwards: it treats an earlier order as the future.
abstract.cn: reactionary 把时间倒着量：它把旧秩序当作未来。

abstract.en: The label is a weapon in debate before it is a description of belief.
abstract.cn: 这个标签在成为信念的描述之前，先是一场辩论里的武器。

abstract.en: Every reactionary claim borrows the language of stability to justify reversal.
abstract.cn: 每一种反动主张都借稳定之名，为倒转辩护。

examples.en: Reactionary forces in the senate blocked the vote for months.
examples.cn: 参议院里的反动势力把表决拖了几个月。

examples.en: The reactionary policy rolled back the housing rules passed a year earlier.
examples.cn: 这项反动政策撤销了一年以前通过的住房规定。

examples.en: A conservative slows a reform; a reactionary tries to repeal it.
examples.cn: 保守派让改革变慢，反动派则想废除改革。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ action（行动）+ ary（人）→ 往回想把时间扳回去的人。

root: 拉丁语 re-（向后）+ agere（做）→ reaction（反动）+ -ary

sensesIntro.en: Reactionary has two senses, one for the policy and one for the person who holds it.
sensesIntro.cn: reactionary 有两层：一层说政策，一层说主张这种政策的人。

core.en: HANDS HOLDING AN OLD DOOR SHUT

branches.en: A measure that undoes a reform.
branches.cn: 撤销改革的措施。

branches.en: A person whose identity is resistance.
branches.cn: 以抵抗为身份的人。

branches.en: The label as a weapon in debate.
branches.cn: 作为辩论武器的标签。

branches.en: Restoring an earlier order by force.
branches.cn: 以武力恢复旧秩序。

branches.en: The word accuses before it describes.
branches.cn: 这个词先指控，再描述。

intro.en: The react- family all turns on doing back: react, reaction, reactionary and reactionism keep one idea of return.
intro.cn: react 词族都围绕「做回去」：react、reaction、reactionary、reactionism 保留同一个回退的念头。

latinIntro.en: Latin agere gives act and action; with re- the compound means to drive back, which politics later turned into a label.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 agere 给出 act 与 action；加上 re- 表示「往回驱动」，政治后来把它变成一个标签。

definition_zh: 可读的；易读的；字迹清晰的；值得一读的
definition_en: able to be read easily, either because the marks are clear or the writing holds attention
core_image: 一页字迹工整的稿纸，灯再暗也不用凑近去认
scene: 灯下那封信的字迹清楚，连最小的注脚都一眼能认出。The letter was readable even in the dim light of the lamp.
sceneCN: 这里 readable 指字迹清晰的、可读的（第 1 个义项：字迹可辨认）；句意为灯下那封信的字迹清楚，连最小的注脚都一眼能认出。

pos.zh: 可读的；易读的；字迹清晰的；值得一读的

senses.title: Clear enough to read
senses.definition: written or printed so clearly that the marks can be recognised without effort
senses.definitionCN: 书写或印刷得清楚，不用费力就能辨认
senses.example: Her readable handwriting made the marginal notes easy to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 她清晰的字迹让页边批注很容易跟上。
senses.why: This is the sense about the eye: the page asks nothing of the reader.
senses.whyCN: 这一层讲的是眼睛：纸页不向读者提任何要求。

senses.title: Worth reading
senses.titleCN: 值得一读的；引人入胜的
senses.definition: written in a way that holds a reader's attention and makes the time pass easily
senses.definitionCN: 写得能抓住读者注意力，让时间轻易过去
senses.example: The history was readable enough to finish on a train.
senses.exampleCN: 那本历史书写得够好读，一趟火车就能看完。
senses.why: Here the praise is for style and interest, not for the clarity of the marks.
senses.whyCN: 这一层赞的是文风和趣味，而不是笔迹有多清楚。

intro.en: Readable joins read, from Old English raedan, 'to interpret marks', with the ending -able.
intro.cn: readable 把 read（古英语 raedan，解读符号）与词尾 -able 组合起来。

items.en: Raedan meant to interpret or advise as well as to read.
items.cn: raedan 既指阅读，也指解读与劝告。

items.en: Read narrowed to the handling of written marks.
items.cn: read 后来收窄为处理书面符号。

items.en: The ending marks what can be done with ease.
items.cn: 词尾标记「可以顺利做到」。

items.en: Cheap printing made readable a selling word.
items.cn: 廉价印刷让 readable 成为卖点词。

items.en: Today it also judges screens, signs and code.
items.cn: 今天它也评判屏幕、标识与代码。

note.en: The look-alike group is the read- family; the near-meaning group separates legible, lucid, gripping and comprehensible.
note.cn: 形近组是 read 词族；近义组把「可辨认的」「清晰的」「引人入胜的」「可理解的」分开。

entries.definition: the act or a measurement taken.
entries.definitionCN: 阅读行为或读得的数值。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a page that asks nothing of the eye.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一页不向眼睛提任何要求」的画面。

normal.en: Readable is read plus able: reading costs nothing extra.
normal.cn: readable 是 read 加 able：阅读不必多付力气。

normal.en: Picture a page you can skim in bad light.
normal.cn: 想象一页在昏暗光线下也能略读过去的纸。

normal.en: Say REE-duh-bl; it sounds like something already open.
normal.cn: 读 REE-duh-bl，听起来像已经翻开的东西。

normal.en: The word judges two things: marks and momentum.
normal.cn: 这个词评判两样东西：符号与推进力。

normal.en: Ask readable to whom: a child, a scanner, a tired commuter?
normal.cn: 问对谁可读：孩子、扫描仪，还是疲惫的通勤者？

abstract.en: Readable is a courtesy paid by the writer to the stranger.
abstract.cn: readable 是写作者付给陌生人的一份礼貌。

abstract.en: Clarity and interest are different debts: one is owed to the eye, the other to time.
abstract.cn: 清晰与有趣是两笔不同的债：一笔欠眼睛，一笔欠时间。

abstract.en: What is readable survives copying; what is merely legible does not.
abstract.cn: 可读的东西经得起传抄，仅仅可辨的东西不行。

examples.en: Her readable handwriting made the marginal notes easy to follow.
examples.cn: 她清晰的字迹让页边批注很容易跟上。

examples.en: The history was readable enough to finish on a train.
examples.cn: 那本历史书写得够好读，一趟火车就能看完。

examples.en: Readable code saves more time than clever code.
examples.cn: 可读的代码比聪明的代码省下更多时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: read（读）+ able（能）→ 读得下去的。

root: 古英语 raedan（解读）+ -able

sensesIntro.en: Readable has two senses: clear marks, and writing interesting enough to carry a reader.
sensesIntro.cn: readable 有两层：清楚可辨的字迹，以及有趣到能带着读者走的文字。

core.en: A PAGE THAT ASKS NOTHING OF THE EYE
core.cn: 一页不向眼睛提要求的纸

branches.en: Ink clear enough for any eye.
branches.cn: 任何眼睛都能看清的墨迹。

branches.en: A text that holds a commuter to the end.
branches.cn: 让通勤者读到最后一页的文字。

branches.en: Clarity for the eye, interest for the time.
branches.cn: 给眼睛的清晰，给时间的趣味。

branches.en: A page read in bad light.
branches.cn: 在坏光线下也能读的一页。

branches.en: Style as a courtesy to the stranger.
branches.cn: 作为给陌生人的礼貌的文风。

intro.en: The read- family is about interpretation: read, reader, readable and readability all describe someone making sense of marks.
intro.cn: read 词族讲的是解读：read、reader、readable、readability 都描述有人把符号弄明白。

latinIntro.en: Old English raedan gives the verb; the -able ending came through French from Latin -abilis, 'fit to be'.
latinIntro.cn: 古英语 raedan 提供动词；-able 词尾经法语来自拉丁语 -abilis，意为「可以被……的」。

items.meaning: able to be read with ease
how easy a text is to read

definition_zh: 阅读；读物；读数；解读；（议会）一读
definition_en: the act of interpreting written signs, the figure shown by an instrument, or a particular interpretation
core_image: 一只手翻过书页，另一只手指着仪表上刚刚停下的数字
scene: 他把温度计的读数记在纸上，又回到窗边的那本书里。He wrote the reading from the thermometer on paper and went back to the book by the window.
sceneCN: 这里 reading 指仪表上的读数（第 2 个义项：仪表读数）；句意为他把温度计的读数记在纸上，又回到窗边的那本书里。

pos.zh: 阅读；读物；读数；解读；一读

senses.title: The act of reading
senses.definition: the activity of working through written marks and turning them into meaning
senses.definitionCN: 把书面符号一路读下去、变成意义的活动
senses.example: Her reading of the letter took less than a minute.
senses.exampleCN: 她读那封信用了不到一分钟。
senses.why: This is the plainest sense: an eye moving along a line until meaning appears.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的一层：目光沿着一行走过去，直到意义浮现。

senses.title: A figure shown by an instrument
senses.definition: the value a gauge, meter or dial shows at a given moment
senses.definitionCN: 仪表、量器或表盘在某一刻显示出的数值
senses.example: The pressure reading had not moved since morning.
senses.exampleCN: 压力读数从早晨起就没有动过。
senses.why: Instruments write their sentences in numbers, and the word lends them the act of interpretation.
senses.whyCN: 仪表用数字写句子，这个词把「解读」这个动作借给了它们。

senses.title: An interpretation
senses.definition: a particular way of understanding a text, an event or a situation
senses.definitionCN: 对文本、事件或局势的一种特定理解
senses.example: Her reading of the novel stressed the silence, not the speeches.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这部小说的解读强调的是沉默，而不是那些演讲。
senses.why: The act becomes a position: readers can disagree, so a reading can be right or wrong.
senses.whyCN: 动作变成了立场：读者会争论，所以一种解读可能是对的，也可能是错的。

senses.title: A public recital
senses.definition: an event at which a text, often poems, is spoken aloud to an audience
senses.definitionCN: 把文本（常是诗）当众念给听众听的活动
senses.example: The poet gave a reading in a half-empty hall.
senses.exampleCN: 诗人在一个半空的大厅里做了一场朗诵。
senses.why: Here the noun names a gathering on a calendar rather than a private act.
senses.whyCN: 这里名词指的是日程表上的一场活动，而不是私下里的动作。

senses.title: Assigned texts
senses.definition: the set of books and articles a course or a group is asked to study
senses.definitionCN: 一门课或一个小组被要求研读的一批书与文章
senses.example: The syllabus listed readings in law, history and economics.
senses.exampleCN: 教学大纲列出了法律、历史与经济学方面的读本。
senses.why: The plural turns the activity into a bundle of texts with a deadline.
senses.whyCN: 复数把这项活动变成一捆带截止日期的文本。

intro.en: Reading is the noun from read, from Old English raedan, which meant to interpret, advise or reckon as well as to read.
intro.cn: reading 是 read 的名词形式，源自古英语 raedan，兼有解读、劝告、估算与阅读等义。

items.en: Raedan covered reading, advising and reckoning.
items.cn: raedan 兼指阅读、劝告与估算。

items.en: The noun named the act and what was read aloud.
items.cn: 这个名词指阅读行为，也指被朗读的内容。

items.en: Later the word was applied to what a gauge reads.
items.cn: 后来这个词被用于仪表所读出的数值。

items.en: Public libraries made readings a shared noun.
items.cn: 公共图书馆让 readings 成为共享的词。

items.en: Today it covers texts, data and interpretations alike.
items.cn: 今天它同时覆盖文本、数据与解读。

note.en: The look-alike group is the read- family; the near-meaning group separates interpretation, recitation, measurement and perusal.
note.cn: 形近组是 read 词族；近义组把「解释」「背诵」「测量」「细读」分开。

entries.definition: a size or amount obtained by measuring.
entries.definitionCN: 测量所得的尺寸或数量。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of one hand on a page and one hand on a dial.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一只手在书页上，另一只手在表盘上」的画面。

normal.en: Reading is both an act and a number: the same word for two habits.
normal.cn: reading 既是动作也是数字：同一个词，两种习惯。

normal.en: Picture a thermometer and a book on the same desk.
normal.cn: 想象同一张桌上放着一支温度计和一本书。

normal.en: Say REE-ding; the word already sounds like a page turning.
normal.cn: 读 REE-ding，这个词本身就像翻页的声音。

normal.en: The plural readings usually means a set of texts or figures.
normal.cn: 复数 readings 通常指一套文本或一组数值。

normal.en: Ask which reading: of a bill, a gauge, a poem or a market?
normal.cn: 问是哪一种 reading：法案、仪表、诗，还是市场？

abstract.en: Reading is the point where the world is turned into signs and signs back into the world.
abstract.cn: reading 是世界变成符号、符号又变回世界的那个点。

abstract.en: Every instrument reading is a sentence the machine writes in numbers.
abstract.cn: 每一个仪表读数，都是机器用数字写下的一句话。

abstract.en: A reading of events is never neutral; it chooses what counts as evidence.
abstract.cn: 对事件的判断从不中性：它挑选什么算作证据。

examples.en: The pressure reading had not moved since morning.
examples.cn: 压力读数从早晨起就没有动过。

examples.en: Her reading of the novel stressed the silence, not the speeches.
examples.cn: 她对这部小说的解读强调的是沉默，而不是那些演讲。

examples.en: The bill failed at its second reading.
examples.cn: 这项法案在二读时失败了。

dict_mnemonic.text: read（读）+ ing（名词）→ 读这件事，以及读出来的数。

root: 古英语 raedan（解读、估算）+ -ing

sensesIntro.en: Reading has five senses: the act, an instrument's figure, an interpretation, a public recital and the texts assigned to a course.
sensesIntro.cn: reading 有五层：阅读行为、仪表读数、解读、朗读会，以及课程指定的读本。

core.en: A PAGE AND A DIAL ON ONE DESK
core.cn: 一张桌上的书页与表盘

branches.en: The act itself and the position it produces.
branches.cn: 阅读行为本身，以及它产生的立场。

branches.en: Figures from a dial, texts from a syllabus.
branches.cn: 表盘上的数值，教学大纲上的文本。

branches.en: The word as a public event.
branches.cn: 作为公共活动的这个词。

branches.en: A number that stands in for a sentence.
branches.cn: 代替一句话的那个数字。

branches.en: Understanding set against performance.
branches.cn: 理解与表演相对。

intro.en: The read- family keeps one root: read, reader, reading and readout all describe turning marks into meaning or numbers.
intro.cn: read 词族共用一个根：read、reader、reading、readout 都描述把符号变成意义或数字。

latinIntro.en: Old English raedan supplies the verb; the -ing noun ending is Germanic, not Latin, and the word never needed a borrowed suffix.
latinIntro.cn: 古英语 raedan 提供动词；-ing 名词词尾属日耳曼语而非拉丁语，这个词从不需要借来的后缀。

items.meaning: the act or a figure read

latinEntries.meaning: to reckon, a distant cousin in sense
latinEntries.meaningCN: 估算，意义上的一位远亲

definition_zh: 重新武装；重整军备；重新装备
definition_en: to equip an army or a country with weapons again, especially after disarmament
core_image: 仓库的门重新打开，木箱里取出的枪还裹着油纸
scene: 停战才过五年，边境的工厂又开始连夜造炮。Within five years of the truce the border factories were rearming.
sceneCN: 这里 rearm 指重整军备（第 1 个义项：重新武装军队）；句意为停战才过五年，边境的工厂又开始连夜造炮。

pos.zh: 重新武装；重整军备；重新装备

senses.title: To arm again
senses.definition: to supply a country or a force with weapons again, especially after disarmament or defeat
senses.definitionCN: 在解除武装或战败之后，再次向国家或部队供应武器
senses.example: The country began to rearm quietly after the defeat.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家在战败之后悄悄开始重整军备。
senses.why: The re- is the whole point: the weapons had been given up, and now they come back.
senses.whyCN: re- 是这个词的全部要害：武器已经交出去了，现在又回来。

senses.title: To equip with new weapons
senses.definition: to replace a force's old equipment with a newer generation of weapons
senses.definitionCN: 用更新一代的武器替换一支部队的旧装备
senses.example: The brigade rearmed with longer-range artillery.
senses.exampleCN: 这个旅换装了射程更远的火炮。
senses.why: Here the emphasis is on upgrading rather than restoring; the force was armed, but not with these.
senses.whyCN: 这一层重在升级而非恢复：部队本来有武器，只是不是这一批。

intro.en: Rearm joins the Latin prefix re-, 'again', to arm, from Latin arma, 'weapons or gear'.
intro.cn: rearm 把拉丁语前缀 re-（再次）加到 arm 上，arm 源自拉丁语 arma（武器、装备）。

items.en: Arma meant weapons and military equipment.
items.cn: arma 指武器与军事装备。

items.en: English arm meant to fit out for war.
items.cn: 英语 arm 意为为战争配备。

items.en: Disarm named the opposite act.
items.cn: disarm 命名相反的动作。

items.en: Rearm became urgent language after the Great War.
items.cn: 一战之后，rearm 成为紧迫的用语。

items.en: Today it also describes rebuilding any capacity.
items.cn: 今天它也描述重建任何能力。

note.en: The look-alike group is the arm- family; the near-meaning group separates remilitarize, mobilize, equip and refit.
note.cn: 形近组是 arm 词族；近义组把「重新军事化」「动员」「装备」「改装」分开。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a storehouse opened again and rifles still greased in paper.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「仓库再次打开，步枪还裹着油纸」的画面。

normal.en: Rearm is re plus arm: the weapons come back.
normal.cn: rearm 是 re 加 arm：武器回来了。

normal.en: Picture a crate opened after years, the oil paper still on the metal.
normal.cn: 想象多年之后打开一只木箱，金属上的油纸还在。

normal.en: Say ree-ARM; the stress falls on the short second syllable.
normal.cn: 读 ree-ARM，重音落在短的第二音节。

normal.en: The word always implies an earlier disarm.
normal.cn: 这个词总暗含一次更早的解除武装。

normal.en: Ask who pays for the rearming, and who is told it is temporary.
normal.cn: 问谁为重整军备付账，谁又被告诉这只是暂时的。

abstract.en: To rearm is to treat peace as an interval rather than an end.
abstract.cn: 重整军备是把和平当作间歇，而不是终点。

abstract.en: Weapons restored are not the same weapons: the second arming changes the first.
abstract.cn: 恢复的武器已不是原来的武器：第二次武装改变了第一次。

abstract.en: The word is neutral in grammar and accusing in history.
abstract.cn: 这个词在语法上中性，在历史里却带着指控。

examples.en: The country began to rearm quietly after the defeat.
examples.cn: 这个国家在战败之后悄悄开始重整军备。

examples.en: The brigade rearmed with longer-range artillery.
examples.cn: 这个旅换装了射程更远的火炮。

examples.en: Rearming absorbed the budget that had been promised to schools.
examples.cn: 重整军备吞掉了原本承诺给学校的预算。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再次）+ arm（武装）→ 再把武器发下去。

root: 拉丁语 arma（武器）+ re-（再次）

sensesIntro.en: Rearm has two senses: bringing weapons back after they were given up, and fitting a force out with newer ones.
sensesIntro.cn: rearm 有两层：交出武器之后把它拿回来，以及给部队换上更新的一代。

core.en: A CRATE OPENED AGAIN

branches.en: A treaty, then factories restarting.
branches.cn: 一份条约，然后工厂重新开工。

branches.en: Old guns replaced by longer-range ones.
branches.cn: 旧炮换成射程更远的炮。

branches.en: Peace treated as an interval.
branches.cn: 被当作间歇的和平。

branches.en: An upgrade rather than a restoration.
branches.cn: 升级而不是恢复。

branches.en: Arming again, and arming better.
branches.cn: 重新武装，以及武装得更好。

intro.en: The arm- family runs both ways: arm and rearm add weapons, disarm removes them, and armament names the whole apparatus.
intro.cn: arm 词族可以两头走：arm 与 rearm 增加武器，disarm 拿走武器，armament 命名整套装置。

latinIntro.en: Latin arma gives arm, armament and disarm through French forms; re- is the Latin prefix of repetition.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 arma 经法语形式给出 arm、armament、disarm；re- 是表示重复的拉丁语前缀。

items.exampleCN: 一个正在重整军备的国家。

definition_zh: 重新评估；重新考虑；重新掂量
definition_en: to judge the value, risk or worth of something again, usually because circumstances have changed
core_image: 一叠旧报表被推到桌边，一只手拿起了新的那一页
scene: 项目做到一半，账上的数字对不上了，团队只好把整个计划重新掂量一遍。Halfway through the project the figures no longer matched, and the team had to reassess the whole plan.
sceneCN: 这里 reassess 指重新评估（第 1 个义项：重新评估计划）；句意为项目做到一半，账上的数字对不上了，团队只好把整个计划重新掂量一遍。

pos.zh: 重新评估；重新考虑；重新掂量

collocations.zh: 在结果出来之后重新评估

senses.title: To reassess a plan
senses.definition: to judge a plan again after its assumptions have shifted
senses.definitionCN: 在假设发生变化之后重新判断一个计划
senses.example: The team had to reassess the plan after the second delay.
senses.exampleCN: 第二次延误之后，团队不得不重新评估这个计划。
senses.why: The first sense is the practical one: the ground moved.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是最实际的：地基移动了。

senses.title: To reassess the risk
senses.definition: to recalculate how dangerous something is with new evidence
senses.definitionCN: 用新证据重新衡量某事的危险程度
senses.example: The bank reassessed the risk of the loan after the audit.
senses.exampleCN: 审计之后，银行重新评估了这笔贷款的风险。
senses.why: Risk is the word's most common object in finance.
senses.whyCN: 在金融里，risk 是这个词最常见的宾语。

senses.title: To reassess a decision
senses.definition: to reopen a choice that had been treated as settled
senses.definitionCN: 重新打开一个已被当作定案的选择
senses.example: The board reassessed its decision when the costs doubled.
senses.exampleCN: 成本翻倍之后，董事会重新考虑了它的决定。
senses.why: The sense admits that a judgement can be wrong.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项承认判断可能是错的。

senses.title: To reassess priorities
senses.definition: to change the order in which things matter
senses.definitionCN: 改变事物重要性的先后次序
senses.example: After the illness he reassessed his priorities in a single afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 病后他在一个下午之内重新排定了自己的轻重缓急。
senses.why: The word can describe a private turning point.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能描述私人的转折点。

senses.title: To reassess the situation
senses.definition: to form a fresh reading of events as they develop
senses.definitionCN: 随着事态发展形成新的判断
senses.example: Officials reassessed the situation hourly during the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水期间，官员每小时重新评估一次局势。
senses.why: The sense is the language of briefings and command.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项是指挥与简报的语言。

senses.title: To reassess after the results
senses.definition: to test an earlier judgement against what actually happened
senses.definitionCN: 用实际发生的事情检验先前的判断
senses.example: The theory was reassessed after the second experiment failed.
senses.exampleCN: 第二次实验失败之后，这个理论被重新评估。
senses.why: The sense links review to evidence rather than to mood.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把复查连到证据，而不是情绪。

senses.title: To reassess a person's worth
senses.titleCN: 重新掂量一个人的价值
senses.definition: to revise what someone is owed in respect or payment
senses.definitionCN: 修改某人在尊重或报酬上应得的部分
senses.example: The company reassessed her worth after she saved the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 她救下那份合同之后，公司重新掂量了她的价值。
senses.why: The word can carry a cold accounting of people.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能带着对人的冷账。

senses.title: Versus reevaluate
senses.definition: to judge anew in practical terms, as opposed to weighing values
senses.definitionCN: 以实际尺度重新判断，与权衡价值相对
senses.example: Managers reassess a budget; philosophers reevaluate a principle.
senses.exampleCN: 经理重新评估预算，哲学家重新衡量原则。
senses.why: The pair separates the ledger from the value.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把账本与价值分开。

intro.en: Reassess is re-, 'again', plus assess, from Latin assidere, 'to sit beside', the image of a judge sitting by the accused.
intro.cn: reassess 是 re-（再次）加 assess，assess 来自拉丁语 assidere（坐在旁边），原指法官坐在被告身旁。

items.en: Assidere meant to sit beside, especially as an assistant judge.
items.cn: assidere 意为坐在旁边，尤指作为陪审法官。

items.en: Assess became to fix a value or a tax.
items.cn: assess 变成确定价值或税额。

items.en: The prefix adds a second sitting of the same court.
items.cn: 前缀加上同一法庭的第二次开庭。

items.en: Business made reassessment a routine step.
items.cn: 商业把重新评估变成例行步骤。

items.en: Today it covers risk, priorities and personal worth.
items.cn: 今天它覆盖风险、轻重缓急与个人价值。

note.en: The look-alike group is the assess- family; the near-meaning group separates reevaluate, reconsider, review and reappraise.
note.cn: 形近组是 assess 词族；近义组把「重新评价」「重新考虑」「复查」「重新估价」分开。

entries.definition: to fix the value of something.
a judgement of value or quality.
something of value that is owned.
to think a decision over again.
to set a new price or value.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a judge sitting down a second time beside a case already heard.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「法官在一桩已审过的案子旁边第二次坐下」的画面。

normal.en: Reassess is re plus assess: the court sits again.
normal.cn: reassess 是 re 加 assess：法庭再开一次庭。

normal.en: Picture old papers pushed aside and a fresh page lifted.
normal.cn: 想象旧报表被推到一边，新的一页被拿起。

normal.en: Say ree-uh-SESS; the stress sits on SESS.
normal.cn: 读 ree-uh-SESS，重音在 SESS。

normal.en: The word is not doubt for its own sake; it follows new evidence.
normal.cn: 这个词不是为怀疑而怀疑；它跟着新证据来。

normal.en: Ask what changed since the first judgement.
normal.cn: 问一句：第一次判断之后，什么变了？

abstract.en: To reassess is to admit that a judgement has a date on it.
abstract.cn: 重新评估就是承认判断上都印着日期。

abstract.en: The word keeps the courtroom image: value is decided by someone sitting in authority.
abstract.cn: 这个词保留法庭意象：价值由某个坐在权威位置上的人决定。

abstract.en: Reassessment is cheapest before the cost of being wrong arrives.
abstract.cn: 在错误的代价到来之前，重新评估最便宜。

examples.en: The bank reassessed the risk of the loan after the audit.
examples.cn: 审计之后，银行重新评估了这笔贷款的风险。

examples.en: The board reassessed its decision when the costs doubled.
examples.cn: 成本翻倍之后，董事会重新考虑了它的决定。

examples.en: After the illness he reassessed his priorities in a single afternoon.
examples.cn: 病后他在一个下午之内重新排定了自己的轻重缓急。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ assess（坐在旁边定价）→ 再坐一次，重新定值。

root: 拉丁语 assidere（坐在旁边）→ assess + re-（再次）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses re-open a judgement: a plan, a risk, a decision, priorities, a situation, results, a person's worth and the line to reevaluate.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在重开一次判断：计划、风险、决定、轻重缓急、局势、结果、一个人的价值，以及与 reevaluate 的界线。

core.en: A SECOND SITTING BY THE SAME CASE
core.cn: 在同一案子旁第二次坐下

branches.en: A plan and a private order of importance.
branches.cn: 计划与私人的重要性次序。

branches.en: Risk in money and risk in events.
branches.cn: 金钱上的风险与事态中的风险。

branches.en: A settled choice reopened by evidence.
branches.cn: 被证据重新打开的定案。

branches.en: The cold accounting of a person.
branches.cn: 对人的一笔冷账。

branches.en: Practical judgement against value judgement.
branches.cn: 实际判断与价值判断相对。

intro.en: The assess- family is a courtroom vocabulary turned commercial: assess, assessment, reassess and reassessment all fix a value.
intro.cn: assess 词族是从法庭词汇变成商业词汇：assess、assessment、reassess、reassessment 都在确定价值。

latinIntro.en: Latin assidere gives assess; the re- prefix simply asks the same judges to sit again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 assidere 给出 assess；re- 前缀只是请同一批法官再坐一次。

items.exampleCN: 一个正在重新评估的委员会。

definition_zh: 重新计算；重算；重新核算
definition_en: to work out a total or figure again, usually because the first result was wrong or the inputs changed
core_image: 一张写满数字的纸上，中间一行被划掉，旁边重新写了一遍
scene: 发票上的税额算错了，会计把每一行都重算了一遍。The tax on the invoice was wrong, so the accountant recalculated every line.
sceneCN: 这里 recalculate 指重新计算（第 1 个义项：重算总额）；句意为发票上的税额算错了，会计把每一行都重算了一遍。

pos.zh: 重新计算；重算；重新核算

senses.title: To recalculate the total
senses.definition: to add a column of figures again because the first sum was wrong
senses.definitionCN: 因为第一次得数有误而把一列数字再加一遍
senses.example: The clerk recalculated the total twice before signing the invoice.
senses.exampleCN: 职员在发票上签字之前把总额重算了两遍。
senses.why: The first sense is arithmetic and ordinary.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是算术的、日常的。

senses.title: To recalculate the dose
senses.definition: to work out a quantity again when a patient's weight or state changes
senses.definitionCN: 当病人的体重或状况变化时重新算出用量
senses.example: The nurse recalculated the dose after the child was weighed.
senses.exampleCN: 给孩子称过体重之后，护士重新计算了剂量。
senses.why: Here the word carries safety, not bookkeeping.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词带着安全，而不是记账。

senses.title: To recalculate from scratch
senses.definition: to abandon a previous chain of work and begin again
senses.definitionCN: 放弃前面的整条计算链，重新开始
senses.example: They recalculated from scratch rather than patch the old model.
senses.exampleCN: 他们没有修补旧模型，而是从头重算。
senses.why: The sense marks a refusal to build on a bad base.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项标记一种拒绝在坏地基上继续的态度。

senses.title: To recalculate the figures
senses.definition: to check a set of numbers for internal consistency
senses.definitionCN: 检查一组数字内部是否自洽
senses.example: The auditor recalculated the figures and found a missing month.
senses.exampleCN: 审计员重新核算了数字，发现少了一个月。
senses.why: The word becomes a tool of verification.
senses.whyCN: 这个词成为核对的工具。

senses.title: To recalculate the route
senses.definition: to work out a path again when conditions on the ground have changed
senses.definitionCN: 实地条件改变之后重新算出一条路径
senses.example: The unit recalculated the route after the bridge was closed.
senses.exampleCN: 桥被封之后，这支部队重新计算了路线。
senses.why: The sense extends the word to space and movement.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项把词扩展到空间与移动。

senses.title: To recalculate a score
senses.definition: to revise a result after a rule or a fact has been corrected
senses.definitionCN: 在规则或事实被更正之后修改结果
senses.example: The judges recalculated the score when the video showed a foul.
senses.exampleCN: 录像显示出一次犯规之后，裁判重算了得分。
senses.why: The sense shows the word deciding an outcome.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项显示这个词在决定结果。

senses.title: To recalculate expectations
senses.definition: to revise what one expects once the numbers behind it change
senses.definitionCN: 在背后的数字改变之后修改自己的期待
senses.example: Investors recalculated the return after the tariff was announced.
senses.exampleCN: 关税公布之后，投资者重算了回报。
senses.why: The figurative sense keeps the same arithmetic.
senses.whyCN: 比喻义仍然保持同样的算术。

senses.title: Versus estimate
senses.definition: to compute exactly again, as opposed to making a rough guess
senses.definitionCN: 精确地再算一次，与粗略估计相对
senses.example: An estimate can be revised by feel; a calculation has to be recalculated.
senses.exampleCN: 估计可以凭感觉修改，计算则必须重算。
senses.why: The pair separates arithmetic from judgement.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把算术与判断分开。

intro.en: Recalculate is re-, 'again', plus calculate, from Latin calculus, a small stone used for counting.
intro.cn: recalculate 是 re-（再次）加 calculate，calculate 来自拉丁语 calculus（计数用的小石子）。

items.en: Calculus was the pebble moved on a counting board.
items.cn: calculus 是计数板上被挪动的小石子。

items.en: Calculare meant to reckon with such pebbles.
items.cn: calculare 意为用这些小石子计算。

items.en: English kept the word for numerical work.
items.cn: 英语保留这个词用于数值运算。

items.en: The prefix adds a second run of the same sum.
items.cn: 前缀加上同一笔账的第二次运算。

items.en: Machines made recalculation instant and invisible.
items.cn: 计算机让重算变得瞬间而无痕。

note.en: The look-alike group is the calcul- family; the near-meaning group separates recompute, recount, rework and adjust.
note.cn: 形近组是 calcul 词族；近义组把「重新运算」「重新计数」「返工」「调整」分开。

entries.definition: the process or result of computing.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a pebble moved back to its first square and the sum begun again.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「小石子被放回第一格，得数从头再算」的画面。

normal.en: Recalculate is re plus calculate: the stones move again.
normal.cn: recalculate 是 re 加 calculate：石子再挪一遍。

normal.en: Picture a line scratched out and written a second time.
normal.cn: 想象一行数字被划掉，又在旁边写了一遍。

normal.en: Say ree-KAL-kyoo-late; the stress is on KAL.
normal.cn: 读 ree-KAL-kyoo-late，重音在 KAL。

normal.en: The word always implies a first answer that failed.
normal.cn: 这个词总意味着第一个答案是失败的。

normal.en: Ask which input changed, not just which sum was wrong.
normal.cn: 问是哪个输入变了，而不只是哪个得数错了。

abstract.en: To recalculate is to distrust the chain but keep the stones.
abstract.cn: 重新计算是不信任那条链，却保留那些石子。

abstract.en: A wrong figure, patiently re-added, teaches where the error entered.
abstract.cn: 一个错数字被耐心重加，会告诉你错误从哪里进来。

abstract.en: Machines hide recalculation; people pay for it in time.
abstract.cn: 机器把重算藏了起来；人则用时间付账。

examples.en: The clerk recalculated the total twice before signing the invoice.
examples.cn: 职员在发票上签字之前把总额重算了两遍。

examples.en: The nurse recalculated the dose after the child was weighed.
examples.cn: 给孩子称过体重之后，护士重新计算了剂量。

examples.en: They recalculated from scratch rather than patch the old model.
examples.cn: 他们没有修补旧模型，而是从头重算。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ calculate（用小石子算）→ 把石子重新挪一遍。

root: 拉丁语 calculus（计数石子）→ calculate + re-（再次）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses recount figures, doses, whole models, audits, routes, scores, expectations and the contrast with a guess.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项重算的是数字、剂量、整个模型、账目、路线、得分、预期，以及与估计的对照。

core.en: A PEBBLE RETURNED TO THE FIRST SQUARE
core.cn: 被放回第一格的小石子

chain: THE OLD ONE IS TRUSTED LESS

branches.en: A total and an audit of the whole column.
branches.cn: 总额与对整列数字的核对。

branches.en: Arithmetic that carries a body's safety.
branches.cn: 牵着人身安全的算术。

branches.en: Refusing to build on a bad base.
branches.cn: 拒绝在坏地基上继续。

branches.en: A path through space and a decided score.
branches.cn: 穿过空间的路径与已定的得分。

branches.en: Revised expectations, and the line to mere estimation.
branches.cn: 被修改的预期，以及它与单纯估计的界线。

intro.en: The calcul- family comes from counting pebbles: calculate, calculation, calculator and recalculate all keep the board.
intro.cn: calcul 词族来自数石子：calculate、calculation、calculator、recalculate 都保留着那块计数板。

latinIntro.en: Latin calculus gives the noun of the pebble and calculare the verb; re- asks for a second run of the same board.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 calculus 给出石子的名词，calculare 给出动词；re- 要求同一块板再算一遍。

definition_zh: 接受者；收件人；获奖者；接受移植的人
definition_en: a person or organisation that receives something given, sent or granted
core_image: 一只伸出的手，掌心朝上，等着东西放进来
scene: 信寄到了，收件人那一栏写的是一个早已搬走多年的名字。The envelope arrived, but the recipient had moved away years before.
sceneCN: 这里 recipient 指收件人（第 1 个义项：信件的接收者）；句意为信寄到了，收件人那一栏写的是一个早已搬走多年的名字。

pos.zh: 接受者；收件人；获奖者；接受者（医疗）

senses.title: The recipient of a letter
senses.definition: the person named to receive a message or parcel
senses.definitionCN: 被指定接收讯息或包裹的人
senses.example: The recipient had moved away years before the letter arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 信到的时候，收件人已经搬走多年了。
senses.why: The first sense is postal and ordinary.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是邮政的、日常的。

senses.title: The recipient of an award
senses.definition: the person on whom a prize or honour is conferred
senses.definitionCN: 被授予奖项或荣誉的人
senses.example: The recipient of the prize gave no speech.
senses.exampleCN: 获奖者没有发表讲话。
senses.why: Ceremony turns the word into an honour.
senses.whyCN: 典礼把这个词变成一份荣誉。

senses.title: A transplant recipient
senses.definition: a patient who receives an organ or tissue from another body
senses.definitionCN: 从另一个身体接受器官或组织的病人
senses.example: The transplant recipient was discharged after nine days.
senses.exampleCN: 接受移植的人在九天之后出院。
senses.why: Medicine uses the word for the receiving body.
senses.whyCN: 医学用这个词指接受的一方身体。

senses.title: The recipient's address
senses.definition: the details that locate the party meant to receive something
senses.definitionCN: 用来定位应当接收某物一方的各项信息
senses.example: A misspelled recipient's address delayed the parcel by a week.
senses.exampleCN: 收件人地址拼错，让包裹晚了一个星期。
senses.why: The word can name a field on a form, not a person.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能指表格上的一个字段，而不是一个人。

senses.title: The recipient of aid
senses.definition: a party that takes help rather than giving it
senses.definitionCN: 接受帮助而非给予帮助的一方
senses.example: The fund required every recipient of aid to publish its accounts.
senses.exampleCN: 该基金要求每一个受援者公开账目。
senses.why: The sense carries power: someone must give first.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项带着权力关系：总得有人先给。

senses.title: A passive recipient
senses.definition: a person treated as the object of another's action
senses.definitionCN: 被当作他人行为对象的人
senses.example: He was a passive recipient of advice he never asked for.
senses.exampleCN: 他是那些自己从未索取的劝告的被动接受者。
senses.why: The word can criticise a role, not describe a fact.
senses.whyCN: 这个词能批评一种角色，而不只是描述事实。

senses.title: A recipient country
senses.definition: a state that receives funds, goods or expertise
senses.definitionCN: 接受资金、物资或技术的国家
senses.example: The recipient country insisted the terms were not conditions.
senses.exampleCN: 受援国坚持说那些条款不是条件。
senses.why: Aid language fixes the word to whole states.
senses.whyCN: 援助语言把这个词固定到国家整体上。

senses.title: Versus donor
senses.definition: one who receives, as opposed to one who gives
senses.definitionCN: 接受的一方，与给予的一方相对
senses.example: The donor sets the terms; the recipient signs them.
senses.exampleCN: 捐赠者定条款，接受者签字。
senses.why: The pair is a single transaction seen from two sides.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词是同一笔交易的两面。

intro.en: Recipient comes from Latin recipiens, the present participle of recipere, 'to take back or receive', from re- and capere, 'to take'.
intro.cn: recipient 来自拉丁语 recipiens，是 recipere（收回、接收）的现在分词，由 re- 与 capere（拿取）构成。

items.en: Capere meant to take or seize.
items.cn: capere 意为拿取或抓住。

items.en: Recipere added the sense of taking back or in.
items.cn: recipere 加了「收回、接纳」的意思。

items.en: The participle named the one doing the receiving.
items.cn: 分词命名正在接收的那一方。

items.en: English used recipient for receivers of goods and letters.
items.cn: 英语用 recipient 指货物与信件的接收者。

items.en: Today it covers prizes, organs, aid and data.
items.cn: 今天它覆盖奖项、器官、援助与数据。

note.en: The look-alike group is the receive- family; the near-meaning group separates beneficiary, receiver, addressee and grantee.
note.cn: 形近组是 receive 词族；近义组把「受益人」「接收器」「收信人」「受让人」分开。

entries.definition: to take something given or sent.
entries.definitionCN: 接受所给予或寄来的东西。

entries.definition: a written proof of payment received.
the act of receiving or a formal welcome.
one who gains from a trust or will.
entries.definitionCN: 从信托或遗嘱中获益的人。

entries.definition: a device or person that receives.
the person a message is addressed to.
one to whom a grant is made.
entries.definitionCN: 被授予财产或款项的人。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of an open hand waiting under a falling object.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一只张开的手在落下的东西下面等着」的画面。

normal.en: Recipient shares a root with receive: the one who takes.
normal.cn: recipient 与 receive 同根：那个拿取的人。

normal.en: Picture a hand held palm up under a letter.
normal.cn: 想象一只手在信件下方掌心朝上。

normal.en: Say rih-SIP-ee-unt; the stress sits on SIP.
normal.cn: 读 rih-SIP-ee-unt，重音在 SIP。

normal.en: The word is a role, not a virtue: receiving can be passive.
normal.cn: 这个词是一种角色，不是美德：接受可以是被动的。

normal.en: Ask who gave first, and who set the terms.
normal.cn: 问一句：谁先给，谁定条款。

abstract.en: Every recipient is half of a transaction that the donor gets to describe.
abstract.cn: 每个接受者都是一笔交易的一半，而捐赠者有权描述这笔交易。

abstract.en: The word looks neutral and hides a direction: something travelled from someone to someone.
abstract.cn: 这个词看似中性，却藏着方向：有东西从某人到了某人。

abstract.en: To be named a recipient is to be placed at the receiving end of a sentence.
abstract.cn: 被称作接受者，就是被放在一句话的受事一端。

examples.en: The recipient of the prize gave no speech.
examples.cn: 获奖者没有发表讲话。

examples.en: The transplant recipient was discharged after nine days.
examples.cn: 接受移植的人在九天之后出院。

examples.en: The fund required every recipient of aid to publish its accounts.
examples.cn: 该基金要求每一个受援者公开账目。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）+ cip（拿）+ ent（人）→ 把东西接过来的人。

root: 拉丁语 recipere（接收）的现在分词 recipiens

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses follow one hand held out: a letter, a prize, an organ, an address field, aid, a passive role, a whole country and the donor opposite.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着一只伸出的手：信件、奖项、器官、地址栏、援助、被动角色、整个国家，以及对面的捐赠者。

core.en: AN OPEN HAND UNDER A FALLING THING

branches.en: A letter and a prize, both addressed to someone.
branches.cn: 信件与奖项，都指向某个人。

branches.en: A body receiving an organ, a party receiving aid.
branches.cn: 接受器官的身体，接受援助的一方。

branches.en: A field on a form rather than a person.
branches.cn: 表格上的字段，而不是一个人。

branches.en: The role criticised as mere passivity.
branches.cn: 被批评为纯粹被动的那种角色。

branches.en: A whole state, and the giver it answers to.
branches.cn: 整个国家，以及它所对应的给予者。

intro.en: The receive- family turns on taking in: receive, receipt, reception and recipient all keep the same Latin hand.
intro.cn: receive 词族围绕「接进来」：receive、receipt、reception、recipient 都保留同一只拉丁语的手。

latinIntro.en: Latin capere gives capture and receive alike; recipere adds the direction back, and recipiens names the party at that end.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 capere 同时给出 capture 与 receive 的根；recipere 加上回的方向，recipiens 命名处在这一端的一方。

definition_zh: 向后靠；斜倚；使（座椅）后仰；躺靠
definition_en: to lean the body or a seat backwards into a resting position
core_image: 椅背一格一格向后倒，人的重心慢慢交给它
scene: 他把椅背调到最低，几乎躺着看完了那场电影。He reclined the seat as far as it would go and watched the film almost lying down.
sceneCN: 这里 recline 指把座椅向后调（第 1 个义项：使座椅后仰）；句意为他把椅背调到最低，几乎躺着看完了那场电影。

pos.zh: 向后靠；斜倚；使（座椅）后仰

senses.title: To recline the seat
senses.definition: to tilt a seat backwards so the body can rest
senses.definitionCN: 把座椅向后倾斜，让身体可以休息
senses.example: He reclined the seat as far as it would go.
senses.exampleCN: 他把椅背调到最低。
senses.why: The first sense is mechanical: a hinge does the work.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是机械的：干活的是铰链。

senses.title: To recline on a sofa
senses.definition: to lie back on a soft surface at an angle
senses.definitionCN: 以一个角度仰卧在柔软的表面上
senses.example: She reclined on the sofa with a book over her face.
senses.exampleCN: 她斜倚在沙发上，书盖在脸上。
senses.why: Here the body, not a mechanism, is the subject.
senses.whyCN: 这里的主语是身体，而不是机械。

senses.title: To recline against a wall
senses.definition: to lean the back against a support and let it carry part of the weight
senses.definitionCN: 把背靠在支撑物上，让它承担一部分重量
senses.example: The guard reclined against the wall and watched the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 卫兵靠着墙，盯着大门。
senses.why: The sense is about borrowed support.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项讲的是借来的支撑。

senses.title: A reclining chair
senses.definition: furniture built so the back can be lowered
senses.definitionCN: 靠背可以被放低的家具
senses.example: A reclining chair took up half the room.
senses.exampleCN: 一把躺椅占了半间屋子。
senses.why: The participle becomes a permanent product label.
senses.whyCN: 分词变成一个固定的商品标签。

senses.title: To recline at an angle
senses.definition: to set the body or a seat at a measured slope
senses.definitionCN: 把身体或座椅调到一个有度数的斜度
senses.example: The dentist reclined the chair to thirty degrees.
senses.exampleCN: 牙医把椅子调到三十度。
senses.why: The sense brings the word close to measurement.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项让这个词靠近测量。

senses.title: To recline in the shade
senses.definition: to rest outdoors in a leaning posture
senses.definitionCN: 在户外以一种斜靠的姿势休息
senses.example: They reclined in the shade and let the afternoon pass.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在荫处躺靠着，让午后过去。
senses.why: The word carries leisure, not just posture.
senses.whyCN: 这个词带着闲暇，不只是姿势。

senses.title: Reclining as ease
senses.definition: the posture that signals trust and unhurried time
senses.definitionCN: 一种表示信任与不慌不忙的姿态
senses.example: His reclining manner annoyed the examiner.
senses.exampleCN: 他那副靠着的闲散样子让考官不快。
senses.why: Posture is read as an attitude by others.
senses.whyCN: 姿势会被别人读成一种态度。

senses.title: Versus lie
senses.definition: to lean back into a support, as opposed to being flat
senses.definitionCN: 向后倚入支撑，与平躺相对
senses.example: You recline in a chair; you lie on a floor.
senses.exampleCN: 你在椅子里后靠，你在地板上平躺。
senses.why: The pair separates angle from horizontality.
senses.whyCN: 这一对词把角度与水平分开。

intro.en: Recline comes from Latin reclinare, 'to lean back', from re-, 'back', and clinare, 'to bend'.
intro.cn: recline 来自拉丁语 reclinare（向后倾），由 re-（向后）与 clinare（弯曲）构成。

items.en: Clinare meant to bend or slant.
items.cn: clinare 意为弯曲或倾斜。

items.en: The compound meant to bend something backwards.
items.cn: 这个复合词意为把某物向后弯。

items.en: English first used the word of bodies and couches.
items.cn: 英语最初用它指身体与卧榻。

items.en: Railway and garden chairs made reclining a product.
items.cn: 火车与花园椅让 reclining 成为商品。

items.en: Today it covers seats, patients and leisure.
items.cn: 今天它覆盖座椅、病人与闲暇。

note.en: The look-alike group is the clin- family; the near-meaning group separates lean, lounge, slouch and sprawl.
note.cn: 形近组是 clin 词族；近义组把「倚」「闲躺」「瘫坐」「摊开四肢」分开。

entries.definition: to lean forward or to tend.
to rest against something at an angle.
to rest in a relaxed way.
to sit or stand with a drooping posture.
to spread the limbs out loosely.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a seat back falling one notch at a time.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「椅背一格一格向后倒」的画面。

normal.en: Recline contains clin, Latin for bending: the back bends.
normal.cn: recline 里有 clin（拉丁语的弯）：背弯下去。

normal.en: Picture a hinge giving way and the body's weight moving back.
normal.cn: 想象铰链松开，身体的重量向后移。

normal.en: Say rih-KLINE; it rhymes with the line of a slanted chair.
normal.cn: 读 rih-KLINE，与斜椅那条线押韵。

normal.en: The word needs a support: a seat, a sofa, a wall.
normal.cn: 这个词需要一个支撑：座椅、沙发、墙。

normal.en: Ask how far back, and who is holding the weight.
normal.cn: 问后仰到多远，谁在承担重量。

abstract.en: Reclining is a small surrender of balance to furniture.
abstract.cn: 后靠是把平衡稍稍交给家具。

abstract.en: The angle of a body is a social statement before it is a comfort.
abstract.cn: 身体的倾斜角度先是一项社会表态，然后才是舒适。

abstract.en: What holds you up also sets how far you may lean.
abstract.cn: 支撑你的东西，也决定你能靠多远。

examples.en: She reclined on the sofa with a book over her face.
examples.cn: 她斜倚在沙发上，书盖在脸上。

examples.en: The guard reclined against the wall and watched the gate.
examples.cn: 卫兵靠着墙，盯着大门。

examples.en: They reclined in the shade and let the afternoon pass.
examples.cn: 他们在荫处躺靠着，让午后过去。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（向后）+ cline（弯）→ 把身子往后弯。

root: 拉丁语 reclinare（向后倾）← re-（向后）+ clinare（弯曲）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses lean one body back: a seat, a sofa, a wall, a chair as product, a measured angle, outdoor shade, a manner read by others, and the line to lying flat.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都把同一个身体往后靠：座椅、沙发、墙、作为商品的椅子、量过的角度、户外的荫、被别人读出的姿态，以及与平躺的界线。

core.en: A SEAT BACK FALLING BY NOTCHES

branches.en: A seat adjusted and furniture designed for it.
branches.cn: 被调节的座椅与为此设计的家具。

branches.en: Soft surfaces indoors and shade outdoors.
branches.cn: 室内的软面与户外的荫。

branches.en: A wall that carries part of the weight.
branches.cn: 承担部分重量的墙。

branches.en: A measured slope and a manner others interpret.
branches.cn: 量出的斜度与别人解读的姿态。

branches.en: Leaning against flat lying.
branches.cn: 倚靠与平躺相对。

intro.en: The clin- family is about slanting: recline bends back, incline bends forward, decline bends away or downward.
intro.cn: clin 词族讲的是倾斜：recline 向后弯，incline 向前弯，decline 弯开或向下。

latinIntro.en: Latin clinare gives the bend; the prefixes re-, in- and de- set the direction of every member of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 clinare 给出弯曲；re-、in-、de- 这些前缀为词族的每个成员定下方向。

items.meaning: bedside practice, from the same bend
